Place: Piemonte, Italy Grape: Dolcetto Vibe: Lush A stunning expression of Dolcetto that is both delicate yet deep with its lush dark cherry fruit. You've got a dash of spice, a little floral element, and lots of savoury tobacco-like complexity on the finish. One of those wines that makes you want to fire up the BBQ. ABV: 12%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Mind-boggling I love love love this wine from Catherine. I buy it on sight, and age these fiercely when I get the chance. Recently caught up with the '18, and my god what a wine. From the south-east facing parcel, Sous La Roche, where vines are planted on grey marl clay soils near Pupillin. This now sees 18 months in large, old oak barrels, and is SO FRESH. Nuts and spice abound, with an almost seaweed-esque salinity and ripping acidity to boot. Everything that's good about Savagnin. Everything that's good about life, tbh.

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Riesling Vibe: Advanced Funky yet fresh. Riesling on skins is something I adore. A gentle 15-day maceration here to coax out as much aromatic charm as possible before any excessive grip takes over. Yann has done it again with this falling perfectly between pithy and pretty citrus. Softly structured with just the right amount of gingery spice and herbal complexity. Large pours all around if you're into things on the wild side. Give this a bit of air and you'll be in for a treat. ABV: 11%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Classic Yep, I can confirm that the 2021s are well and truly singing. The cooler year brings a vivid acidity that works superbly alongside the delicate house style. Light on its feet but by no means lacking in character. This is an elegant expression that really showcases the characteristic VR spiciness. Ethereal. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic The perfect entry into the wonderful world of Domaine Droin, where consistency and quality are always guaranteed. This screams Chablis and as you’d expect is chock full of those minerals. As a baby, we’re talking oyster-shell and citrus but with a few more years of age, you’ll start to see some undergrowth and gun-flint notes coming to the fore. Ice buckets at the ready. ABV: 12%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic Talk about complexity. Côte de Léchet sits happily on the left bank of the Serein, soaking up the sun on steep slopes that reach up to 38%. Yields are low, so the concentration is high. It kicks off tangy, then opens into a fleshy, generous mid-palate. A finish of Maldon salt and straw sees us out in style. Très bon! BV: 13%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic If this is the entry-level bottling, then we’re in for one hell of a ride with this new Droin release. Already drinking like a dream, it’s very much begging for an ice bucket and a plate of oysters. Seashell and sea spray for days. Clean, crisp, and hydrating. ABV: 12.5%

wine: Domaine Droin, Chablis 1er Cru 'Montée de Tonnerre' 2023
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic Talk about complexity. Floral, herbal, spicy, a bit of brioche. You name it, this has it. If you're a fan of the Côte d’Or, then you'll be a fan of this. More richness than your usual Chablis but nothing to be mad about. In fact, I'm positively ecstatic about it. ABV: 13%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural Olivier Lamy is continuing to push out some of the finest gear in Burgundy, and this is right up there. This plot was thankfully spared from the frosts and incorporates some younger fruit from some of the Lamys' high-density plots. Zesty, baked, and buttered bread wrapped up by a seamless salinity that runs throughout. ABV: 13%

wine: Domaine Hubert Lamy, Saint-Aubin 1er Cru 'Clos de la Chatenière 2021
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural The Lamys have been doing bits in Saint-Aubin since the 17th century, however it's current owner Olivier who has written their name in the history books. This is white Burgundy par excellence. Gorgeous fruit front and center, masterful use of oak all carried along by crystalline acidity. Top of the very top. ABV: 13%

Place: Tavel, Rhône Grape: Red Blend Vibe: Vibey Drink me. Due to the limited quantites, we've decided to share the love to some other producers that deserve just as much admiration so this pack will include 1 x L'Anglore Chemin de La Brune 2024 and 1 x Mystery L'Anglore Inspired Bottle xoxo

Place: Tavel, Rhône Grape: Grenache Vibe: Vibey As per, the lightest of the "reds" produced at l'Anglore. Silty, white wine like texture and energy combines with bright, southern framed fruits and tonic like quality. ABV: 14%

Place: Tavel, Rhône Grape: Mourvèdre, Grenache Vibe: Vibey A wine of plushness and density, and whilst all the cuvées from l'Anglore can benefit from a quick nap, this is the one that'll reward the most. Fruit rich in its youth, it'll turn spice-laden with some time. Good luck. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Tavel, Rhône Grape: Grenache Vibe: Banging A new wine from l'Anglore, with juice kept aside from the general blend owing to stupendous aromatic compexity and seduction. No further words required. This pack includes 1 x l'Anglore, Tavel 'Jardin d'Orfeuil' 2020 and 1 x Mystery l'Anglore inspired bottle xoxo

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Aligoté Vibe: A Steal The standout of AMI's wines, in my personal opinion. Soils are clay with some limestone mixed in, from a plot in front of Santenay. Nice n cloudy, just how we like 'em, the smell and taste are both sharp as heck, green apples melded with cream with a long, citrus-y finish and acid off the charts. ABV: 12%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Zippy Fruit here comes off some very chalky soils on the left bank of the Serein river, and is aged 3/4 in barrel and 1/4 in amphora, so we're talking serious texture. Beautifully creamy aromas and a full, robust body are all balanced by a citrus-y, mineral palate. A modern and intriguing take on Chablis. ABV: 12%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Pulsating Chardonnay from three separate sites in and around Rotalier, that little village where wine royalty like Jean-François Ganevat and Labet come from. For those not in the know, this is where you want to be. After the initial mineral reduction blows off, ripe, almost candied citrus begins to unfurl. Layers upon layers of complexity carry through to a long, mouth-watering finish. Queen. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Intoxicating Aromatic charm meets textural finesse. Textbook spice and stone fruit on the nose, with just a smidge of something nutty and gently oxidative. The fruit is rich, the acidity off the charts. There’s power, there’s poise. For a wine with everything turned up to 11, the balance is remarkable. Otherworldly. Two bottle allocation. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Beaujolais fruit vinified in Jura, France Grape: Gamay (Fleurie) Vibe: Alive and kicking This is a stunning vintage of this wine. Fresher than the previous warm, brooding rendition, it shows Gamay doing what it does best, with all its gorgeous, juicy fruit on full display. Like the very best wines, it feels almost ever-changing, pretty florals weaving in and out of savoury hints. Racy and energetic. In my eyes, you can judge a good wine by how long the bottle lasts. Blink and you’ll miss this. ABV: 13.5 %

Place: Alsace fruit vinified in Jura, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Lighter Alsatian Pinot brings a mineral, sappy expression. Maylis brings her usual deft touch in the cellar. This practically drinks itself. So much purity and energy wrapped up just waiting for a cork to be popped. The reds in this vintage might even surpass the whites, that's no easy feat. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Mineral Thought-provoking expression of Chardonnay from a lieu-dit within Poligny. Whole bunches are gently pressed before being fermented in steel. No sulphur, no filtration, no fining. A mineral citrus bomb of a wine. Sharp and steely, this would slice through a roast chicken real nice. ABV: 13%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Ploussard Vibe: Ethereal Ploussard from Poligny in its purest form. Fermented in fibreglass. Almost rusty but so fresh and alive. Fruit forward at first with red currants and orange peel before going all smoky on the finish. Yves' work is incredible, both in the vineyard and in the glass. IDK why he still flies under the radar. This is an exceptional vintage. ABV: 12.5%

wine: La Chaume des Lies, Hautes Côtes de Beaune 2023
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Electric A vibrant, playful Pinot from a domaine that's just hitting their stride. Bright and red-fruited with searing acidity, this is a producer to get onto before their prices go through the roof. Don't say you weren't warned. ABV: 12%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Aligoté Vibe: Natural, textural When Aligoté's good, it's really, really good. Like this. Honeyed, baked fruit on the nose with a gorgeously creamy palate of apples n custard. Like school dinner dessert, but with a zesty flourish. ABV: 11%

wine: Prévost, La Closerie Grand Cru GC23
notes: Place: Champagne, France Grape: Pinot Noir + Chardonnay Vibe: W-O-W The grapes for this one are bought in from super trusted sources - Chardy from Le Mesnil grand cru in the Côtes des Blancs and Pinot from Puisieulx grand cru in Montagne de Reims, both of which were planted in the sixties. This absolutely jumps out of the glass with aromas of pear, freshly baked bread, smoke and orange, with a beautiful full body and saline minerality for days. Just stupid good . ABV: 12.5%

Place: Champagne, France Grape: Pinot Meunier Vibe: Game-changer Delicacy is the word for this one. The finest selection from Les Béguines (87%), topped up with an addition of still red made entirely from 'millerandé' Meunier. Essentially, tiny, seedless, particularly sweet and scented berries, and here they bring perfume and lift from. Vinified without SO2 and aged for 10 months in one 228 litre barrel. Yikes. Elegantly aromatic spiced red fruit and a texture to die for. ABV: 12.5%
Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural, textural Elite. Floral, stone-fruited, dried-fruited, shredding acidity, beautiful texture. Say no more. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural, textural I'm gonna go out on a limb and say the name is some kind of pun in French. But ours is not to reason why. Ours is to drink. So much texture to this one, with a crazily complex palate full of butter, tropical fruit, green apple and spice, with some nuttiness floating through as well, finishing with notes of melon and vanilla. I mean. How many flavours can you get in one wine?! ABV: 13.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural, textural Is it orange or is it white? More importantly, who cares? The Savagnin is harvested late when it's super ripe, then spends five months macerating in amphora and stays there for another seven after pressing, where it's kept company by the sounds of singing bowls and a crystal harp. Yes, really. Mandarin and sweet spice hit you first, followed by a rounded, mineral palate. Intensity is a word that comes to mind. ABV: 13%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural, textural Oxy Savagnin, is there anything better? This is a real feast for the senses, with intense aromatics of green apple and lemon balm, and flavours of straw, cashews and dried herbs, rounded out with a beautiful chalky texture. Take your time with this one, it's got a lot to say. ABV: 13%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural Buy on sight gear. Part of the plot here used to be planted with Pinot, but Hubert and his son Olivier re-planted it all with Chardy in the '90s, believing it a better match for the limestone soils. Who are we to argue with the masters? This is fresh, fresh, fresh, with creamy layers of apple, lemon and hazelnut and spice ranging from cardamom to mint. Complex hardly begins to describe this. ABV: 13%

Place: Emilia Romagna, Italy Grape: Lambrusco Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends Joy in a bottle! No frills Lambrusco, just lovely sweet aromatics and a palate bursting with dark fruit. One to splash about with abandon. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Alto Piemonte, Italy Grape: Nebbiolo Vibe: Classic, richer Conterno + Nebbiolo.... do I even need to continue? Explosive yet nuanced, effortlessly complex yet immediately pleasurable. This is the real deal. ABV: 14%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Classic From 60-year-old vines in Saint-Cyr-En-Bourg, a village known for its heavy clay soil, which gives powerful, rich expressions of Chenin. Those citrus and white stonefruits are gently supported by subtle notes of hazelnut coming from ageing in larger oak cask. A beautiful tension runs throughout the wine to keep everything poised and fresh. Value, and would certainly give some Burgs a decent run for their money. ABV: 13.5%

wine: Prévost, La Closerie '&' Extra Brut L23
notes: Place: Champagne, France Grape: Pinot Meunier Vibe: Sheesh A cuvée created to combat all the fun, fun side effects of climate change, grapes here are sourced from all over Champagne, but all from plots either tended to by Prévost himself or vetted according to his exacting standards. Rich, expressive, balanced. Grapes in the hands of a master. Don't think 2 hard, just get one or maybe three. You won't find this cheaper elsewhere btw ;)

Place: Macon, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Elegant A site recently promoted to premier cru status, nice one! Hand-harvested Chardy planted on clay and limestone making for a fresh, crisp yet exotic fruit profile. Mineral and tense on the palate with a touch of toastiness. A well-deserved promotion. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Gris Vibe: Serious Stunningly pink in colour, redcurrants and cranberries jump out of the glass at first, followed by a palate of rhubarb and strawberry yoghurt atop a bed of earthiness. The sweetness of the fruit is balanced by a touch of tannin and something herbal kicking along underneath. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Sylvaner Vibe: Herbal Sylvaner sees 18 days of skin contact before an eight month sleep in amphora, giving it a lovely oily texture. Serious notes of preserved lemon, with some juicy apple coming through in the middle and distinct aromas of sage and thyme. Would be cracking alongside a roast chicken, if you're into those. ABV: 11%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Gris + Riesling + Sylvaner Vibe: Easygoing Tryo, aka try orange wine - clue's in the name! This is the perfect entry level orange, though miles more complex than most skin contact at this price point. Pink grapefruit in appearance and taste, savoury and salty with a mouth-filling texture and a slightly tropical element. One for novices and nerds alike. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Blanc + Pinot Noir Vibe: Classy Punchier than most Champagne you could find for this price. 3.5 years on lees, giving classic biscuity notes at first with a distinct marzipan, amaretto-esque palate, finishing on some preserved lemon. Prime example of how good Crémant can be in the right hands. ABV: 12%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Auxerrois + Riesling Vibe: A Steal Plenty complex for the price! Floral at first, with Riesling doing most of the heavy lifting here, bringing searing acid and notes of apple, cream and green olive. Proper proper stuff. ABV: 12%

wine: Les Grangeons de L’Albarine, 'Combernand' Chardonnay + Aligoté 2021
notes: Place: Ain, France Grape: Chardonnay + Aligoté Vibe: Alpine The grapes in the lieu-dit Combernand are grown on glacial moraine soil, formed when glaciers melt down and dump a thick layer of pebbles on the ground. Geology rocks! Gorgeously fresh, ripping Aligoté bottled unfined and unfiltered. Big glass plz. ABV: 11%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay + Savagnin Vibe: Electric Beautiful Chardy/Savagnin blend from clay-limestone soils. Delicate and ethereal with notes of citrus, wet stones, spice and candied fruit, this is one to sit on, if you can - no shade if you pop the top as soon as you get your mitts on it though. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Umbria, Italy Grape: Procanico + Drupeggio + Verdello + Malvasia + Sangiovese Vibe: Nostalgic This wine took me right back to my school lunchboxes - it tastes like strawberry Petit Filous (the most elite flavour). Sounds weird but trust me on this one, it's delicious. The juice from the white grapes is poured over the skins of the Sangiovese, which hang out macerating for a few days, getting all that lovely fruit but none of the tannin. Just yum. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Rhône, France Grape: Grenache + Syrah Vibe: Stone Cold Classic, Richer Côtes du Rhône of the very highest order. Find me a better wine at this price? You cant. Intensity of fruit, floral charm, powder fine tannin. This has it all and then some. This négoce bottling truly shows that Frank Balthazar is a master of his craft. ABV: 14%

Place: Oregon, USA Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Gorge Kelley Fox calls this the 'Chablis' of her portfolio, and it's easy to see why. This is super crisp, ever so slightly floral, beautifully mineral with a hint of almonds. Just beautifully straightforward Chardonnay that's clearly been made by someone who knows what they're doing. Praise! ABV: 13%

Place: Bugey, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Unique One of the more mental Chardonnays I've had the pleasure of trying. Aurélien has 5 hectares spread over multiple tiny plots, all with different expositions and soil types - a real patchwork, geddit? This is exceptionally creamy on the nose and it carries over into the finish, with a peach yoghurt kind of vibe going on. Super refreshing, super interesting. One for those who get bored easily. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Kamptal, Austria Grape: Zweigelt + Gr ü ner Veltliner Vibe: Smashable The days of rosé being relegated to the summer are over! This is a wine for all seasons. The Gr ü ner is direct pressed while the Zweigelt sees a few weeks' maceration before both are thrown into a combo of stainless and old wood fermenters. This is full of slightly spicy, juicy, sweet red fruit, with sherbet-like aromatics keeping things fun n fresh. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Rhône, France Grape: Syrah Vibe: Srs You might recognise Vincent's name, given he's the man tasked with taking the helm at Domaine Belluard. So the credentials speak for themselves. This is unoaked Syrah from a vineyard planted in the early 1960s, with zero sulphur adds. Plums and blueberries at first, followed by violet aromatics and a sprinkling of black pepper. Proper stuff. ABV: 13%

Place: Rhône, France Grape: Grenache Vibe: Complex You might recognise Vincent's name, given he's the man tasked with taking the helm at Domaine Belluard. So the credentials speak for themselves. This wine comes from bush-trained, old vine Grenache and goes through carbonic maceration before sleeping for six months in fibreglass. No SO2 added at any stage, this is 100% grapes, and good ones too. With notes of sour cherries, bitters and orange peel and a touch of smoke, this is p-r-e-t-t-y, closer to a Spanish Garnacha then a Rhone red. What's not to like? ABV: 14%

Place: Etna, Sicily, Italy Grape: Grenazzu + Tinto Nero + Nerello Mascalese Vibe: Wow I distinctly remember saying upon trying this that I'd never tasted a red like this before, and I'll stand right by that statement. Old school varieties planted in volcanic soils around Mount Etna, including Grenazzu, dialect for Grenache, which are handpicked, destemmed and then macerated for 28 days before elevage in a mixture of concrete tanks and demijohns. This is bursting with Morello cherry flavours, juicy but serious at the same time. This is limited AF, so grab one while you still can. ABV: 13%

Place: Lanzarote, Canary Islands Grape: Malvasia Volcanica Vibe: Sea spray-core This is the most fruit forward of the Puro Rofe cuvées. You can really feel the proximity to the sea in the wine, but it goes through malo, so it's a combination of spritzy and full in texture. The things some producers can accomplish. The mind boggles. This is full of minerality but also has notes of ripe pear and stone fruit, plus a good lick of salinity. Sheesh. ABV: 13%

Place: Gippsland, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Very, Very Good More mastery from Bill Downie. Silky texture and opening with lovely juicy fruit, followed up with an aromatic, woody finish. Put a chill on this and you're laughing. ﻿ABV: 13%

wine: Vinicola Nulles, Adernats Cava de Guarda Brut Nature NV
notes: Place: Tarragona, Spain Grape: Macabeo + Xarel-lo + Parellada Vibe: Summery Get off the Cava-hater train and get onto this. Chock full of apple and citrus with a honeyed, quince-y thing going on underneath, this is perfect for a pre-dinner drink, or a during dinner drink, or an after dinner drink. It's perfect for drinking, basically. ABV: 12%

wine: Stella di Campalto, Brunello di Montalcino 'VCLC' 2016
notes: Place: Montalcino, Italy Grape: Sangiovese Vibe: Top Bins The newest addition to the impeccable Stella line up. A single plot of 25 year old vines nestled next to the winery that sits on a south-facing, gently sloping hill. Immaculate. ABV: 14.5%

wine: Lucien Aviet, Trousseau 'Cuvée des Géologues' Poussot 2017
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau Vibe: Classic, Earthy This Poussot bottling has plenty of energy along side voluptuousness from the vintage. Dark fruit is wrapped up alongside traces of wet stone and dried spice. Complex and savoury from a true master. ABV: 14%

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Saint Aubin 1er Cru 'La Chateniere' 2023
notes: Place: Burgundy , France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural Marc Colin can do no wrong in my eyes. This offers a mighty fine balance of citrus fruits, saline edge and Saint-Aubin’s characteristic tension. There is just so much concentration and a never ending nutmeg-inflected finish. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Oxy There is something truly quite remarkable about Savagnin under voile. It takes on this savoury, moreish character that just make my mouth water and my belly grumble for hard cheese. Nutty, oxy notes rest on top of dried fruit that is all kept in balance by some nice structure and waves and waves of acidity. ABV:14%

wine: Lucien Aviet, Melon à Queue Rouge 2023
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Melon à Queue Rouge Vibe: Classic, ripe-fruited Melon à Queue Rouge is a local Jurassic variety closely related to Chardonnay that is now only grown by 3 producers in and around Arbois. This is bursting with delicate aromas of white flowers, yellow fruit and a hint of something exotic. Broad yet refined, there is something unmistakably Burgundian about this. ABV: 13%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Life changing The J.K.M Pinot is produced in honour of Andrews mum, June, who still helps out in the winery. " The intention for this wine is to explore both new viticultural and wine making techniques". The result is sumptuous, driving and never ending. Fruit rich, spice rich and acid rich, it leaves you begging for more. ABV: 13%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Gewürztraminer + Others Vibe: Natural, Advanced Another little blend coming from a parcel on sandstone and volcanic rock. Heady in its aromatics, textured without being bitter, and refreshment in spades. The perfect match for all things spicy. Let this breathe and marvel as layers of complexity slowly start to unfurl. ABV: 13%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Captivating I read somewhere recently that Australian Chardonnay is the greatest bargain of the fine wine world. Case in point. Fruit from both the Upper and Lower Yarra is handpicked, gently pressed to barrel and fermented naturally. Super expressive from the moment it hits the glass. Everything you want in Burgundy but don't get until you're spending £60+ is here, and more. Struck match, ample fruit, nutty complexity. Wow. ABV: 13%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Sizzling The Les Vergers vineyard was planted in the early 90s, with own rooted vines growing on rich red volcanic soils. It's a bit shy at first but my lord when it goes it truly goes. The fruit power is very apparent, in the green orchard spectrum, backed up by zinging acidity and smokey, fennel spice cut. A stunner for the mid to long term. ABV: 13%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Ethereal Fruit sourced from a vineyard in the cooler Upper Yarra Valley. I mean, come on. Maybe I am biased but show me Burgundy, or Pinot from anywhere, at this price that is this good. Built to age but so seductive right now. Look past the immediate fruit and you're on an autumnal walk in the woods with mushroom and subtle undergrowth aromatics wafting around. Svelte tannins and a bit of whole bunch laden pepper. A stunner, line up. ABV: 13%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc Vibe: Aromatic It's in the name really. Mostly Sauvignon, with the vineyard now entering prime maturity. 20% of the ferment was as whole bunches and elevage is for 18 months in old barrique. Textbook fruit profile, alongside nice graphite and olive nuances. Its a wine of balance and class yet extreme accessibility. ﻿ABV: 14%

Place: Adelaide Hills, Australia Grape: Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc Vibe: Bright Inspired by the rippling white blends of Cheverny in the Loire Valley, but distinctly Australian. Bright, clear and orchard fruit laden, the quince and dried floral stuff flowing through later on. It matured on its lees in tank which has fleshed out the palate somewhat. Crying out for lunch. ABV: 12.7%

Place: Adelaide Hills, Australia Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Savoury Hard work, making wine. Hand harvested fruit is chilled overnight before being gently pressed as whole bunches. He wants pure juice, does Tim Stock. There's fruit and plushness but this is all about the flavours that follow. Nuts, salted butter, honeycomb and saline minerality. A beauty. ﻿ABV: 13.3%

Place: Adelaide Hills, Australia Grape: Sauvignon Blanc, Chardonnay Vibe: Fragrant Everything skin fermented before maturing for 8 months in older oak. A bit cloudy and a bit pithy in terms of texture, which we want. Plenty of orange tinted citrus fruit character from the off, and that keeps everything ticking over as we head down the tropical route. Salty, drying tannins finish us off and have us reaching for the rest of the bottle. A go-to. ABV: 13.1%

wine: Les Fruits, Voix des Raisins Rosé 2022
notes: Place: South Australia Grape: Shiraz, Cinsault Vibe: Pure Rosé that drinks like an ultra-light red of extreme interest. Sign me up. The Shiraz is hand harvested and immediately foot crushed on the tractor to begin its maceration, arriving at the winery ready to press. Wholesome. Immediately blended with some lightly bathed Cinsault. Pomegranate and red plum laden, it's beautiful and gluggable in every sense. Drink it in. ﻿ABV: 12.8%

Place: Barossa Valley, Australia Grape: Cinsault, Grenache Vibe: Vibey Tonic like in terms of herbal edge and drinkability, this is one to load on. 2/3 of the ferment was carbonic, with the remainder thrown in as whole berries for extra fruity joy. It's a longer ferment for Les Fruits, and we're left with a way more savoury, complex red that'll both stand up to a full meal but also do stupidly well from the fridge if the sun allows it. Dried flowers, red cherry and a bit of old oak infused spice. Wow. ﻿ABV: 13.4%

Place: McLaren Vale, Australia Grape: Grenache Vibe: Marvelous Old vine Grenache grown on the sandy soils of Blewitt Springs. A perfumed example of why Australian Grenache is one of the wine worlds great gifts. Fine-boned and structured in essence, but with the fruit weight to balance this out. It's mouth-watering, juicy, savoury and grown up all at once. ﻿ABV: 13.7%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Sauvignon Blanc Vibe: Benchmark Top tier Sauvignon, more in the mould of Sancerre than Southern Hemisphere, better for it too. A supremely elevated acid profile cuts through layer of citrus and green tropical fruits and its subtley creamy profile. Don't serve too cold. ABV: 12%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Elegant The antithesis of the bombastic, fruit forward style of old Australia. Here's a wine for those who used to like Burgundy before it did the price rise thing. A cool scented fruit profile dominates from the off, moving into nutty, creamy, subtle spice territory as the wine opens up. A wine to whip out the good stemware for. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Yarra Valley, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Fine-Boned 23' was a really low yielding vintage for Gembrook Hill, what did make it into the bottle is superb. There's a skeletal element to this that once upon a time I never really understood, but with the benefit of years of "tasting" I know come to love and relish. Tonic like quality, it's bright and overtly red fruited with svelte tannins binding it all together. ABV: 13%

Place: Mosel, Germany Grape: Riesling + Others Vibe: Electric, Natural Tart as anything, this Riesling heavy blend hits you straight away with plenty of sour orchard fruit before giving way to a soft peach yogurt like finish. Cloudy, confusing and above all delicious. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Gaillac, France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Joyous, Juicy Biodynamic fruit and zero additions make for a dazzling, blue-fruited take on Gamay. The Gaillac is so underrated. I love the herbaceous, garrigue-like quality that comes through in the wines. This is equal parts smashable, equal parts serious. Ori is only on her third vintage, but you'd never be able to tell. This has to be the most pure-fruited expression to date. ABV:12%

Place: Gaillac, France Grape: Syrah Vibe: Pet-Nat + Friends Syrah and Pet-Nat isn't a combo you come across often and after tasting this I'm not sure why. Strawberry laces and sherbet are undercut by electric acidity. Again, the Gaillac brings some herbal charm. Joy in a bottle. Unique and unforgettable with a great name too. ABV: 11%

Place: Cahors, France Grape: Malbec Vibe: Natural, Lighter Unoaked and seriously juicy. As you'd expect from Malbec this is deep, almost inky in appearance but be prepared for a surprise as this is Cahors but not as you know it. There is so much vibrancy on display here its actually hard to believe. The most joyous Malbec you'll find, trust me. ABV:13.5%

Place: Colchagua Valley, Chile Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon Vibe: Spicy Cab Sav isn't our usual thing. Thankfully this example is worlds apart from the usual plonk in the corner shop. Partly due to the 120 year old ungrafted vines and partly due to the natural ferment! Plenty of juicy cassis, plumy fruit with just a whisper of old oak. ABV: 14%

wine: Domaine Bohn, Le Coup De Jus 2022
notes: Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinor Noir, Riesling, Pinot Gris Vibe: Ethereal, Dangerously drinkable Mostly Pinot Noir that spends a few days as whole bunches infusing into the juice of the Riesling and Pinot Gris. This technique really brings out the vibrant aromatics from the Pinot. Be warned, this goes down too easily. ABV: 12.5%

wine: Les Héritiers du Comte Lafon, Macon Chardonnay 2021
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Dreamy According to the winemaker, this cuvée comes from the best vineyard in the area. Ideal balance between clay and limestone in the soil, decently steep slope - all the good stuff. This wine is so elegant, searing acidity and a mineral undercurrent with a finish that goes on for days. Even a little spice on the palate alongside apple and citrus flavours. These guys can do no wrong. ABV: 12.5%

wine: Hacienda La Parilla, El Pinto Palomino 2025
notes: Place: Jerez, Spain Grape: Palomino Vibe: Classic, textural Recently, it's been hard graft trying to find decent wine at decent prices but here we have it. This Palomino is a steal. Citrus and apples on the nose followed by a clean, crispy and salty finish. Who's got the almonds? ABV: 11.5%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Natural When I tasted this, literally all I wrote down in my notes was 'W O W'. Not particularly helpful when it comes to writing a description, but gives you a general idea. Whole bunches, semi-carbo and incredibly gentle extraction leads to exactly the kind of fine Burgundy we like round here. Ethereal drinking. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Sussex, England Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Lighter Grown on chalky soil less than 10km from the English coast. Precise and nimble, thanks to a short 'n' sweet maceration yet still packed with crunchy red fruit and just a whisper of tannin. Pretty impressive, especially with zero adds. In a word: crushable. The future is so bright for not just the guys at Titch Hill but for English wine. Woo. ABV: 9%

Place: Sussex, England Grape: Blend Vibe: Pet-Nat + Friends Fun times in a bottle. This is English fizz but not quite as you know it. A Pet-Nat from a mix of grapes that thrive here. Some you’ll recognise, others you probably won’t. It’s lively, refreshing, and made more for drinking than thinking. Lots of crushed red fruit and tart countryside apples! You'll need atleast 2. ABV:9%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural, textural This is a painstakingly pure and linear Chardonnay with so much tension that things almost feel electric. The fruit is from two plots with one being just above the 1er Cru designated area of the slope. The higher elevation actually helps to keep things elegant. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Pineau d’Aunis Vibe: Natural, lighter Pineau d’Aunis, I'm a big fan. Very much one for now whilst the others rest, you know? Spice-laden, with admirable lift and plenty of sour fruit. A prime example of the harmony achieved between producer and variety on show here, they just know what they're doing. This is my fav bottle yet, the cool vintage bringing' immense freshness. Serve chilled. ABV: 11%
