Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Yeah right so we have Chenin and then we have Robinot Chenin. Pulsating straight off the bat. '24 was wet and cool resulting in one of the most electric expressions to date. Classic on the nose, revolutionary in the mouth, this zips along, cutting through all that fruity, lees-driven complexity. Banger, that's it. How good is Chenin! ABV: 11.5%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Fruit from near-centurion vines. Further indication that Chenin Blanc is one of God's gifts. How could this get any better? Well, this release has seen 15 months in barrel! Now it's very much primed and raring to go. Immense concentration off the bat here, a combination of luscious orchard fruit, custard and salted nuts. Acidity is off the charts as expected. Poise! Second glass please. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Strekov, Slovakia Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Textural, Natural Chardonnay of the highest order. The amount of good wine coming out of Eastern Europe is insane, and Strekov 1075 is one of the best. Masterfully integrated oak and generous fruit are balanced out by beautiful acidity. Burgundy move over! ABV: 12%

Place: Strekov, Slovakia Grape: Blauer Portugieser, Alibernet, Dunaj Vibe: Funky, Lighter Ok, I'm not really sure what the hell is in this but just trust me when I say it's bloody delicious. Rustic, earthy medium-bodied red with a sprinkle of spice. A teeny tiny hint of brett adding complexity. This works equally well from the ice bucket as it does next to a roaring fire. Sign me up. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Swartland, South Africa Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, crisp Sharp and citrusy, with a distinct apple-y thing hanging out in there too. Lean yet still showing plenty of succulent fruit, thanks to multiple picking for optimal ripeness. Hard to beat at this pricepoint. ABV: 13.5%

wine: Domaine Durrmann, Rouge de Pinot Noir 2024
notes: Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Natural, Fresh + Fruity Pinot Noir grown over Sandstone and Schist. This has heaps of bright juicy summer pudding fruit underpinned by a nice mineral core and bit of earthen charm. All done in stainless, without any additions for a wine that is joyous now but will only settle into itself with more time. ABV:11%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Gewürztraminer Vibe: Natural, textural Trying to find nice Gewürztraminer is bloody hard work, but we did it. This is a beautiful dry expression and is a lot more restrained than the usual heady Alsatian style, think more tropical fruit than bath bombs. Almost like drinking the wine equivalent of Lilt. Will convert even the most sceptical. ABV: 12%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Blanc + Pinot Gris Vibe: Pet-Nat + Friends, Skinsy As the name suggests, the fruit is picked from parcels on Schist. Most of the Pinot Blanc spends 3 weeks on skins before being joined by direct press juice from the Pinot Gris and the remaining Blanc. I love how juicy this vintage is. Mango Rubicon anyone? Plus, we're back to zero sulphur at bottling. Drink quick. ABV:11.9%

Place: Modena, Emilia Romagna, Italy Grape: Lambrusco Grasparossa Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends Lambrusco with age? I'm telling you, Claudio is not messing around. Making a very strong case that Lambrusco as a style deserves to be taken seriously. Lambrusco Grasparossa given a short maceration, the free-run moved to steel to finish the ferment, then refermented in bottle with grape must of the same variety and held back until primed and ready. Savoury and balsamic, mature and grown up. Still a core of ripe fruit, but things are now focused on a unique minerality I've not previously encountered in a

Place: Mosel, Germany Grape: Riesling Vibe: Classic This wine kicked off what turned out to be a very long night chez Andreas Bender, so it's one of the only ones I remember. Dry, fresh, and the perfect balance of fruit and acid. Ideal apero wine. Is there anything Riesling can't do? ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Champagne, France Grape: Pinot Meunier Vibe: Hectic A rarity, an oddity, a majestic bottling. Historically one of my favourite producers to drink, although that's becoming a harder and harder task. Anyway, managed to crack one open last weekend. Pulsing and savoury but in an effortless sense. The earthen, lightly oxy stuff can be off putting for some, but that's fine, more for us.

Place: Campania, Italy Grape: Fiano + Falanghina Vibe: Natural, Crisp God, I really do love Campania. Fiano and Falanghina spend a couple of days on their skins for a little grip and some nice waxy texture. Bone dry, saline and hinting at something tropical. This is silly good value. ABV:12.5 %

wine: De Moor, Chablis 1er Cru 'Mont de Milieu' 2023
notes: Place: Chablis, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural, textural A typically driving Chablis from the de Moor stable. Intensity is off the charts, balanced beautifully by one of those characteristic acid lines. Effortless drinking. I'm half inclined to drink them all myself, but that would be rude. ABV: 13%

Place: Txakolina, Spain Grape: Hondarrabi Zuri Vibe: Classic, crisp Oh I do love some Txakoli! Bone-dry, heaps of citrus, a sprinkle of salt and all with a prickly spritz - the perfect accompaniment to some summer sunshine. ABV: 11.5%

Place: North Canterbury, New Zealand Grape: Pinot Noir, Gewürztraminer Vibe: Its in the name A co-ferment of Pinot and Gewürz, skins and all, with the wine then sent off to a mix of oak, tank and amphora for maturation. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Bandol, France Grape: Cinsault, Grenache, Mourvèdre Vibe: Elite Top end rosé, with so much going on, from fruit to herb to earth. The right amount of everything. Acid, fruit, texture, grip. Superb. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Sylvaner Vibe: Textural Old vine fruit has a 5 week long bath, skins intact. Here's a lesson in balance of extraction. The fruit is all apricot and grapefruit pith with a smattering of pepper. The tannins are a treat. Large glasses please. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Gris Vibe: Gastronomic Schieferberg is the place to be! Southerly exposed, at 350-400 metres of altitude, sheltered by the Ungersberg mountain. It's all schist too, which keeps the heat on hot days and returns it as needed on those cooler nights. This is one hell of a wine. Bone dry and broad shouldered, a Pinot Gris with personality in spades. Apple skin bitters, citrus zest, plenty of stone fruit, almost with a ginger-like spice. The finish is all crushed rock and steel. Decant this and serve it with food. ABV: 13%

Place: Penedes, Spain Grape: Xarel-lo, Parellada Vibe: Easy Skinsy, Natural Old vine fruit, 2 weeks on skins and then 8 month in amphora/steel tank. This is an extreme crowd pleaser. Texture and grip, aromatics and fruit. Quadruple threat. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Polusard Vibe: Light As A beautiful expression, with maceration dialled down and floral expression pushed to the fore. The juicy fruits and spice come through later on, keeping things crunchy and interesting. One for the fridge. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Canary Islands, Spain Grape: Baboso Blanco Vibe: Classic, textural Only 500L produced, which is not much. 1 barrel. 50% of plantings of this extremely rare variety are on the Tameran property. Hen's teeth. Crazy energy, bloody hell. Simply put one of the best white wines you will drink this summer, if you're lucky enough to get on it. Complex, refreshing. If this was Burgundy, we'd all be in tears. ﻿ABV: 12%

wine: Lost in a Field, Frolic Pet Nat 2025
notes: Place: England Grape: Madeleine Angevine + Other English Heritage Varieties Vibe: Pet-Nat + Friends A gorgeously aromatic pet-nat made from a blend of heritage UK varieties such as Madeleine Angevine. This is a fruity, fault free, zero sulphur bottling from Tim Wildman MW. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Tasty Maturing Bourgogne Rouge that proves more hands-off wines can still benefit from a short snooze in the cellar. The fruit is still vibrant but is softening nicely, revealing a medley of herbs and subtle spice. Lovely work from AMI as usual. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir, Aligoté Vibe: Hello! Burgundy-Nouveau? Is there such a thing? This would be it. The Pinot is treated to a carbonic bath, emphasising that primary character and the Aligote to a quick press for clear juice before fermentation in old oak. Red wine with a white wine texture. It's a vibe. ABV: 11.5%
Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Elite What to get the person who already has everything? Something like this.

Place: Piedmont, Italy Grape: Nebbiolo Vibe: Bloody Good Fruit blended from plots in Serralunga, Monforte and Castiglione Falletto. A snapshot of the greater Barolo, and a stunning one at that. Inviting and well formed to the extent that you'll probably be pulling multiple corks. For those that have patience, there's tannin that'll reward you handsomely. Line up. ﻿ABV: 14.5%

Place: Piedmont, Italy Grape: Nebbiolo Vibe: Up There Manley, who makes the M8 wines, used to work over at Mascarello. He knows what he's doing Nebb-wise. This is a ripper straight off the bat. Open and welcoming, but always building and developing. Textbook. Smashable. ABV: 14.5%

Place: Modena, Emilia Romagna, Italy Grape: Lambrusco del Pellegrino Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends Claudi showcasing the diversity and depth of Lambrusco. This is del Pellegrino, also known locally as Lambruscone. A short time on skins for blushing red bubbles. All wild red fruit and roasted berries, herbal and salty, with a fine bead of fizz that makes it almost impossible to put down. After drinkin' this, I think we can all agree that we need to take Lambrusco seriously. ABV: 11%

Place: Champagne , France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic Fruit from two plots within Avize that're on heavier clay soils, particularly when compared to Mineral. Expect command and intensity. It's broad and full, layered and seductive with that trademark Agrapart acidity cleaning it all up. Stunning. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Veneto, Italy Grapes: Glera, Boschera, Perera, Bianchetta, Grapariol, Verdiso, Marzemina Vibe: Charged Up Mind altering taste. Ripping acidity balanced out by luscious fruit and a wonderful amount of texture. It drinks astonishingly well over lunch. You've been warned. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Conca de Barberà, Spain Grape: Trepat Vibe: Crunchy What does crunchy mean? Bright and ripe and fresh. Three amazing words. Highly chillable and full of red cherry, plum and high altitude herbal aromatics. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Conca de Barberà, Spain Grape: Parellada Vibe: Dangerous Supremely thirst quenching. Parellada usually finds a home in Cava production in these parts, so it's nice to see it given the spotlight. Ultra-crisp, there's added interest following a half day spent on the skins. Hi Summer, is that you? ABV: 11%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Aligoté Vibe: Mature IYKYK. Easily, the most coverted bottling from the Domaine. Stirctly reserved for the real heads. As the name suggests, pretty old vine material from over in Saint-Bris. Some of the oldest Aligote going around, I'd wager. These kind of wines take so much work that for many it is barely worth bothering. So be thankful. Momentous stuff. If you age this, I'll buy it back for silly amounts in a few years down the line. Drink one now, one for the cellar. ABV: 13%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Ploussard, Trousseau Vibe: Tasty We got a bottle of this on a recommendation from our producer in Jura. One to watch. We wanted to sign him ourselves but what can you do. This was drunk in the carpark at Geneva airport. Tasted good direct from bottle. Imagine what it'd be like from glass. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Ploussard Vibe: Aromatic I wish more producers would produce Ploussard in this style. I'm off the overly stinky, reductive stuff. Who has the time. Thanks Kevin. Alluring in every sense. A guzzler. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Biblical Woof. Get me some cheese. You'll find that raw, nutty, saline thing after this has been kissed with a bit of oxygen. It's powerful and driving but almost impossible to put down. Fox wine 4ever.

Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau Vibe: Bright Tony doesn't bother to submit this to the appellation for grading for fear that the conservatives wouldn't get it. Fair. It's lifted, energetic and bloody tasty. Settled down nicely! ABV: 14%
Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Fresh Beautiful. A wine of sumptuous energy, appeal and complexity. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Somontano, Spain Grape: Moristel Vibe: Crunchy Hello! Chuck this on ice and you're pretty much set. Transports one to the foothills of the Pyrenees with all the sour wild berry and herbal aromatics. A ripper, Value. Yes. ABV: 13%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Crystalline Topped up, extremely pure Savagnin from a producer you'll want to keep tabs on. Full of lively citrus fruit, peppery spice and bitter grip. ABV: 13%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Ripping Extended elevage, basically a repeat in terms of profile his reg Savagnin but with everything more pronounced, particularly the nutty, saline elements. Side by side? Ok. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Languedoc, France Grape: Carignan Gris, Grenache Blanc, Grenache Gris Vibe: Floral A stunner, quite clearly betraying the Burgundian education achieved by Magnon. Stone fruited and acid driven on the palate, there's just the right amount of flesh and texture. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Penedes, Spain Grape: Macabeo Vibe: Textural Really old vine fruit giving wonderous levels of natural concentration with natural balance. It's only natural. Fermented on skins for 14 days in amphora that're buried in the ground. Value! ABV: 10.5%
Jukes 6 is black fruit-themed with a deep, earthy, spicy feel and a mellow, long and savoury finish. ABV: 0%
Jukes 1 is centred around a citrus, stone fruit and fresh herb theme, resulting in an aromatic, uplifting and dry style. ABV: 0%

wine: Peggy et Jean-Pascal Buronfosse, SE KWA SA? 2023
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau, Poulsard, Chardonnay Vibe: Natural , lighter A full Jurassic field blend, as if Peggy and JP couldn't do any more to make us happy. The 2023 vintage is well and truly on, the locals calling it the best in decades... This is so incredibly moreish. It would be poor from me to even try and describe what's going on, such is the diversity. This needs to be tasted/drunk. ABV: 11%

wine: Peggy et Jean-Pascal Buronfosse, Chardonnay 'Les Ammonites' 2022
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural , textural Fruit from a tiny, organically farmed plot on the limestone slopes of Rotalier. The taste is in the name really, a vineyard heavy in fossilised sea life from years gone by. Close your eyes and you could be somewhere coastal, with rasping, salt tinged acidity creaming through some well ripened stone fruit flavours. Stunning, as per. ABV: 12%

Place: Penedes, Spain Grape: Xarel-lo Vibe: Easy Skinsy, Natural Skinsy number from 60 year old vines of Xarelo Vermel, a rare mutation with a thicker pink skin. This mutation makes it perfect for extended time on its skins and the result is something stone fruited, saline and incredibly moreish. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Penedes, Spain Grape: Trepat + Grenache Vibe: Natural Delightfully pale ros é made from Trepat and Grenache. Zesty, fresh aromatics with a touch of texture make this one a great all rounder for the summer ahead. Uncomplicated and delicious this will suit the picnics in the park equally as much as the dinner table. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Penedes, Spain Grape: Xarel-lo, Muscat Vibe: Pet-Nat + Friends Thirst quenching excellence from old bush vines teeming with biodiversity. Super fresh and citrusy with the Muscat adding just a hint of floral intrigue. Bottled unfined, unlfitered and with zero additions. ABV: 11%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Riesling, Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir, Pinot Auxerrois, Gewürztraminer Vibe: Natural, Advanced A joyous blend from the south-east facing and humid hillside above the village of Scherwiller. The different varieties are pressed together over eight hours extracting structure, texture and color. Gorgouesly oranged hued, aromas of peaches and cream jump out of the glass whilst there is a heap of floral and herbaceous complexity on the palate. Always changing, always delicious. ABV: 13%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Pinot Gris Vibe: Natural, textural Totally dry expression of Pinot Gris from the Frankestein Grand Cru. Fruit forward and luscious with an almost Chartreuse like qualilty. Things are kept in harmony by an intense saltiness and stony minerality on the palate. Open this an hour before serving to really show off the wine in its best light. ABV:13.5%

Place: Penedes, Spain Grape: Xarel-lo Vibe: House White A wine that you'll want sitting comfortably alongside the milk in your fridge, 7 days a week, as things hot up. It's very, very easy to like. A fair whack of stone fruit and some nice body, but also plenty of tension and crispness. All rounder, we all need one. ABV: 11%

Place: Montsant, Spain Grape: Garnacha Vibe: Natural, lighter A new bottling from the boys at Joan d'Anguera, with fruit from younger vines treated like fruit from younger vines would like to be treated. They want freshness and vibrancy, and it was achieved. It's light on and effortlessly juicy, whilst maintaining its pedigree. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Textural Old vines, planted on a warm, south-facing slope. Expect some ripeness to the fruit profile, cut to shreds by that characteristic Autran freshness. All stainless for the ferment, as well as half its maturation period. Wonderful. ABV: 14%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Textural Ancient, low yielding vines on show here. Texture for days. There's all the ripe orchard fruit flavours we want, added to some honey-laden notes, showing the warmth of '18. A beauty. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Tense How good is tension. Reductive and nervy at the start, then things flesh out, flowing nicely and building in intensity. A ripping drink. What we wish all white burgs could taste/feel like. Yummy. ABV: 13%

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru 'En Cailleret' 2022
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Immense Mother Mary... one of the best sites and best operators going around. A wine of phenomenal detail and precision that demands attention and hopefully some patience. One to load on. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Veneto, Italy Grape: Bianchetta, Glera Vibe: Textural As with all things Costadilà, there's no shortage of vibrancy or personality. Plenty of exotic fruits and grassy flavours kicking about, as well as some yeasty elements, which make this the most food oriented of the Costadilà fizzers. Get on it. ABV: 10.5%

wine: The Hermit Ram, Salty White Amphora 2022
notes: Place: North Canterbury, New Zealand Grape: Sauvignon Blanc, Pinot Blanc, Riesling Vibe: Salty 14 days on skins, then raised in amphora. Texture in many forms. Tropical and exotic, both in terms of fruit and spice. Salty too, as in the name. Bloody good. ABV: 11.5%

Place: North Canterbury, New Zealand Grape: Field Blend Vibe: Moreish What can't the man do? Not much apparently. Red and white ferments in the mix here, pink in colour. It's at once weirdly serious and the most gluggable thing you've ever opened. Do your worst. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

It's Back, We're Back, Binch are Back, People's are Back, Weino BIB is in. Will you be? Here's the gist. Dan's, People's Wine, Binch and Weino BIB will be throwing their doors open on Sunday the 14th of May for an afternoon wine crawl of unheard of proportions. Each ticket grants you entry as part of a select group of lucky individuals who will be offered glasses of the good stuff. Good stuff only. Because you're worth it. How It's Gonna Work We'll have a shotgun start, with each group of 25 kicking things off at a different bar. You'll spend 40 mins or so knocking back multiple delicious wine

Place: Gippsland, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Very, Very Good A bit more meat on the bones with the Bull Swamp bottling, but in the most forgiving way possible. Still graceful. If Camp Hill was the more floral, free flowing iteration, then Bull Swamp is it's yang. Darker fruited and almost peppery, there's depth and a brooding complexity that will demand some patience. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

Place: Gippsland, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Very, Very Good If this were Burgundy people would genuinely lose the plot, it's that good. Thankfully it's not Burgundy. So much delicacy and clarity in the glass. The nose is so good that I may as well just stop writing. Drinking very well on release, it will be amazing to see this flesh out and take on more of that haunting, decaying kind of character. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Gippsland, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Charged Up All fruit goes into stainless steel and is left to do its thing. Bill Downie proving the same point as he has been for several years now, all the work is done in the vineyard. These have always been wines full of personality and regionality, but I can't remember them having this freshness. Remarkable consumption, in a sultry way. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Gattinara, Italy Grape: Nebbiolo Vibe: Structured The 2018 Gattinara Molsino emerges from a relatively warm, sunny spot on the estate at 400m in elevation. It presents myriad shades of dark cherry/plum fruit, sage, menthol, new leather and dark spices. Potent and virile in the glass, the Molsino possesses tremendous drive as it builds into a deep, beautifully resonant finish that is utterly captivating. It’s a remarkable effort for the first year in which Roberto and his team were in charge. The ambition is pretty clear. Molsino will soon be the Monfortino of Alto Piemonte. (Antonio Gal

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Ripe Not your everyday Bourgogne Blanc, with fruit coming from within Saint-Aubin. There's richness of texture and fruit weight with penetrating acidity. Things are going all golden and hazelnutty too. All things that you want. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Heathcote, Australia Grape: Malvasia, Schioppettino , Syrah Vibe: Easy AS White wine, rose wine and red wine all blended together. Straight on ice. We're on the lighter side of medium, with ice tea like refreshment factor. Wild berry, salt and herb. Yum. ﻿ABV: 12%

wine: Momento Mori, Give Up The Ghost 2019
notes: Place: Heathcote, Australia Grape: Greco Vibe: Momentous Bugger all Greco di Tufo planted in Aus, like barely any. 10 months on skins, everything done by gravity, and only the free run juice used. Painstaking. Results though! Super fragrant in a refreshing, mountain air like way before the citrus fruit flavours take control. Feels beautiful to drink. Is beautiful. So are you. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Heathcote, Australia Grape: Fiano, Malvasia, Vermentino Vibe: Energetic We're treading the line between white wine and skinsy here. You know, the Italian line where even the heavy maceration gear is labelled Bianco. That's an aside though. What's in the bottle here is brilliant. All varieties fermented separately with varying degrees of skin contact + technique. Vibrancy is never in short supply when it comes to Momento Mori. Blimey this makes you want to knock it back. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

wine: Domaine Labet, Macvin du Jura NV
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Hectic Macvin sits somewhere in the realm of solera aged Sherry, the sweeter stuff. Must is boiled, reduced then blended with Marc. It's tasty as, heading down the more rancio road of dried and stewed fruits with a spice laden finish. ABV: 17%

wine: Les Héritiers du Comte Lafon, Mâcon-Milly-Lamartine 2023
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Instant Classic This is a beauty, should be in peoples Chardy 101. Richness and density meets freshness and drive. ABV: 13%

wine: Les Héritiers du Comte Lafon, Viré-Clessé 2022
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Textbook A powerful iteration of Viré-Clessé, more along the lines of what you want from this village. Full but tight atm, this'll benefit from some air and a swirl in the short term. We're on the riper end of orchard fruit spectrum, with plenty of mealy, honeyed stuff backing it all up. ABV: 13%

Place: Veneto, Italy Grape: Merlot, Cabernet France, Refosco Vibe: Fresh As This is a natural wine, and sometimes will open with some fizziness. This will blow off with air and time. The Loire meets the Veneto here, and does so really nicely. Makes you wonder. We get all that lovely fragrant, juicy red fruit that one associates with the fresher red styles of this part of the world, combined with some pencil shaving laden tannin keeping all in check. It's bloody delicious. One for the fridge. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Veneto, Italy Grape: Glera, Moscato Vibe: Uplifting + Aromatic A devilish combo, the addition of ultra-aromatic Moscato bringing further intrigue to what was an already driving, moreish fizz. A transportive fizz, one that'll have you in the misty hills of Northern Italy. Tremendous work. Easy work for you. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Veneto, Italy Grape: Glera Vibe: Uplifting Plenty of energy in the bottle, with tonnes of orchard fruit and fresh cut grass waiting to be unleashed. Unfiltered, so will have a light sediment and non-dosed so will be incredibly moreish. You've been forewarned, maybe best to double down. ABV: 11%

Place: Valencia, Spain Grape: Garnacha Vibe: Fragrant Grenache from Spain, or Garnacha as it's known in Spain, is well into its phenomenal resurgence. The vibe is way lighter, more aromatic and generally just prettier and way easier to like/consume. No different here. Ripe red fruits, plenty of lift, too. Have with a BBQ. How good's a barbie? ABV: 13%

Coming in with some good stuff that you may be less familiar with. Villiam from Pandemonium Wines will be running us through six bottles by three Slovakian producers. All levels on the natty spectrum, all levels of greatness. Pivnica Cajkov, a natural winemaker with over 20 years of winemaking under his belt from the hills of the Nitra region; Pivnica Brhlovce, whose cellar is located in a cave of tuff bedrock - made of volcanic ash; and Ján Svetík, also from the Nitra region, who takes a rustic approach to winemaking, using just hands and time in his cellars. Nice. We’ll hopefully learn somet

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Layered Young producer, classic stylez. One to watch. Here we go on that multi-layered, oxidative journey. You'd be smart to arm yourself with a wedge of mature, hard cheese for the ride. Raw nuts, baked citrus, tonnes of sea salt, and ginger like spice. Miraculous. ﻿ABV: 14%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Ploussard Vibe: Transparent So, so good. One to be served lightly chilled. Oodles of refreshing red berry character pulse through. Effortless now but also one of those Ploussard that will stand the test of time. Good luck trying to hold onto this one. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Sierra de Gredos, Spain Grape: Grenache Vibe: Delicious Curro Barreño from Fedellos do Couto up in Ribeira Sacra makes these wines from vineyards owned by Dani Landi. A formidable combination. There's so much ease here, easy to like, easy to appreciate, easily flowing complexity. Beauty. ﻿ABV: 14.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Layered This hangs out under flor for a year, so expect some nutty, saline, Sherry like quality. Demands a large piece of hard, mature cheese. Very, very good. ABV: 13%
Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Effortless Sous-voile, so oxy, so nutty and delicious. Ample breadth and complexity on show. Spiced apple, brine and citrus peel energy. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Saint Aubin 1er Cru Rouge 2015
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Tasty More matured Pinot from the phenomenal cellars of Marc Colin. This might just be the best of the bunch too. Elegance personified, its just starting to show that undergrowthy, five spice laden quality that hooks you on good Burgundy. Apologies in advance. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Gamay, Grolleau Gris, Grolleau Noir Vibe: Energetic A new fizz project from the minds at Calvez-Bobinet and Bruno Richard. No adds. Pure pleasure. Raspberry and red citrus fruits on the cards with this one. So much life, dangerously easy. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Energetic A new fizz project from the minds at Calvez-Bobinet and Bruno Richard. No adds. Pure pleasure. Full on Granny Smith vibes. Like biting into your first of the season, from the fridge. Pucker up. ABV: 11%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Refreshing Early picked fruit on show here, and it's singing. Rasping acidity that could cut through stone shapes the wine, alongside some youthfully exuberant orchard and citrus. Very, very tidy. Should have got more. ABV: 12.5 %

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Chassagne Montrachet Rouge 'Vieilles Vignes' 2016
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Seductive A good amount of flesh on the bones here, owing to the warmth of 2016. The result is a wine full of seduction. Red cherries and strawberry dominate. Into it. ABV: 13%

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Santenay Rouge 'Les Champs Claude' 2015
notes: Place: Burgundy Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Sensual Finding a producer in Burgundy who is equally adept with both white and red is tough going. We have one here. Great news. Vines planted in 1901. So much poise here, delicacy and savoury power combining effortlessly. Insanely good drinking. ﻿ABV: 13%

wine: Chevassu, Côtes du Jura Pinot Noir 2023
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Fresh + Fruity All aboard the high drinkability train. All that's good about Jurrasic Pinot on show here. Tonnes of fragrance, great depth of fruit and a little bit of X factor. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Spicy + Textural Topped up Savagnin from one of the best in the business. Ample flesh and ripeness, this is Savagnin at its mouth-coating best. Begs for cheese. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: UK Grape: Cold Brew Botanical Blend Vibe: Non-Abv + Crisp Plenty going on with these Blurred Vines Alt-Wines. All of it to like. This is the route to go down in the non-abv sphere, with a much greater level of intensity and feel compared to their dealcoholised siblings. Red fruited, fherbal and lightly tannic with nicely persistent fizz. A small dose of caffeine from the green tea will keep you dancin' all night long.

Place: UK Grape: Cold Brew Botanical Blend Vibe: Non-Abv + Crisp Plenty going on with these Blurred Vines Alt-Wines. All of it to like. This is the route to go down in the non-abv sphere, with a much greater level of intensity and feel compared to their dealcoholised siblings. Green fruited, plenty of herbal charm and a little grip.

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Saint Aubin 'Cuvée Luce' 2020
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Chiseled and Intense Everything over at Domaine Marc Colin is being geared further toward longer ferments and more detailed flavour. They were already starting at a pretty good base, mind. Here's one to bust into immediately, whilst your Chassagne's go to sleep. There's immediacy to the ripeness and stone fruited flesh that welcomes you in, and a definite mineral streak that tidies it all up. Yummy. ﻿ABV: 13%

wine: Domaine Saumaize-Michelin, Pouilly Fuissé 1er Cru 'Sur La Roche' 2023
notes: Place: Macon Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Persistent This'll suck you in. Pretty much as good as it gets in these parts. Mildly reductive, so use a large glass and give it a swirl. Nutty, fruity, saline, full of tension and breadth at the same time. It toys with you. Let it. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

Place: Macon, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Textural and Complex Top end gear. Barrel selections from the domaine's best sites, Ampelopsis sits in cask for 20 months of extended elevage. Presence! This has it in spades. There's just the right amount of citrusy acidity to keep things in check too. Beautiful. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Provence, France Grape: Cabernet Sauvignon and Syrah Vibe: Fuller Plenty of power here. Understandably, its what we're looking for. Probably one to put to sleep for a few years, but if you're into opening things early then be my guest, pour me a glass. Layered, brambly fruit and some pretty polished tannins on show right now. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Macon, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, Energetic If all Chardonnay tasted like the Chardonnay made by Saumaize-Michelin then Chardonnay would have nothing to worry about. Precise and savoury yet incredibly welcoming. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

wine: Clos des Vignes du Maynes, Macon Rouge 'Cuvée 910' 2025
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Gamay + Pinot Noir + Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, lighter Gamay, Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. The most legit Burgundy in a sense, an ode to centuries of winemaking in the region. You're in for a treat if you manage to nab one of these. A textural dream, an aromatic wonder, it'll draw you in and keep you there. Tart fruit, bit of pepper, decaying florals. Wow. ABV: 12%

Place: Abruzzo, Italy Grape: Montepulciano Vibe: Classic, easy Easy going and uncomplicated, exactly what we need on occasion. You get all that dark red and blue fruit that we want, a bit of dusty tannin to shape things and plenty of freshness. Bottled under screwcap too. It's a dream. ABV: 13%

Place: Champagne , France Grape: Avize + Cramant Chardonnay Vibe: Classic A blend of Avize and Cramant Chardonnay, all Grand Cru of course, we're not messing around here. Agrapart wines are always powerful but my god this is structured. ﻿ ﻿Flavours of crisp stone fruits, wet stones, lemon oil and mint. Can you say yum? I can. Yum. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Chenin Blanc from some enviably placed vines in Anjou with a couple of 'half decent' vignerons operating out of the neighbouring plots... This bottling see's juice left resting in barrel for 24 months. A supreme luxury, and one that rewards greatly, with the fruit taking a backseat to a whole lot of pure, cutting Montbenault minerality. ABV: 12.8%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Pure Chenin magic. Fruit from a small parcel between Montbenault and Les Aussigouins, two supreme terroirs. Old vines, exposed situation, picked for freshness. Sent off to 500L barrels for 10 months prior to bottling. Like biting into the tastiest apple you've ever had. God this is good. Invigorating. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Old vine Chenin, tank fermented for optimum freshness. Hope you like acid, because it's here in spades, ripping things up. Plenty of that crushed rock, bruised apple business too.

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural, textural Topped up Savagnin. TOP! This is a ripper, all that chiseled power is on full display. It's expressive as hell. Equal parts cerebral and smashable. ABV: 13%

wine: Philippe Chatillon, La Grande Chaude Blanc 2020
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural , textural Old vine Chardy here, and it's not shy. Great presence! A white wine that demands a meal, my favourite type. Firmly in the smoky, mineral-driven camp. ABV: 13%

wine: Philippe Chatillon, La Grande Chaude Rouge 2020
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau + Pinot Noir Vibe: Natural , lighter Chatillon used to run things at de la Pinte, he knows what's what. Trousseau and Pinot Noir here, hand-harvested, hand-crafted. Pretty firm from the outset, but that drops away to deliver a sumptuous array of tart red fruit and five spice. Yummy! ABV: 13%

Place: Corbières, France Grape: Carignan + Grenache + Syrah + Grenache Gris + Macabeu + Terret Vibe: Natural, lighter ﻿Mostly Carignan, like 95%, from a century old vineyard co-planted with Grenache, Syrah, Grenache Gris, Macabeu and Terret that also get thrown in the vat. You know how some wines manage to combine phenomenal complexity with effortless drinkability? Here's another. There's power but also lift and a suppleness to the fruit that just screams throw me in the fridge for halfa and then get cracking. Lovely. ﻿ABV: 14%

Place: Corbières, France Grape: Carignan + Cinsault + Grenache Vibe: Natural, richer Succulence and seduction are high on the agenda here. 100% whole bunches, carbonic the whole way. Here's a dark-fruited, herb-spiced joy that should be extremely high on your list. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

wine: Dominio del Águila, Pícaro del Águila Tinto 2023
notes: Place: Ribera del Duero, Spain Grape: Blanca del País + Bobal + Garnacha + Tempranillo Vibe: Classic, lighter A producer that effortlessly treads the line between making wines that the old folk will get around but also that the really trendy guys will like cus it's a pretty hands-off field blend. Tenderness here, like a cuddle. Dark fruits, plenty of lift, a bit of texture and a good lick of acid. ﻿ABV: 14%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Classic Fizz that isn't Champagne but is a better example of fizz than many a Champagne. At Champalou the work is painstaking. Impeccably looked-after vines, perfect soil conditions, by-hand work in the cellars. This has everything you could want, from the brioche through to the ripe fruit. Tasty. ﻿ABV: 13%

wine: Domaine des Roches Neuves, Saumur Blanc 'Clos Romans' 2023
notes: Place: Loire , France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Classic , textural The vines here are planted within a clos (walled vineyard) that dates back to the 11th century. Germain has been steadily replanting the site with massale-selected vines at high densities. Incredibly saline and linear. A stupid amount of pent-up energy cuts things to shreds here. Impeccable. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Colchagua Valley, Chile Grape: Carignan + País Vibe: Natural, richer More blinding value coming out of Chile. Carignan and Pa í s, dry grown and not messed around with. No shortage of dark fruit, spice and floral character here. Very easy to like. ABV: 13%

Place: Abruzzo, Italy Grape: Trebbiano Vibe: Classic, textural Time in tank on the lees has added some lovely texture here, balancing out some fairly racy acid. The fruit's gone all yellow and delicate, with a nice floral element coming through too. A bargain. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau Vibe: Classic, lighter A bit more tannin to go round here. A cuvée produced from the press juice of all the single vineyard wines. Needs time (or a decent amount of air, protein-rich food) but the potential is pretty self-evident. Aviet doesn't do average. ABV: 14.5%

wine: Lucien Aviet, Trousseau 'Cuvée des Géologues' Nonceau 2019
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau Vibe: Classic, ripe-fruited A riper, more fruit-forward rendition here, but we lose none of that classic Aviet guile and class. A true varietal master. ﻿ABV: 14%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Chenin Blanc from some enviable vines in Montbenault (Anjou), with a couple of half-decent vignerons operating out of the neighbouring plots... Olivier Lejeune is at the helm of Clos des Plantes, and is working wonders. Veering toward the tropical, exotic end of the Chenin spectrum here. Fruit power and complexity is all kept in check by soaring acidity. A banger. ABV: 12.3%

wine: Domaine Catherine et Pierre Breton, Bourgueil 'Trinch' 2024
notes: Place: Loire, France Grape: Cabernet Franc Vibe: Natural, lighter Hits the spot! Equal parts classically structured Bourgueil and chillable smasher. Young vine Cabernet Franc doing the thing here. So much energy, it's like it's coiled up, with the focus on fruit shining through. Ready, set, go. ABV: 12.5%

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Chassagne Montrachet 'Cuvée Margot' 2022
notes: Place: Burgundy , France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural Ok here we go! This is why I do this. A fair bit of immediacy on the cards here, a younger drinking Chardonnay for those who, like me, can't wait. Impressive drive keeping some real muscularity in check. The persistence is off the charts. Marc Colin, take a bow. ABV: 13%

wine: Domaine Marc Colin, Saint Aubin 1er Cru 'En Montceau' 2022
notes: Place: Burgundy , France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural Ahhhh! Marc Colin. Real Burgundy hitting its straps now. A wine of insane depth and textural beauty. It's fleshed out in bottle, but still retains that crystalline acidity that this domaine is so well known for. Beauty! ﻿ABV: 13.5%

wine: AMI, Bourgogne Blanc 'La Tête dans Les Nuages' 2022
notes: Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic, textural A Chardy blend, some fruit from near Puligny and the rest from estate vineyards just outside Savigny. All organic. Slow ferment and a year spent in old oak on the lees, but not stirred. A complex zinger that builds with air. Like a proper guzzler of the highest order. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural , textural Varron might ring a bell or two if you know the work of the other Rotalier locals. Personality is never something that's lacking in the wines of Buronfosse, so in that sense, it's business as usual. Business at the front, party in the back. The unmistakable Jura twang, overrun by a riot of orchard fruit. Saline through and through in the most moreish sense. Wow. ABV: 13%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Pineau d’Aunis Vibe: Natural Older vines so a more concentrated rendition of Pineau d’Aunis when sat side by side with Le Regard. A comparative exercise that everyone should be undertaking. Explosive aromatics really lure you in here, there's seduction on show, exotic and alluring. This '22 vintage is a return to the denser, spicier side of the grape that I'm not mad about. '23 is a return to something lither, spicer and more sanguine. ABV: 11%

wine: Agrapart & Fils, Champagne Grand Cru 'Complantée' Extra Brut NV
notes: Place: Champagne , France Grape: Chardonnay + Pinot Noir + Pinot Meunier + Pinot Blanc + Arbane + Pinot Meslier Vibe: Classic A field blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, Pinot Blanc, Arbane and Petit Meslier. Not too common! Especially at this elevated level. Things at Agrapart have and will continue to be terroir focused. Exhibit A. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Victoria, Australia Grape: Pinot Noir Style: Mineral, textural All fruit is hand destemmed, cold soaked to get some colour out and then left for 14 days to ferment, before heading to stainless steel for a rest. No oak, ever. Nada. Sits in tank, nothing added or removed, none of the usual tricks or racking. Just left to rest. The resulting wine is pretty bloody good. A mix of mineral drive, restrained fruit and purity of texture. One to savour. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Victoria, Australia Grape: Riesling + Chardonnay Style: Punchy yet ethereal White blend, 48hrs on the skins, letting the grapes do their thing is the method here. 8 months in tank with full solids, nothing added or removed, then hand-bottled before 18 months resting in bottle. Magic. 9% abv. Mostly Chardonnay and Riesling here, there's no lack of presence or fruit power but it's a thing of ethereal nature. A bit reductive, so let the thing breathe. ﻿ABV: 9%

Place: Victoria, Australia Grape: Schioppettino + Syrah Style: Natural, lively Schioppettino and Syrah. The Schioppettino is done blanc de noir, bled straight off with no extraction, and the Syrah sees only a short maceration, like a pink wine. Proper light red, but in no way lacking in complexity or intensity. Straight to the fridge and then straight down your gullet. ENERGY! ABV: 12%

Place: Western Cape, South Africa Grape: Grenache Noir Style: Classic, fragrant 1/3 whole bunches, followed by 16 months resting in older oak. Your days of juicy, high alcohol Grenache may be numbered. Subtlety is high on the agenda here. Perfumed aromatics, a dash of peppery spice and delicate, red-berried fruit. Unreal. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Western Cape, South Africa Grape: Grenache Blanc Style: Classic, textural A kiss of skin contact here, aiding the texture. Herbal spice comes through, adding intrigue to what is a citrus-laden, refreshing drink. It's tight, moreish and crowd-pleasing. Can't miss. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Cabernet Franc Vibe: Natural, richer Go deep and dark here. Ruben is a richer iteration of Cabernet Franc, but definitely not lacking the usual chiselled features. This is all blackcurrant, violet and pencil shavings. Exactly what you want. Fragrant on the nose and effortless in the mouth. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

wine: Az. Ag. Ciù Ciù, 'Arbinus' Verdicchio dei Castelli di Jesi 2025
notes: Place: Marche, Italy Grape: Verdicchio Vibe: Natural, textural As with all things Ciù Ciù, here's a wine that's not short of personality and crowd pleasing drinkability. Representative of all that's good in Italian white wine making. Ample floral and honeyed notes coupled with just enough fruit and just enough nutty, savoury backbone. A long lunch wine. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Rioja, Spain Grape: Tempranillo Vibe: Natural Safe as houses. 100% Dry, 100% Tempranillo, 100% easy as. Much to like here, it's stupidly good value. Pink wine with as much freshness as there is flavour, of which there is much. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

wine: Pierre et Catherine Breton, 'La Dilettante' Vouvray Brut NV
notes: Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Classic Impressive gear that drinks far above its station, it'd give many a more easterly French sparkling producer a run for their money. Electric and full of character. Flesh up front, and a spice that builds and builds throughout. Completely dry, as the bottle will be too. ABV: 12.5%

wine: Jean-Paul et Charly Thévenet, Morgon 'Vieilles Vignes' 2022
notes: Place: Beaujolais, France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Classic, lighter My first experience of this wine was drinking a 9 year old 2005, mind blown. Got it from Antic in Lyon, probably the best wine shop I've set foot in. It's been too long. Blockbuster, and built to last. I'd be putting this down for a short nap while tucking into some of the younger vine Morgon, but each to their own. Collector's item. ABV: 13%

Place: Beaujolais, France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Classic, lighter Thévenet! My dear Thévenet. I've always loved these wines, so it makes sense to sell them :) These are always on the more powerfully structured end of the Morgon spectrum, with the 'Tradition' cuvée allowing for earlier drinking pleasure. ABV: 13%

Place: Saint Gilles, France Grape: Grenache Blanc Vibe: Easy Grenache Blanc, easy as. This is the ultimate crowd-pleasing, beginners skin contact wine. A bit of grip, but not too much. Nice and floral, but not too pungent. Just good, clean fun that won't scare anyone but also has more than enough going on. ABV: 12.2%

Place: Colchagua Valley, Chile Grape: Semillon + Moscatel Vibe: Natural, crisp Do you like aromatic whites that are also dry and ultra refreshing? You've come to the right place. Semillon does the work here to temper that flamboyant beast that is Moscatel. Very easy to get along with. ABV: 13%

Place: Marsala, Sicily Grape: Grillo Vibe: Classic, saline Grillo, younger vines, bottled for freshness. Oath. di Bartoli is THE name in Marsala. Six months on fine lees has lent some texture, but otherwise this is all about zip and salty moreishness. It demands seafood or savoury snacks. This is a good demand. Give in to the demand. ﻿ABV: 11.5%

Place: Canary Islands, Spain Grape: Vijariego Vibe: Classic, textural This variety is nicknamed Diego. Way easier, so we'll stick with that. There's bugger all Diego produced, anywhere, so count yourselves as the 1% here. Acidity is dialled right up here – we can expect a long and pleasant life. It's dominated by florals at the moment, which is no bad thing, but I expect this to flesh out over the next few years in bottle. A wine of incredible depth. ﻿ABV: 11.5%

Place: Canary Islands, Spain Grape: Marmajuelo Vibe: Classic, textural My mind sees Marmalade, my mouth sees an endlessly pleasurable experience. New booze from Gran Canaria. Marmajuelo is another of those Canarian native varieties that has little difficulty translating volcanic soils and good sunshine into expressive yet taut, mineral driven beauties. The inaugural release of this wine from 2020 was amazing, and this is even better. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Piedmont, Italy Grape: Nebbiolo Vibe: Classic, richer Tradition to the core, purity of expression above all else. What they achieve at Petterino is a testament to their hard graft and patience. You should all be most thankful. Alpine Nebb at its fragrant best here. Stoked to encounter these. ﻿ABV: 13.5%

Place: Piedmont, Italy Grape: Nebbiolo Vibe: Classic, richer Fruit from within some of the best Cru sites of Gattinara. A painstaking approach to farming and winemaking, with wines held back until they are ready to go. Wondrous. Give it some air, then sit back and marvel. Runs the full Nebb journey, and then some. ﻿ABV: 13%

wine: Clos des Plantes, Whaka Piripiri Mai 2024
notes: Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Fruit from around Montbenault in the Anjou. You don't get much better site wise for Chenin Blanc. I was very keen to get this in, having drunk my weight in Poïèsis (Lejeune's other Chenin bottling) in recent times. A tad fresher here, still tropical, but with that scintillating acid line that's something of a producer speciality. All in steel for purity. Insanely good drinking, cannot wait to sink my teeth into another bottle. ABV: 13%

wine: Hors Champ, Le Rouge et Le Blanc 2024
notes: Place: Rhône, France Grape: Muscat Blanc à Petit Grains + Grenache Vibe: Natural, lighter Half n half Muscat Blanc à Petit Grains (the good type) and Grenache. I've called it a light red but you can call it a rosé, you can actually call it whatever you like. Totally fine. What isn't in dispute is what happens in your mouth. Pulsing acidity, freshly crushed red cherries, a touch of garrigue. Excellent drinking. ABV: 13%

wine: Nights At The Larger Table #2 - Tuesday 8th March
notes: The most fun you'll ever have on a Tuesday in March. Wanna come to the Jura? Here's the ticket. Turns out I can't stop buying the stuff, which probably tells you something. So come on a journey of discovery. Bring an open mind and an appetite for cheese. Tuesday 9th March, 6:30-9pm

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural, crisp Chitry is just outside Chablis. Half-decent Chardonnay territory. So you get the gist of what's gonna happen here. A bit more broadness, good foil as the acid is off the charts. If you like them crisp, and then a bit gentler as things heat up, then you're onto one here. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Burgundy, France Grape: Aligoté Vibe: Natural, textural Aligoté gets the de Moor treatment. I'd kind of like the de Moor treatment if all the results are this good. Pretty rare to get this much complexity into this much Aligoté but that's the magic of a top producer. Drinks like a fleshier Petit Chablis. To get their desired results this bottling is a blend of three quarters '23 and the rest '22. Results achieved. ABV: 12%

wine: Gaël Petit, Tavel 'La Combe des Rieu' 2023
notes: Place: Rhône, France Grape: Grenache Noir + Grenache Blanc + Grenache Gris + Cinsault + Carignan + Clairette Blanche + Clairette Rosée Style: Classic, lighter Ooft! Tavel! Who would have thought! This is incredibly good. Spice-driven, fragrant and fresh with dashing tannic pull rounding things out. Ros é, but not as you know it. Don't drink it too cold, more like chilled red territory here. ABV: 14.5%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Chenin, Cabernet Franc, Grolleau, Pineau d’Aunis Vibe: Natural, lighter Blouge from the brain of Bobinet. Music to my ears. Light, fruity and juicy. A hint of pepper and a little pleasing grip give this a crunchy cranberry vibe that I'm very much here for. ABV: 11% *Please note the wine comes with a variety of different coloured labels and so might appear different to the one pictured.

Place: Montsant, Spain Grape: Carignan + Syrah Vibe: Natural, lighter Carignan joining forces with Syrah here. Classic bedfellows? They should be, based on this evidence. Supremely Mediterranean, it really takes you there. Garrigue, dark fruits and lashings of spice. This is moreish as hell, and as with all these d'Anguera wines, freshness is now high on the agenda. Top drinking, cold nights beckon, BBQ beckons too. ﻿ABV: 14.5%

Place: Western Cape, South Africa Grape: Syrah Vibe: Natural , richer This is particularly delicious. As the name suggests, fruit from older vine Syrah planted on mountainous sandstone-based vineyards. This gives us naturally restricted yields and all the potential complexity that comes with that. 50% whole bunches. Lots to unpack here, but it does the work for you. Floral and peppery, leading into darker fruits and some meatiness. Textbook. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural , textural Multidimensional booze, they really do know what they're doing over at Buronfosse. Massale selection in the 1940’s with the three different strains of Savagnin. You could view this as a kind of Vin Jaune-Lite, with spritely acidity carving up some pretty rich texture and lightly oxidative notes. Wondrous drinking as per. ABV: 13%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Auxerrois (+ apples) Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends Piquette-ish. Wine, water and cider come together to create something far more than the sum of its parts. Low on alcohol, high on drinkability and interest. This is firmly sat in the splash around with abandon camp. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Pfalz, Germany Grape: Pinot Noir Vibe: Classic, lighter Under normal circumstances I'd say stick to Riesling, but I was pleasantly surprised here. German Pinot used to be pretty sinister, over-oaked and underripe. This is neither of those things. It's plush, refreshing and incredibly balanced. What's more, it improves and develops over a couple of days once opened, a sure sign of class. Very, very good value here. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Castilla y León, Spain Grape: Mencía + Alicante Bouchet Vibe: Classic, textural Old vine Mencia with a dash of Alicante Bouchet. No oak, all pure fruit. Another ripping example of the good things happening in Bierzo atm. There's intensity here, but also plenty of guile and savoury complexity. This is a steal. ABV: 13%

wine: Nights At The Round Table // 2nd December
notes: Pizza and Wine, a tale as old as time itself. Join me for an intimate evening of pepperoni fuelled wine tasting. Wine by Me. Pizza by Yard Sale Pizza. Flavours TBC 6 spots are available, £50 a head, bring both a thirst and an appetite . Thursday 2nd December // 7-9pm // Newington Green

Place: Champagne , France Grape: Chardonnay + Pinot Noir Vibe: Classic 90% Chardy, 10% Pinot Noir. Fruit from 7 villages, including the GC Avize and Cramant. Classic Agrapart. Bright and driving, with some extra plumpness from the addition of Pinot. A generous intro to the house style. So much to like here... lemon, oyster, brioche, cream. All the yummy things. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

wine: Lucien Aviet, Trousseau 'Cuvée des Géologues' Ruzard Rosière 2021
notes: Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau Vibe: Classic, balanced The Aviets know a thing or two about Trousseau, it would seem. Fruit here off two sites: Ruzard, which is higher up and is naturally leaner and more angular, and Rosière, where the juice is fuller and more structured. Makes sense to combine the two, balance and all! Plump yet ultra refreshing, a tannin structure to die for massaging some pretty, bright crantastic fruit. ABV: 13.5%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Riesling Vibe: Natural, textural I've had this a few times now, over several vintages, and it is really something. The Grand Cru term in Alsace can be a bit of a misnomer, not always indicating upper echelon quality – that's not the case here. Long, slow fermentation of old vine fruit from vines grown on particularly dry soils gives us immense complexity and nerve. This has it all, power, freshness, fruit, florals. What a wine. ABV: 13%

Place: Beaujolais, France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Natural, lighter Plushness and ease of access is the name of the game here. As with all the booze from this esteemed operation, freshness is also high on the agenda. Expect lashings of morello cherry and redcurrant and some wonderful tannins. Unsurprisingly, this is delicious. ﻿ABV: 12%

wine: Joh. Jos. Prüm, Wehlener Sonnenuhr Riesling Auslese 2013
notes: Place: Mosel, Germany Grape: Riesling Vibe: Classic, textural One of the best Riesling producers in the world, one of the best Riesling vineyards in the world, one of the best vintages on record. Easy. Decadent, who doesn't love a bit of decadence. Astounding that a wine of this quality and this age can retail at. A blinder offering. A layered, pulpy, stone fruit rich personality and a wonderful balance between the fruit/acid/mineral things going on. This is Auslese, so expect a decent level of sweetness, but balanced as always. ABV: 7.5%

Place: Montsant, Spain Grape: Garnacha Vibe: Natural, lighter Pure old vine Garnacha off sandy, limestone based soils. Whole bunch fermentation with native yeasts and 15 months spent in oak. This is astoundingly good, like stupid, as in it really should be consumed en masse if you can. Whisper it quietly, Rayas-esque... Medium-bodied, fragrant and fluid, with all that Mediterranean scrub and spice. Salty and moreish. CHRIST. ﻿ABV: 14.5%

Place: Ribeira Sacra, Spain Grape: Bastardo Vibe: Natural, lighter Bastardo.... you may know it as Trousseau. This is the goods. All that ethereal business going on, mellowing out some serious cherry fruit. Fragrance no issue, freshness no issue. One for Burgundy fans, Jura fans, wine fans, good booze fans. ABV: 12%

Place: Loire , France Grape: Cabernet Franc Vibe: Classic , Lighter This is a goodie. Cabernet Franc at its best. Thierry Germain knows a thing or two about producing delicious wine, made abundantly clear here. Blue-fruited, herbal, peppery. It's got that pencil shaving thing going on too. High quality. It's drinking exceptionally well now. Like literally right now, I've a glass on the go as I write this. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Muscat + Pinot Noir + Pinot Gris Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends A devilish Pét-Nat made from Muscat, Pinot Noir and Pinot Gris. Fleshy and crowd-pleasing with absolutely zero austerity on show here. Joyous drinking. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

wine: Pierre et Catherine Breton, Bourgeuil 'Avis de Vin Fort' 2024
notes: Place: Loire, France Grape: Cabernet Franc Vibe: Natural, lighter A somewhat contradictory name, Avis de Vent Fort being an old sailing expression to have a stiff drink before heading out. This is anything but stiff. Ethereal. I loved this when I tasted it, took the bottle home, lasted a hot minute in the fridge too. Ultra fresh and fragrant, with just the right amount of tannin. Brilliant. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Montsant, Spain Grape: Garnacha Vibe: Natural, lighter Organic + biodynamically farmed Garnacha, picked earlier and wild yeast-fermented with only moderate extraction. This is very much in that delicious, modern Spanish Grenache/Garnacha style that's getting so much acclaim. Beautifully structured, delicate and generous all at once. A producer to get into for sure. ABV: 14.5%

wine: Momento Mori, Staring At The Sun 2021
notes: Place: Victoria, Australia Grape: Fiano + Vermentino + Moscato Giallo Style: Aromatic, crisp Fiano, Vermentino and Moscato Giallo join forces in this aromatically splendid, textural beauty. Always a firm favourite with the home crowd, this is a wine that keeps getting better vintage after vintage. Expect broad-reaching tropical flavourings, crisp acid and some powdery grip. Yummy. ABV: 12%

Place: Abruzzo, Italy Grape: Montepulciano Vibe: Natural Full of joyous pomegranate exuberance and rose petal aromatics. This is lithe, moreish and ultra refreshing with a touch of rusticity. The perfect luncheon pink, don't drink it too cold, you want the flavour here. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Chablis, France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural, textural Blistering! The negoce label from Alice and Olivier de Moor is reaching some pretty heady heights. Mineral laden, with some delicate mid-palate richness closing back in to a driving, moreish, saline finish. Go hard whilst you can. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Loire, France Grape: Pineau d'Aunis Vibe: Classic, richer Old vine Pineau d'Aunis, like, seriously old. Whole bunch fermented, then a year (and a bit) in barrel. Lifted and vibrant from a cooler vintage, making this just so easy. Complexity in spades too, nicely spiced with plenty of herbal character. Oh Robinot, you’ve done it again. ABV: 11%

Place: Victoria, Australia Grape: Syrah + Sauvignon Blanc Vibe: Natural, chillable Mostly Syrah, and then a smattering of other things both red and white thrown in for good measure. This places drinkability very much at the fore, with crushing acidity and joyful red fruits pushing things along. Drink chilled in the sun, or whilst chilling in the sun, up to you. ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Western Cape, South Africa Grape: Grenache Vibe: Natural, lighter Light red fans can rejoice, as well as those of you who want chilled reds on hot days. Organic Grenache, short maceration, unoaked. All about fruit purity here and wild floral aromatics. Gluggable, in the most sophisticated sense. ABV: 13.5%

wine: Château Tour des Gendres, Pét Nat 2025
notes: Place: Bergerac, France Grape: Sauvignon Blanc + Chenin Blanc Vibe: P ét Nat + Friends This is Sauvignon Blanc and Chenin, so as you'd expect it's superbly racy and crisp. Orchard and citrus fruit flavoured, a bit creamy, with gentle froth. A far more interesting aperitif! ABV: 11.5%

Place: Bierzo, Spain Grape: Godello Vibe: Natural, textural So this is very, very good. Godello from 100 year old vines. Stone fruit, dried fruit and herbs all combine here with a rich pastry undertone, plus some toasty notes. The finish is all briny salinity. Can u say complex? ABV: 13.5%

Place: Beaujolais , France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Natural, lighter As is the house style, this is lovely and welcoming in its opulence. Equal measures bright and fleshy, this is Morgon for the purist, blue-fruited with driving acid and incredible length. Iconic. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, Driving Impressive. I'll make no secret of my affection for Chenin from Savennières and this just continues my love affair. Driving acid, bitter apple, lusciously concentrated stone fruit and saline bite. ABV: 12%

wine: Agnès et René Mosse, VdF Chenin Blanc 2024
notes: Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Chenin Blanc Vibe: Natural, textural Low yields + long ferments = complexity + yummy. This is an equation I can support. Honeyed and floral, almost quince-like with that rippling Chenin Blanc acid line that we all know and love. ABV: 11%

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Pineau d'Aunis + Cabernet Franc + Grolleau Vibe: Natural Bright in every sense of the word and lusciously fruit driven. Loads of raspberry and red cherry character. Rejuvenating qualities. We've got lashings of Pineau d'Aunis here, with the balance being Grolleau Noir and Cabernet Franc. Ripeness is becoming less and less of an issue in the Loire, so you're getting even more balance and give here. Pretty bloody good as an aperitif, you could have it with food too, maybe something a bit spicy or fatty, but it's so good by itself. Best laid plans and all that.

Place: Loire Valley, France Grape: Cabernet Franc, Grolleau Gris + Gamay Vibe: Natural, lighter Cabernet Franc, Grolleau Gris and Gamay combine in this excruciatingly drinkable Loire red full of peppery spice and strawberry fruit. This is the real thing. Drink chilled to become chilled. ABV: 11.5%

Place: Txakolina, Spain Grape: Hondarrabi Zuri + Gros Manseng Vibe: Classic, crisp These grapes are planted spitting distance from the sea and you can taste it! The sea not the spit... Lightly spritzy, saline, citrusy. Just add seafood. ﻿ABV: 12%

wine: Château Ollieux-Romanis, 'Lo Petit Fantet d’Hippolyte' Blanc 2025
notes: Place: Corbières, France Grape: Grenache Blanc + Grenache Gris + Marsanne + Roussanne Vibe: Natural, textural Intense in every sense! It's sunny in Corbières and you get that in the glass. Ripe fruits veering toward the tropical all cleaned up with some classic garrigue spice and crisp acidity. I really, really rate this. Plenty of minerality and saline stuff going on. Smells like it's gonna be powerfully fruity but it is so tight and moreish. A blend of Roussanne, Grenache Blanc and Marsanne. Fermented with wild yeasts, with no added SO2. ABV: 13%

Place: Galicia, Spain Grape: Mencía Vibe: Natural, easy Seriously, how good is Mencia? Colour, fragrance, presence, freshness... This has BBQ written all over it, or you could just smash the bottle solo, as I have done. ﻿ABV: 12.5%

Place: Istria, Croatia Grape: Malvazija Istarska Vibe: Easy Gold in the glass, gold in the mouth. This has lovely richness coupled with loads of acid and herbal, salty freshness. Crowd pleaser, not too weird. ABV: 13%

Place: Alsace, France Grape: Riesling Vibe: Natural, textural I really, really enjoyed this. Stinks like Alsatian Riesling in the best way with lovely fragrance and evident power. It's got a bit of weight and ripe fruit on the palate with an amazingly fresh acid line cutting it all up. ABV: 12.5%

wine: Agrapart & Fils, Champagne Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru 'Terroirs' NV
notes: Place: Champagne , France Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Classic Stupendous champagne that really makes you sit up and pay attention. Driving acidity, crazy depth. Really vinous in style and demands some food alongside! 'Terroirs' is bottled as Extra Brut, with all fruit coming from the Grand Cru villages of Avize, Oger, Cramant and Oiry. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Molise, Italy Grape: Falanghina Vibe: Easy If ever there was a wine made to convert the masses, this is it! So much drinkability with vibrant fruit flavours, a nice bit of texture and beautiful colour. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Rioja, Spain Grape: Viura + Malvasia Vibe: Classic, crisp Crisp and fragrant, exactly what we want here. If you want a restrained, Sauvignon alternative this is the one! For this price you could do a lot worse. Don't do worse, do better. ABV: 12%

Place: Bandol, France Grape: Grenache + Cinsault + Mourvèdre Vibe: Classic So much depth of flavour here, it really is remarkable. Wild cherry, strawberry, pepper, Mediterranean herb... I could go on all night. The perfect Rosé does exist. ABV: 12.5%
Place: Ribeira Sacra, Spain Grape: Doña Blanca + Godello Vibe: Advanced This is bloody tasty stuff! Bit of grip and pithy texture alongside ample citrus fruit veering toward the tropical.﻿ ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Puglia, Italy Grape: Falanghina Vibe: Easy The perfect beginners orange wine! Electric colour, electric flavour! Fruity, herbal and salty. If you want a skin contact wine with all that visual appeal, that can back it all up with the quality of the contents, then this is a go-er. 5 days on skins has accentuated that lovely blood orange character and given it some pithy texture. ABV: 12%

Place: Puglia, Italy Grape: Bombino Bianco Vibe: Easy Salty, citrus aromatics and flavours, so delicious. A tasty intro into the world of skinsy, natty white wine! Whisper it quietly, I prefer this as a 'wine' to the orange. There's a bit more character, a bit more grip. This has crowd pleaser written all over it. ABV: 11%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Trousseau Vibe: Natural , richer Absolutely banging. This is what Trousseau is all about… drive, nerve, and an underlying core of delicious fruit. ABV: 10.5%

Place: Veneto, Italy Grape: Cabernet Franc Style: Natural, easy Trattoria booze at its finest. Cab Franc, done in cement, with no additions. Pure, unadulterated drinking pleasure. BYO Trattoria. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Rioja, Spain Grape: Tempranillo + Graciano + Garnacha Vibe: Classic, Riper From the stable of Telmo Rodríguez, LZ is an extremely aromatic, floral Rioja with svelte tannins and beautiful balance. Good whack of fruit too. A winner. ABV: 14%

wine: Château Ollieux-Romanis, 'Lo Petit Fantet d’Hippolyte' Rouge 2024
notes: Place: Corbières, France Grape: Carignan + Grenache + Syrah Vibe: Natural, easy Moreish Corbières! This Carignan-dominant blend will be breaking hearts UK wide! Fruity, fresh and fragrant. Bloody good producer this, magnificent value. ABV: 13%
Place: Rhône, France Grape: Syrah Vibe: Natural, richer So so so tasty. Just the right balance of meaty, fruity and savoury with crazy spice and lift. Yep! ﻿ABV: 14.5%

Place: Beaujolais, France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Natural, lighter Magical Beaujolais from Marie Lapierre. Light, crunchy and just damn delicious. This is consistently one of my favourite Beaujolais to smash through, it suits any occasion , is always tasty and has so much general appeal you'll be batting people away with a stick. ﻿ABV: 12%

Place: Abruzzo, Italy Grape: Montepulciano Vibe: Natural, lighter Beautifully bright and fruit-driven natural red. Heaps going on here but retains extreme drinkability. A certain candidate for chilling down prior to splashing it around glasses. Tart red berried fruit and a touch of countryside herbal spice. ABV: 12%

Place: Bierzo, Spain Grape: Mencía + Alicante Bouchet Vibe: Natural, lighter Parajes is a beautiful, Mencia-dominant, regional blend full of pure fruit and minerality. Bottles like this typify all that's good with Spanish wine at the moment. Quality and interest have never been higher, and the prices are dreamy. Fans of well put together, medium bodied reds should be flocking to this. ABV: 13%

Place: Naoussa, Greece Grape: Xinomavro Vibe: Classic, richer Brilliant, delicious wine. The similarities with Nebbiolo are apparent almost immediately, both to the eyes and to the nose. Seductive tannins, ample dried fruit and some of that Mediterranean herbal, spice quality that sends you toward the east. An absolute steal. ABV: 14%

wine: Domaine Marcel Lapierre, Raisins Gaulois Gamay 2025
notes: Place: Beaujolais , France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Natural, lighter Light and crunchy, this is a super fresh and lively Gamay from the famous cellars of Lapierre. Primo picnic wine. ABV: 12%

wine: Viticola Mentridana, 'Las Uvas de la Ira' 2022
notes: Place: Méntrida, Castilla y León, Spain Grape: Grenache Vibe: Classic, lighter Smoky, gorgeous Grenache from one of Spain’s top winemakers! Ethereal qualities. A bit more flesh on the bones and immediate drinking appeal here when compared to La Bruja from Comando G. No bad thing. One of each, compare and contrast. ﻿ABV: 14.5%

Place: Puglia, Italy Grape: Negroamaro Vibe: Natural, lighter Fruity, fresh and extremely smashable. Serve chilled and in the sun for a great time! That bloody Negroamaro again, doing the thing, pleasing the crowds. This whole Nù Litr range should be put in the drawer of every hotel room, move the Bible. It's the stuff of conversion. ABV: 12.5%

Place: Languedoc, France Grape: Syrah + Cabernet Sauvignon + Grenache Vibe: Classic, richer A supple red with delicious red and black fruits, pepper and dried herb character. Nice and full with blackcurrant and cassis coming through strong. ﻿ABV: 13%

wine: Az. Ag. Ciù Ciù, Rosso Piceno 2025
notes: Place: Marche, Italy Grape: Montepulciano, Sangiovese Vibe: Classic, lighter Plush, savoury, fruity and herbal organic red with light peppery spice. Moreish! ABV: 13.5%

Place: Cahors, France Grape: Malbec Vibe: Natural, richer Fresh and fruity modern French Malbec from an outstanding organic producer. Where so much Malbec is basic or over-oaked, this is a wine with actual character. Cahors is on a comeback, largely due to producers like du Cèdre. This is banging. Camille is unoaked Malbec, produced in a young, fresh and modern style from this most traditional of appellations. Dark colour, with fresh acidity and juicy fruit flavours of cassis and black cherry. ABV: 12.1%

Place: South Australia, Australia Grape: Shiraz Vibe: Natural, easy Fresh, fleshy and fruity organic Shiraz from Australia. This has bramble, raspberries and plums on the tongue and finishes off with a little spice. The perfect, easy going BBQ wine does exist! ABV: 14%

Place: Rioja, Spain Grape: Tempranillo Vibe: Natural, lighter Extremely high on the drinkability scale are the wines under the fantastic Gran Cerdo label. They're looking for clean, refreshing expression and that's precisely what we get. Go on.. Classic flavours of dark berries, red florals and light menthol. Unoaked, bright and fresh. ABV: 13%

Place: Rioja, Spain Grape: Tempranillo, Graciano Vibe: Classic, easy Mature, soft and gentle Crianza Rioja from a great organic winery. I wish more Rioja tasted this good! This is pretty classic, with all that smooth leather business going on but instead of just tasting a great whack of gross American oak, you get plenty of fruit for your buck. Very well done. ABV: 14%

wine: Domaine Jean-Claude Lapalu, Beaujolais-Villages Vieilles Vignes 2024
notes: Place: Beaujolais , France Grape: Gamay Vibe: Natural, lighter Pure and succulent expression of Beaujolais, red-fruited and savoury. A brilliant wine. Lapalu is one of the most respected growers in the region, and after one sip of this you'll understand why. ABV: 12%

wine: Joh. Jos. Prüm, Wehlener Sonnenuhr Kabinett Riesling 2019
notes: Place: Mosel, Germany Grape: Riesling Vibe: Classic, textural Maturing Prüm will make grown men cry. Perfect sugar/acid balance. I don’t know what else to say other than drink this. ABV: 9.5%

Place: Jura, France Grape: Savagnin Vibe: Natural , textural Benchmark. Intensely mineral, balancing succulent, at times opulent apple and mango fruit flavours with that saline and moreish twang. The long and peaceful barrel aging has rendered an utterly compelling wine that will reward for many years to come. I' not crying, you're crying. ABV: 12.9%

Place: Mosel, Germany Grape: Riesling Vibe: Classic, Crispy Super crisp, lightly off-dry, smashable Riesling. Perfect for summer or spicy food. ‘Maximin’ is sourced from various vineyards in the Mosel-Saar-Ruwer, and has a charming lightness with notes of citrus and fresh green apple and a lively lifted finish. ABV: 11%

Place: Languedoc, France Grape: Vermentino + Terret Gris Vibe: Classic, crisp Invitingly aromatic with orchard fruits, citrus zest and wild flowers. A great aperitif white! Easy to drink, easy to like, easy to buy... ﻿ABV: 13%

Place: Vinho Verde, Portugal Grape: Loureiro + Alvarinho Vibe: Classic, crisp Super fresh and citrusy with a little bit of added texture and complexity. Salty and delicious. A lot of Vinho Verde is extremely average, just light, colourless and flavourless juice bottled in bulk. There's so much more going on here, it's a proper, food friendly wine whilst holding onto that natural zing. If you liked Chin Chin, you'll prefer this (just hide the label and no one will know). ABV: 12%

wine: Az. Ag. Ciù Ciù, Falerio 'Oris' Bianco 2025
notes: Place: Marche, Italy Grape: Trebbiano, Passerina, Pecorino Vibe: Natural, textural Nutty, floral and fruity all in one. Incredibly moreish organic Italian white. Great with food! ABV: 13%

Place: South Australia, Australia Grape: Chardonnay Vibe: Natural, textural Organic sunshine in a bottle. A fresh and lively Chardonnay with ripe peach and honeydew melon vibes, balanced by a solid acid line. If you want a crowd-pleasing, fruit-forward white then this is the ticket! ABV: 13%

Place: Rioja, Spain Grape: Viura Vibe: Natural, crisp All about the easy going, unadulterated fruit here. Which is what we all really want, right? Mostly Viura, as is the norm for these parts, with a whole bunch of other white varieties blended in. We're talking far greater than the sum of it's parts business. Clean, crisp and enviably refreshing. ABV: 12%

wine: Domaine Guy Allion, Sauvignon de Touraine 2025
notes: Place: Loire , France Grape: Sauvignon Blanc Vibe: Classic, crisp Citrus fruit based, a lean texture and notes of asparagus, elderflower. Racy! Enough of the screwcap snobbery, this one's a winner. ABV: 12%

wine: Château Le Roc, Ambulle VdF Negrette 2024
notes: Place: Fronton, France Grape: Negrette Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends Fruity and delicious! The blend's a bit of a mystery but the end result is bloody tasty! Pure enjoyment on the cards here. It's been described to me as adult Ribena, which probably ticks a lot of boxes. No SO2 used, so it's definitely not for the long haul. Sit back, feet up, glass gone. ABV: 9.5%

wine: Cantina Bernardi, Fior di Cassia Frizzante NV
notes: Place: Veneto, Italy Grape: Glera Vibe: Pét Nat + Friends Fresh orchard fruit and white floral aromas and flavours. A great aperitif style fizz with a cute little price tag. ABV: 10.5%

wine: Grande Provence Angels Tears Sauvignon Blanc 2024

More from Grande Provence

More from Grande Provence

wine: Chateau Filhot Sauternes Grand Cru Classe 2019 (375ml)

wine: Lagarde Proyecto Hermanas Malbec Cabernat Franc 2022

A wine of genuine character for those seeking something beyond the conventional.

The wine's oily texture and pronounced alcohol create an impression of subtle sweetness, while a fiery finish provides compelling length. A powerful, aromatic expression of Syrah that demands attention.

Approachable and engaging now, this wine possesses the backbone to develop gracefully over several years. Decant for an hour before serving alongside roast lamb or other rich meat dishes.

This carefully balanced Malbec demonstrates both elegance and depth, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a refined, fruit-driven red.

Its distinctive profile makes it a refined choice for those seeking a nuanced and characterful white from Gaillac.

Nuances of nutmeg and ginger add a refined spice complexity, enhancing the fruit's depth and balance. This Chardonnay offers a sophisticated expression of California’s diverse terroir.

wine: Buena Vista North Coast Cabernet Sauvignon 2023

This cool climate expression reveals layers of blackberry fruit intertwined with vibrant pepper and sage notes. It skillfully walks the line between ripe richness and fresh green undertones, showcasing nuanced complexity and structure for a discerning palate.

Matetic Corralillo Garnacha 2022 presents a refined floral nose intertwined with sweet brambly fruit and subtle white pepper nuances. Its fresh, nervy profile makes it a compelling expression of terroir and winemaking precision.

Its distinctive saline notes add complexity, showcasing the cold maritime influence that defines this intense and expertly balanced white wine. Its harmonious profile showcases both elegance and varietal authenticity, making it an excellent choice for those seeking refined complexity and traditional style.

Sentito Montepulciano D'Abruzzo 2023 showcases vibrant flavors of cherry, sour cherry, and blackberry, enriched by a distinctive balsamic note on the finish. Expertly crafted, it offers both depth and elegance, making it a refined expression of Montepulciano from the Abruzzo region.

Campagnola Villa Rocca Soave DOC 2024 offers a classic expression of Soave with a light straw hue and subtle greenish reflections. On the palate, this wine balances mineral freshness with savory depth, delivering a refined texture and a long, persistent finish—ideal for those seeking an authentic and nuanced Italian white.
