The Campagnola Valpolicella Classico DOC 2024 greets the eye with a vibrant ruby red hue, characteristic of its classic origin. On the nose, it reveals an elegant bouquet dominated by fresh, ripe cherries and a medley of juicy red fruits. This harmonious aroma profile reflects the wine's lively and approachable character, making it a refined choice for those seeking a traditional Valpolicella experience.

On the palate, it is linear and precise, offering a medium-bodied expression that reflects the cool climate’s distinctive character with elegance and balance.

wine: Masi Tupungato Organic Passo Doble Tierra Soleada 2022

Crafted from organically grown grapes, this wine delivers a soft, fruity character that is both approachable and elegant, making it an excellent choice for those seeking quality with a sustainable touch.

Masi Tupungato Organic Passo Blanco 2024 offers a refined aromatic profile featuring melons, lemons, and jasmine. This fresh, fruity white wine is light to medium-bodied, delivering a gentle and highly approachable palate. Crafted from organically grown grapes, it reflects a commitment to sustainable viticulture while providing a clean, vibrant drinking experience. Ideal for those seeking elegance and freshness in every glass.

With only 1900 bottles produced, this limited edition offers immediate enjoyment or the potential to age gracefully for 10 to 15 years, enhancing its complexity. Best served chilled, it pairs exquisitely with duck liver parfait, dark chocolate fondant, and well-aged blue cheese, making it a refined choice for discerning palates. More from Glenwood Vineyards

This wine reveals a yellow straw hue with rich vanilla and ripe pineapple aromas. The palate is full and creamy, complemented by toasty oak nuances and a marmalade-citrus finish. Expertly suited to complement Thai and Mediterranean cuisine, it is an exceptional match for sushi and fresh seafood. More from Glenwood Vineyards

Friesland M-Klas Cabernet Sauvignon 2022 exemplifies the finest qualities of Stellenbosch terroir, offering a sophisticated blend of dark black fruit and blackcurrant notes. Crafted with precision, this wine honors Marilise’s spirit of class and beauty, promising an exceptional experience now and the potential to evolve gracefully over the next three decades. Ideal for connoisseurs seeking a premium, authentic Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon.

Crafted with precision, it delivers a well-structured and elegant profile, ideal for immediate enjoyment or cellaring over the next three years. A sophisticated expression of family winemaking tradition from this celebrated South African region.

Ideal for immediate enjoyment or cellaring over the next decade, it exemplifies the honest, family-driven winemaking tradition of Stellenbosch.

Ideal for connoisseurs seeking a wine of distinctive character and sensory superiority.

Expertly crafted from the finest grapes, Chateau du Tracy Pouilly Fume 2023 boasts concentrated aromas of citrus and grassy asparagus flavours, perfectly balanced with delicate mineral notes. Savour the refreshing, harmonious taste of this exceptional wine.

On the palate, it offers a balanced and elegant experience, marked by a harmonious blend of spicy flavours and a long, satisfying finish. This Armagnac exemplifies sophistication and depth, ideal for connoisseurs seeking a nuanced and enduring spirit.

Experience the bold flavours of Matetic Corralillo Syrah 2021. Grown on the hills of Cordillera de la Costa in the San Antonio Valley, our Syrah offers notes of sweet spices and black olives. Planted between 1999 and 2004, this wine boasts red and ripe fruit flavours with a succulent texture. A must-try for all Syrah lovers.

wine: Undurraga Terroir Hunter Leyda Sauvignon Blanc 2015

From Undurraga's premium Terroir Hunter range this Sauvignon Blanc is one of the new Chilean style white wines offering up more of an old world style. The nose reveals notes of limes and spices, such as blackcurrant leaves, as well as nuances of green chilli peppers, fennel and gunpowder. The smooth-textured mouth is fresh and well-balanced with a delicate minerality and salinity. Long and vibrant in the finish. Expertly crafted in Stellenbosch, the Boekenhoutskloof Cabernet Sauvignon 2017 offers a complex and enticing aroma of blackberry, mulberry, and cassis. With robust structure and spicy tannins, this medium-plus weight wine finishes with notes of tobacco leaf and spice.

Expertly crafted from old vines planted in 1902, 1936, and 1942, with a dash of muscat d’Alexandrie from 1902, the Boekenhoutskloof Semillon 2017 is a regal and textured wine. Its expressive and generous nature offers refined notes of lemon, lime, stone fruit, and beeswax, making it a sublime choice for any occasion.

Experience the depth and complexity of Boekenhoutskloof Franschhoek Cabernet Sauvignon 2017. Notes of purple violet and rooibos blend with blackberry and cassis to create a silky, smooth taste with a well-balanced finish. Fine tannins add a soft grip to this red, making it a truly attractive choice for any wine enthusiast.

Indulge in Yalumba The Caley 2013, a sophisticated wine boasting notes of menthol, graphite, and plum. With a delicate floral touch and hints of pepper and vanilla, this wine's palate is both savoury and juicy. The fine tannins perfectly balance its immense flavour, making it a must-try for any wine connoisseur.

wine: Abreu Vineyard Rothwell Hyde Estate Red 2015
notes: This dark ruby red wine boasts sweet dark berry fruit, black cherries and cassis flavours with a delicate touch of precious wood spice. The palate is ripe and sweet with firm, complex tannins and nuances of nougat. With a massive yet well-developed style, this T-bone steak wine is perfect for those seeking a powerful and seductive taste.

Vergelegen's 2021 GVB White is a flagship blend of 78% Semillon and 22% Sauvignon Blanc. Tight and focused, this wine boasts herbal and grapefruit notes with a ripe tropical finish. Perfectly paired with fresh seafood, indulge in the long, flavourful aftertaste. More from Vergelegen Estate

Expertly crafted by Hollick, The Bard Sauvignon Blanc 2022 is an aromatic and balanced wine. Hints of pineapple, passionfruit, and flinty lime aromas delight the senses, while the crisp palate and balanced acid and sugar provide a pleasing roundness. Enjoy this exceptional vintage now and experience the finest flavours of this renowned winery.

There are distinct Cabernet tannins, chalky, taut and spicy, and a purity of fruit, but not enough to add flesh to the bones. Christina Pickard" - 88/100 , Wine Enthusiast

Experience the rare and exquisite Warwick Estate White Lady Chardonnay 2022. Sourced from limited availability vineyards, this wine boasts floral and mineral notes, with hints of white nectarine and pear. Silky yet austere, it culminates in a clean and long lemon finish.

Located in Wellington in the Western Cape of South Africa, the Andreas Estate was acquired by U.K wine lovers with the aim to build on the heritage of both the estate and its wine. Since the maiden release of their 2014 vintage, the single wine estate has consistently achieved 4* Platter ratings and 90+ Tim Atkin scores, as well as adding a second Shiraz to double the wine range! wine: Hundred Acre Fortunate Son The Diplomat 2018
notes: As described by wine expert Jayson Woodbridge, this "21st Century Claret" is a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Petite Sirah. With notes of cherry, mulberry, cassis, and blackberry, this wine boasts a soft and plush body, lively backbone, and earthy finish. A truly indulgent experience.

Andreas Wines Syrah, Wellington 2020 features a deep purple red hue, with complex and balanced aromas of leather and smokiness. On the palate, the full-bodied red is filled with flavours of black fruit, dry prunes, and black cherries with a smoky finish. Expect a good mouthfeel with medium tannins and a lingering finish of chocolate.

The Masi Costasera Amarone Classico Riserva 2016 is a rich and intense wine with deep, opaque dark red colour. On the nose, the wine displays enticing aromas of super-ripe fruit, cinnamon, and vanilla. The palate is warm and satisfying, offering flavours of baked fruit, sweet spices, cooked cherries, and cloves. With a dry and long finish, this wine is perfect for those who appreciate a complex and well-balanced flavour profile.

Indulge in the rich and luxurious flavours of Romano dal Forno Valpolicella Superiore 2013. Experience a perfectly balanced blend of black fruit, tar, spice, and smoky undertones that culminate in a full-bodied and opulent wine. With its precise and graceful intensity, this wine is a must-try for any wine connoisseur.

wine: Casanova di Neri Brunello di Montalcino DOCG 2015
notes: Discover the exceptional vintage of 2015 with Casanova di Neri Brunello di Montalcino DOCG. This young and intense red wine boasts a pleasant aroma of dark and exotic fruits, accompanied by subtle hints of spice. The perfectly ripe tannins and balanced finish make it a must-try for any wine connoisseur.

With a bright red colour and expressive bouquet of young red fruit and blackberry, this wine is full-bodied and persistent. Its silky tannins and elegant power make it a must-try, especially if opened 2 hours in advance or decanted gently.

County Line Sonoma Coast Zinfandel 2021 offers an intense bouquet of robust fruit and spice aromas, balanced by herbal complexity and refreshing acidity. Nutmeg-spiced blackberry and sun-warmed strawberry aromas are accompanied by floral Earl Grey tea and earthy briar. Lingering flavours of cacao nib and leather provide an elegant contrast to voluptuous fruit. A perfect pizza pairing and ideal for sipping.

Experience the bold flavours of the 2021 County Line Syrah Sonoma Coast. From its violet hue to its dark bramble fruit aromas, this cool-climate Syrah offers a complex flavour profile of black pepper, wild mushrooms, olives, and cured game. A sip reveals gripping acidity and smooth tannins, making it an excellent accompaniment to dishes like duck confit and mushroom moussaka.

wine: County Line Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2021
notes: The 2021 County Line Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir offers an exquisite balance of sweet red berry compote and earthy herbs. Sensual notes of raspberry, strawberry, rhubarb, sage, and clove on the nose lead to a lush and harmonious palate, rounded out with supple tannins. Serve with a slight chill or at cellar temperature with pork loin or root vegetable tarte Tatin. A truly sublime experience.

A bouquet of red fruits with even hints of vanilla and spice. Subtle aromas of black cherry and cassis transition onto a vibrant, tangy palate and a delightfully spicy aftertaste, all of which is derived from low-yielding, mature vines.

wine: Fonseca Late Bottled Vintage Port 2015 in Gift Box
notes: Fonseca's Late Bottled Vintage Port 2015 in Gift Box is bottled unfiltered for extended aging potential. It features a complex flavour profile of rich black jammy fruits balanced with tannins and acidity. An ideal choice for special occasions.

aromas: Cassis, Blackberry, Cranberry, Black Pepper, Black Olive
notes: The nose is opulent and intense, oozing with rich, ripe dark fruits and plums and subtle whiffs of cloves, cardamon, black pepper and perfume. Brambles, blackberry and liquorice flavours intertwine with hints of raw biltong on the palate, and the fruitcake spiciness of the nose follows through beautifully. The midpalate is velvety and brooding, with juicy cranberry fruit, vibrant acidity and integrated, silky oak tannins creating exceptional balance. Savoury nuances add to the layered complexity of the wine, with accents of black olive tapenade and cassis lingering on a smooth, round finish.

wine: Vilafonte Seriously Old Dirt 2020 Gift Boxed
notes: This luxurious Cabernet Sauvignon lead blend from Vilafonte's Seriously Old Dirt 2020 Gift Box offers a smooth palate entry with fresh plum, black raspberry, mulberry, and ripe strawberry. Subtle spicey notes of nutmeg and sage provide depth and complexity, while a silky texture coats before a broadened mid-palate and long-lasting finish. Enjoy this exceptional South African blend now or age for future appreciation.
Klein Kloof Pinotage 2018 blends smooth berry fruit with hints of banana and herbs to create an impressively balanced, medium-full and spicy palate. Enjoy the richness of this wine each sip!

The Warwick Trilogy shows classic examples of a Bordeaux styled wine grown in South Africa. Perfectly weighted for superb ageing potential, over the past decade we have been storing back vintages and are now pleased to release some of the very limited stock we have remaining. This 6 bottle vertical case includes the highly rated 2010 to 2015 vintages presented in a wooden case. An ideal gift for that special wine lover in your family. The Warwick Estate Trilogy 2017 features a complex blend of cab franc, cab & touch merlot, creating a bold, dark-fruit bouquet with underlying earthy and floral notes. The aging process of 26 months in 50% new oak gives this noteworthy wine a beautiful tannin structure and fine acidity for an excellent aging potential of 10 years or more.

The Warwick Estate Trilogy 2011 is a Cabernet-led Bordeaux-style red blend, made from unique vineyards in the winemaker's home region, the Cape. It is a sophisticated expression, with flavours of cassis fruit, exotic spices, and fine tannins. It has been seriously wooded, with the addition of two years of French barrels, 60% new, offering it a grand future.

Redolent of roses and ripe-for-the-picking strawberries, the refreshing De Toren Délicate is an elegant red blend that combines red’s seductiveness with the undeniable drinkability of white. Medium-bodied and immeasurably gentle, it offers up an abundance of juicy fruit and velvety, smooth tannins that lead to a sophisticated finish. Delicious on its own as an apéritif, it’s also the perfect consort to the lingering pleasures of Spanish tapas or a platter of the finest French charcuterie.

grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Malbec
notes: De Toren Z 2017 is made from 38% Merlot, 25% Cabernet Franc, 19% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Malbec, and 8% Petit Verdot. This complex and intense red blend is aged for 12 months in a combination of 225L French and American Oak. The resulting blend is characterised by aromas of rich cherry and cloves with a touch of garrigue, juicy blackcurrant, and black cherries, alongside ripe, creamy tannins and a striking minerality.

Eikendal Cabernet Sauvignon 2013 is an award-winning premium cabernet with a complex nose full of ripe berries, dark chocolate, spices, and pencil shavings. On the palate, you experience silky tannins, fruity notes, and delicate oak flavours, culminating in a long-lasting aftertaste.

The Dowie Doole Grenache 2021 is made using only old oak barrels, giving this wine an exquisite balance of delicate red fruits, such as strawberry and raspberry, and gentle tannins. Enjoy this crunchy and aromatic experience today.

The Bodegas Luzon Finca Luzon Crianza 2019 is a remarkable wine, combining a deep cherry colour with a garnet rim and aromas of strawberry, cherry, and black plum. Lush and fruit-packed on the palate, it has fresh acidity to balance the full body. An expertly crafted, fresh and fruit-driven red!

Made from Shiraz grapes grown on Koffieklip – rich soils, this wine shows fresh black cherry, plum and chocolate complimented by cedar spice. The palate is soft and juicy with a long velvety finish. More from the Cavalli Estate

The Errazuriz Las Pizarras Pinot Noir 2016 is an expertly crafted, smooth and elegant wine with complex bouquet. The palate offers intense red fruit, floral notes and subtle hints of citrus and sweet spice, all supported by fine tannins and a long, chalky finish. Ideal for special occasions, it expertly balances power and elegance.
Richly concentrated yet elegant in style, this wine is brimming in dense layers of baked plum, mocha and leather. The tannins are sinewy and supportive, with great structure and power. Virginie Boone

With a profile of dark spice, dried herbs and mulberry and blueberry fruits, this Cabernet Franc is a complex and distinctive wine. Aged for 27 months in 65% new barrique, the wine has a powerful structure and a savoury undertone.

wine: Vajo dei Masi Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico 1997 Magnum
notes: A special wine, made to celebrate this important anniversary, and already 'legendary' in several respects, will be presented as part of the celebrations. It is, of course, an Amarone, the wine that is responsible for Masi’s classification as one of the world's great producers and that at the same time Masi’s work has made iconic as one of the world's benchmark wines. Called 'Vajo dei Masi', its grapes come from the eponymous founding vineyard, high up in the hills in the Valpolicella Classica region, on the ridge between Marano and Negrar. The vintage is 1997, one of the best ever in Valpolice

The nose offers up decadent notes of black cherry and mulled dark fruits. The colour is deep and dark, and the palate has an explosion of succulent fruit, blackberries, blueberries and unripened strawberries. Unlike many SA Syrahs, there is little spice present and instead a more refined old world style. A fruit driven style of Sauvignon Blanc which portrays a melange of tropical fruit aromas and a broad palate that has lovely freshness and complexity. Pale straw with green tinges. This wine displays fresh black current, passion fruit, gooseberries and lime on the nose. The palate is layered with complexity and mouth coating texture, whilst still offering a fresh and mineral appeal. The Mont Rochelle Sauvignon Blanc is made up from 2 very distinctive vineyards, one situated in Franschhoek and the other in a cooler climate, Durbanville area. Freshness and layered fruit complexity are the hallma

The Mont Rochelle Chardonnay expresses the true reflection of the Mont Rochelle terroir. This fruit forward Chardonnay is more European in style with an integrated oak component and lovely angular acidity. Pale straw in colour with golden hues and displays white pear, lemon curd and pineapple characteristics on the nose. There are hints of citrus and stone fruit on the palate which is refreshingly long and lingering on the finish.

Classic in style with a lovely tannin structure and nuances of eucalyptus, cassis and blackcurrant. Ruby red with youthful purple hues, this wine displays an array of classic cigar box characteristics that are neatly integrated with layers of black fruits and pencil shavings. The palate is a delicate balance of opulent fruit and acidity with tannins that are well defined and silky in texture.

A vibrant, crisp expression of Stellenbosch Blanc de Blanc MCC. Fresh green apple, white pear and quince dominate the fruit profile, while flavours of biscuit and brioche bring complexity to the palate. More from the Cavalli Estate

This fruit-focused and supple Chenin Blanc shows notes of fresh stone fruit, pear and sweet melon with the floral aroma of peach blossom. The tropical hint of pineapple on the palate is complemented by a delicate spice and vanilla. The wine finishes with a pithy line of citrus and a vibrant, lingering acidity. Oak comes from 6 months in 225L French Oak barrels. More from the Cavalli Estate

aromas: Nectarine, Lime, Pineapple, Mango, Vanilla, Brioche
notes: Notes of lime, orange and nectarine underpin a unique tropical hint of pineapple and mango. The oak is well integrated on the palate, showing as a delicate spice and vanilla, complemented by the tangier taste of lime on the palate. Some buttery brioche adds to the body and mid-palate of the wine, creating a multi-layered taste that is both complex but fresh and enjoyable. More from the Cavalli Estate

aromas: Green Apple, Pear, Quince, White Peach, Peach, Lemon, Melon
notes: Fresh aromas of pear, green apple and white peach are complemented by a floral note of peach blossom. The palate brings flavours of melon, quince and lemon with a delicate yet zippy acidity. The wine is elegant in weight but satisfying in texture and length. More from the Cavalli Estate

Enjoy a glass of Glenwood Vigneron's Selection Chardonnay 2022 for a crisp and flavourful experience. This yellow straw-coloured wine has a subdued nose with vanilla and marmalade notes. On the palate, you can taste citrus peel, butter, and a steely minerality. The lingering aftertaste and lengthy finish make for a refined and memorable experience. More from Glenwood Vineyards

The extended lees-ageing on this wine allows for a restrained fruit profile of passion fruit and pear on the nose. While bright and fresh, the palate is remarkably full, with intense concentration, zest and richness in the finish. This old-world-inspired Sauvignon Blanc can be enjoyed now or up to eight years from vintage. Grapes are sourced from Walker Bay, the only ones in the Stony Brook range not to be grown on the estate. More from Stony Brook

White pepper, violets and warm earth on the nose, with intense dark berry fruit. The palate shows dense, savoury flavours contrasted with bright acidity before the robust finish. There are multiple layers of texture in the wine, with lovely balance between the richness, chunky tannins and lively freshness. This wine has spent 26 months in second and third fill French oak. More from Stony Brook

The nose offers up spice and chocolate. Dark, ripe berry and black pepper. On the palate rich, warm flavours with intense, but rounded mouthfeel and grippy tannins in the finish. Perfect balance in this new-world-meets-old-world Syrah. The ideal partner for hearty, slow-cooked winter meals. Aged for 26 months in French barriques. More from Stony Brook

grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
notes: The 2018 vintage is a Cape Bordeaux-style blend, made up of 44% Cabernet Sauvignon, 33% Merlot, 13% Cabernet Franc and 10% Petit Verdot. The nose offers dark chocolate, ripe cherry, cigar box and caramelised blackberry aromas with a little red pepper, showcasing new-world fruit paired with old-world winemaking techniques. There is rich, concentrated red fruit on the palate, matched with big, well-integrated tannins and a bright, elegant finish and just a hint of oak. More from Stony Brook

The colour is a deep crimson, with lively red pepper, Cape fynbos and dark chocolate on the nose. The immediate brightness on the palate gives way to intense concentration with lengthy tannins and an elegant, dry finish. Just 2,410 individually numbered bottles produced More from Stony Brook

Vibrant, golden yellow in colour with glints of light green. The nose is led by bright lemon and lime, with the perfect amount of oak and butterscotch backing up the natural fruit. The weight of the wine is in great harmony, showing linear acidity and richness in the finish, all the while supported by delicate oak structure. Another classic vintage, this wine will age gracefully for the next 10 years and pairs beautifully with rich, creamy pasta dishes. More from Stony Brook

wine: Stony Brook Ghost Gum Cabernet Sauvignon 2020
notes: Generous amounts of brooding, dark berry fruit give way to secondary aromatics of cedar and cigar box. The palate is surprisingly full and plush, with intense purity of fruit. A Cabernet filled with detail and precision that eases into a sustained finish of bright acidity and savoury tannins. Age for up to 18 years from vintage. Just 5,382 individually numbered bottles produced. More from Stony Brook

This year's Glenwood Sauvignon Blanc is yellow straw in colour, boasting undertones of stone fruit and ripe peach. Its tangy and pithy palate finishes with a crisp acidity, making it a perfect pairing for Thai, Mediterranean, and sushi dishes. Enjoy it with fresh seafood for an unforgettable experience. More from Glenwood Vineyards

wine: Undurraga Terroir Hunter Lo Abarca Sauvigon Blanc 2016
notes: This award-winning Sauvignon Blanc from Undurraga Terroir Hunter is a unique, complex wine that captures its origin close to the Pacific Ocean in its intense, characterful nose. With aromas of citrus, herbs, and earthy minerals, this wine has a great structure on the palate, with an interesting vibrancy and a salty, minerality finish. DWWA Best Chilean SB 2017.

wine: Undurraga Terroir Hunter Lo Abarca Sauvigon Blanc 2015
notes: The Undurraga Terroir Hunter Lo Abarca Sauvignon Blanc 2015 has an intense nose of bell pepper, complemented by sharp and zesty citrus aromas. The palate reveals a lush, pyrazine-packed body with a cutting lime acidity, making this Sauvignon Blanc an ideal pairing for vegetable-forward dishes.

The Katnook Founder's Block Shiraz 2017 is a delicious, full-bodied red wine. It offers a robust blend of menthol, inky aromas, jammy fruit, and a blackcurrant finish. This bold flavour profile provides a unique experience for the palate. Enjoy a glass of this exceptional Shiraz and savour it's deep complexity.

The Geno Branco 2020 is an outstanding wine with its citrus colour and greenish hue. It delivers intense aromas and flavours of tropical fruit, followed by tangerine and crisp citrus on the finish. Enjoy the perfect balance of flavour with this superior quality Italian white.

wine: Prieure des Papes Chateauneuf-du-Pape Vieilles Vignes Rouge 2019
notes: This 2019 Chateauneuf-du-Pape Vieilles Vignes Rouge from Prieure des Papes is a bold expression of the region's terroir. The complex aromas of blackberries, raspberries, ground pepper, and garrigue are balanced by a medium to full-bodied texture, delivering stunning flavour and a long finish. A true representation of the Southern Rhone.

Woodlands Margaret River 'Margaret' Reserve 2017 has a delightful aroma of blackcurrant with a hint of mint. On the palate, it is juicy and succulent, with a pleasant lift from its acidity and a well-integrated burst of oak. Enjoy its classic Margaret River flavour.

Experience the unique flavours of Matetic EQ Coastal Sauvignon Blanc 2021, with its complex and delicate nose exhibiting aromas of citrus and tropical fruits like mango, papaya, and lime zest. On the palate, enjoy the concentrated fruit flavours, crisp minerality, and subtle richness from partial barrel fermentation.

The Bodegas Norton Lo Tengo Torrontes 2021 is a crisp white wine with a bright and pale yellow colour and greenish reflections. Its aromas evoke ripe peaches, apricots, and tropical fruits, with subtle hints of jasmine and rose petals. On the palate, it has a delicate balance of acidity and sweetness, allowing for a long and pleasurable finish.

wine: Angeline Winery Russian River Single Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020
notes: This Angeline Winery Russian River Single Vineyard Pinot Noir 2020 is a rare bargain from one of California's top AVAs for Pinot Noir. This deep-coloured red wine offers aromas of black cherries, raspberry, and Victoria plum, as well as floral and spice notes. It is immensely satisfying and remarkably complex.

Our Angeline Winery Cabernet Sauvignon 2020 is a full-bodied red that features rich notes of blackberry pie, cassis, and clove, with toasted oak, subtle green peppercorn and touches of butterscotch on the finish. Perfect for any occasion, this cabernet sauvignon delivers a striking and rich flavour.

wine: Radise Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG Extra Dry NV
notes: Radise Conegliano Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG Extra Dry NV offers a light and refreshing taste experience. On the palate enjoy a fruity bouquet of apple complemented by a soft, dry flavour. Its delicate body and crisp finish make it an ideal aperitif.

The Momento Grenache Noir 2018 is a red wine crafted for longevity, with its combination of red berries, spice and floral scents, fresh and juicy mid palate, and fine tannin texture. This wine pairs an elegant and pure flavour with a bright acidity that will allow it to gracefully age for years to come.

wine: Vignals La Petite Gargotte Cinsault Rose 2021
notes: Vignals La Petite Gargotte Cinsault Rose 2021 brings a clean, fresh taste with a light body. Its strawberry and raspberry undertones offer a bright flavour profile, while its long finish provides a delightful taste. Enjoy a pleasant, crisp experience and discover the unique flavours of Cinsault Rose.

Vignals Detective Merlot IGP 2019 is a delightful, full-bodied red wine that features a vibrant purple hue. On the nose, savour rich red fruit aromas along with herbal notes. The palate is smooth and balanced, with a lip-smacking finish that lingers on the tongue. Enjoy this delightful Merlot for its juicy, plumy red fruit flavours.

wine: Cantine Matrone Lacryma Christi del Vesuvio Bianco 2017
notes: Cantine Matrone's Lacryma Christi del Vesuvio Bianco 2017 is a pale yellow wine with complex aromas of pear and other tree fruits, balanced with subtle notes of white peach and liquorice. On the palate, it presents strident minerality and a good body, making it a well-structured, food-friendly wine.

The light, bright Villa Dria Cote Sauvage 2018 is a classic Gascon white blend of Colombard and Sauvage Blanc. Boasting tangy acidity and gooseberry flavours, its crisp herbal character defines its quintessential character.

wine: Taylor's Very Very Old Coronation Tawny Port Limited Edition
notes: To mark the Coronation of His Majesty King Charles III on 6th May, 2023, Taylor’s has set aside a very limited amount of Very Very Old Tawny Port to be bottled as a commemorative limited edition. JAMES SUCKLING, 99pts, 21 st April 2023 - This is an over 80-year-old blend with amazing toffee, caramel, tangy orange and light balsamic character. Medium body, very sweet, yet there’s a freshness and lifted state that gives it length and intensity. So long and flavourful. Rum and raisin. Shows real very old tawny character. It’s like you are in the aging cellars with dirt floors and old wooden vats.

wine: Larry Cherubino Ad Hoc Middle of Everywhere Shiraz 2019
notes: This medium-bodied Shiraz from Larry Cherubino is full of bold aromas of red earth, black spice, and dark berries. The palate experiences fine silky tannins and flavours of dark cherry and blueberry with a touch of spice. Enjoy a complex and medium-bodied wine with every sip.

The Petit Vega 28 Meses Reserva 2015 is an expertly crafted red wine. Aromas of cassis, blueberry, and tobacco carry sweet oak, chocolate, and mocha notes. Ageing for seven years brings out the best of its texture, creating a mouth-coating, rich full-bodied flavour. Decant and savour with roast lamb or cellar for future enjoyment.

Experience Akarua The Siren Pinot Noir 2019 with its bright ruby hue, savoury nose and silken tannin. You'll enjoy rich fruit flavours of blackcurrant and mulberry, accompanied by notes of vanilla and star anise. Balanced acidity, Szechuan pepper and fennel seed add a unique warmth and round out the palate for a long, persistent finish. Cellared for 10+ years for maximum flavour.

Experience the full-bodied Akarua Pinot Noir 2021 with its deep ruby colour and ripe raspberry aroma. Notes of black plum, black cherry, wet leaves, charred wood and smoky mushroom give this complex wine its unique flavour. Balanced by chalky tannin and lively minerality, this long-lasting wine will age gracefully for over 10 years.

The Eikendal Classique 2015 is a nuanced and powerful red blend that features full aromas of blue and black fruits, balanced earthiness, and a signature freshness. The balanced tannins and tightly-knit structure offer a long and linear composition that is sure to please any wine enthusiast.

The Eikendal Classique 2018 is a powerful blend of full-bodied aroma and red and black fruits. Its carefully balanced acidity, fine tannins, and subtle oak spice give this wine complexity and depth. Enjoy the signature freshness of Cellar Master Nico Grobler with every sip.

Introducing the Eikendal Charisma 2021, an elegant blend of Rhône Valley Shiraz, Bordeaux Petit Verdot and Italian Sangiovese. This delightful red is expertly crafted for a bold, charming and seductive finish, boasting a fresh structure with aromatic and seasoned undertones. Experience its unique fruity flavours with flair, making it the ideal accompaniment to any dish.

The Eikendal Chardonnay 2020 is full of complexity, with a unique blend of four clones sourced from seven different vineyards. Enjoy notes of orange peel and perfume, with a refreshing yet tight palate, and mineral core for strong acidity.

Showcasing a pure, extraordinary perfume of sweet red fruit; red currant, fresh cranberry and red raspberry. Layers of black and blue fruit unfold; black raspberry, plum & loganberry move to darker undertones of cocoa powder and liquorice. This wine will mature most gracefully, rewarding the patient collector.

The Bodegas y Vinedos Pujanza Norte 2018 is a top-tier Rioja wine aged for 12 months using 225L French oak barrels. It has a black-cherry colour and a complex nose of red-berry fruit, subtle notes of black fruit, and scented blossom. On the palate, it offers a delicate attack with polished tannins and a well-balanced finish. This vintage was voted as a Decanter wine of the year 2022 as well as receiving Tim Atkin's Spanish wine of the year award.

aromas: Blackcurrant, Plum, Dark Chocolate, Mocha, Leather
notes: Casa Montes Don Baltazar Malbec 2017 is a full-bodied Argentinian Malbec featuring flavours of oak, dark chocolate, mocha, dark fruit, plum, and blackcurrant. It also offers notes of leather and a touch of spice for a smooth, balanced finish. Enjoy it with dinner or on its own.

Stonehedge California Chardonnay 2017 is an exquisite mix of citrus, butter cream, minerals and other flavours. Its strong tannins, acidity, and med-body make it an ideal partner for spicy food pairings such as rocket leaves salad or wasabi-infused sushi. Its finish is long and exhilarating.

Andreas Wines Syrah, Wellington 2019 features a deep purple red hue, with complex and balanced aromas of leather and smokiness. On the palate, the full-bodied red is filled with flavours of black fruit, dry prunes, and black cherries with a smoky finish. Expect a good mouthfeel with medium tannins and a lingering finish of chocolate.

Indulge in the decadent Glenwood Grand Duc Noblesse 2017, a scrumptious dessert wine comprised of 50% new oak-aged semillon and sauvignon. Its non-vintage complex flavour profile offers generous layers of kumquat, honey, and fynbos harmoniously balanced. More from Glenwood Vineyards

aromas: White Peach, Peach, Lemon, Grapefruit, Vanilla, Toast
notes: Gibbston Valley China Terrace Chardonnay 2021 is a complex and precise white wine, carefully crafted with whole bunch pressed and handpicked fruit aged in French barriques and puncheons (20% new). Its aromas offer a bouquet of fine, pure white fleshed fruits infused with mineral complexity, while its palate is notably harmonious, featuring flavours of lemon and barley sugar, white peach, grapefruit, and white flowers. Oak spices, vanilla, raw sugar, and toast add balance and depth, finishing long and with a fine nutty quality.

wine: Gibbston Valley School House Pinot Gris 2021
notes: The Gibbston Valley School House Pinot Gris 2021 boasts bright straw gold colour, honeycomb and fig aromatics on the nose, and a lush expansion of ripe fruit on the palate. Rich and decadent, this full, creamy and weighty wine has been handpicked and pressed in full, before 10 months fermentation and aging in puncheons and barriques. Enjoy an elegant and long-lasting finish.

wine: Gibbston Valley China Terrace Pinot Noir 2021
notes: This 2021 Pinot Noir from Gibbston Valley's China Terrace Vineyard is crafted from 4 clones of the varietal, grown on 7 hectares of North-facing slopes. Its complex soil composition of loess, clay and schist offers an intriguing freshness and complexity. Aged 10 months in 20% new French oak following hand picking, this wine reveals spicy red fruits, full structure and savoury charm.

Gibbston Valley Collection Pinot Noir 2019 is produced with hand-picked grapes and carefully blended in multiple fermenters including 10% whole cluster. Its 10-month aging in French oak, of which 15% is new, gives it a consistent full-red colour and aromatics of red fruit, fruit cake, briar and blossom. On the palate, it has a bright, crisp texture defined by red and dark fruits, finished with a mineral edge.

Gibbston Valley Diamond Pinot Noir 2021 offers an elegant red and dark fruit core with balanced complexity, structure and weight from 10 months aging in 20% new French Oak. Grown in the Cromwell Basin of Central Otago, the Torr Vineyard sits 250-340m above sea level, creating the perfect conditions for this distinctive New Zealand red.

Gibbston Valley's Glenlee Pinot Noir 2021 is a carefully crafted vino, crafted from hand-picked fruit, small batch natural ferments, and 10 months of French oak aging, of which 20% is new. Its high density vineyard, planted in 2002, offers free draining soil and optimum conditions for producing a bouquet of fragrant red spice and delicate, elegant flavours. An enjoyable and indulgent wine experience awaits.

wine: Gibbston Valley Gold River Pinot Noir 2021
notes: The Gibbston Valley Gold River Pinot Noir 2021 is a ruby red gem, carefully sourced from six vineyards in Bendigo (55%), Pisa (30%) and Gibbston (15%) for a distinct blend. Aromas of bright red fruit, joined with a subtle earthy complexity, lead to a creamy red fruit palate and a silky-smooth finish, thanks to French oak barrel aging. Expertly crafted and approachable, it delivers quality and distinct regionality.

wine: Gibbston Valley Le Maitre Pinot Noir 2021
notes: Gibbston Valley Le Maitre Pinot Noir 2021 is the perfect match for experienced wine-lovers. Grown in the Home Block at Gibbston, with the oldest vines dating back to 1983 and certified organic, this vibrant red offers concentrated cherry, plum, and spice flavours balanced by acidity and a supple finish. Matured for 10 months in French oak casks (33% new), it’s superbly balanced and elegant.

Gibbston Valley Reserve Pinot Noir 2019 is a highly acclaimed, award-winning wine. It is made from select vineyards, producing low yields for superior quality. This vintage flaunts a deep colour and concentrated flavours of dark fruit. The full-bodied palate is rich and voluptuous, leaving a lasting and powerful impression.

wine: Gibbston Valley School House Pinot Noir 2021
notes: Gibbston Valley School House Pinot Noir 2021 is a complex blend of dark fruits, rose petal, damsel plum and sweet red aromatics, with dense, graphite-like tannins providing a unique finish. This wine is an expression of the unique terroir from the Bendigo region, offering a bold combination of richness and high-altitude energy.

Bladen Gewurztraminer 2021 is a single vineyard, hand-picked wine from the Tilly's family Southern Valleys vineyard. Aromatic and off-dry, it offers distinct turkish delight and ginger character with a splash of acidity. Perfectly complements oriental dishes, such as Thai & Indian cuisine, as well as pâté, smoked fish and blue cheese. View more wines from the Bladen Winery

Our Bladen Sauvignon Blanc 2022 is grown on the nutrient-rich alluvial soils of Conders Bend in the Central Wairau Valley. Crafted using cool stainless steel fermentation and a small 2% wild barrel-ferment, this expression of a Marlborough classic is bursting with bright lemon clarity and a complex yet approachable taste of citrus, succulence and structure. Enjoy now with your favourite picnic fare. View more wines from the Bladen Winery

Our Te Hera Reserve Pinot Noir 2019 is a rarity, with only 125 cases produced. This elegant and nuanced red is aged for 16 months in 30% new French oak barrels. Tasting notes reveal a medium red colour, with black-fruit, dark cherry and berry aromas on the nose and subtle herb, spice and liquorice nuances from the oak. On the palate, there are layers of dark berry, plum and earthy flavours, underpinned by fine tannin and structure. Perfect for any Pinot Noir enthusiast.

Te Hera Estate's Pinot Noir 2020 offers a medium red hue, aromas of dark cherry and berry fruit complemented by smoky oak, and subtle violet and spice hints. It's taste is full and elegant, with layers of flavour in the berry and cherry spectrum, plus savoury complexity and soft tannins that provide a rich mid-palate. Enjoy classic Pinot Noir character at an exceptional value. Aged 11 months in French Oak, 2160 bottles produced.

Medium to deep garnet-purple coloured, the 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon Wraith opens with compelling crème de cassis, wild blueberries, anise, chocolate mint and black earth scents plus suggestions of candied violets, cinnamon stick, tar, cigar box and smoked meats. Full-bodied, rich, super firm and built like a brick house, the palate offers layer upon layer of very tightly wound, subtly nuanced flavours leading to a very long, very perfumed and minerally finish. If any Hundred Acre wine can live for 100 years, this is certainly a contender. Lisa Perrotti-Brown. Drink 2022-2080.

The utterly perfect 2014 Scarecrow Cabernet Sauvignon (1,500 cases) has everything one could possibly want in a Cabernet. Inky purple-coloured to the rim, with a glorious nose of white flowers, crème de cassis, hints of blackberry and boysenberry, some liquorice and forest floor are followed by an enormously concentrated wine with fabulous purity, a skyscraper-like mid-palate and texture, a length of nearly a minute, and stunning flavours, with flawless integration of acidity, tannin, wood and alcohol. This is a great, great wine and certainly one of the Cabernet Sauvignons of this vintage. Dr

Stellenbosch Bordeaux style blend. Dark, intense ruby colour while the nose shows complex smokey and savoury notes, both dark and red fruits, vanilla, dark chocolate and liquorice. Aged for 24 months in selected French oak, the palate is bold and round with a grippy yet elegant tannin and showcasing plums, mulberries and blueberries as the primary fruits. More from the Cavalli Estate

A smoky, savoury nose with generous notes of vanilla, honey and ripe fruits. The palate is smooth with an interesting linearity laced with a creaminess from the peaches, guavas and honeysuckle. Aged for 12 months in selected French oak. A blend of Chenin, Chardonnay, Verdelho & Viognier. More from the Cavalli Estate

Notes of dark chocolate, fruit compote and black forest cake are followed by plum, cedar and vanilla on the palate. The wine is showing a fresh, elegant mid-palate with a robust tannin and elegant finish. More from the Cavalli Estate

wine: Dieu Donne The Cross Collection Shiraz Viognier 2016
notes: Sleek, supple and seductive 2016 vintage offers captivating interplay of soft plum, inky blue and black berries with a fine dry tannin structure from 22 months in new French oak. Lovely integration and length with an exotic note from the 2% viognier. More form Dieu Donne

wine: Dieu Donne The Cross Collection Merlot Cabernet 2016
notes: Only the best barrels selected for this range. Rewarding and complex 2016 has Cabernet Sauvignon (14%) supporting Merlot in a poised fresh and restrained blend, rounded from 24 months in all-new French oak. Rich, deep and long. More form Dieu Donne
Massive fruit punch on nose. Black plum fruit, tobacco & spice leading to some depth of sweet fruit, though dry. Well structured with earthy undertones. More form Dieu Donne

Pleasing berry character on 2019 vintage supported by 18 months oak, half new, adding chalky tannic grip to the fruit-derived structure. Blackcurrant and dark moreno cherry with dark inky colouration. Very much fruit driven and supple with a creamy textured finish. More form Dieu Donne

aromas: Blackcurrant, Blackberry, Plum, White Pepper, Vanilla
notes: This medium-bodied red wine has ripe blackberry, blackcurrant, dark cherries and plum, with hints of toffy, vanilla, liquorice, mulled spice and pencil shavings, flavours followed by delicate white pepper nuances on the nose and palate. More from Grande Provence

aromas: Orange Peel, Cinnamon, Dark Chocolate, Tomato Leaf
notes: This Merlot fronts notes of vibrant dark cherries and raspberries with hints of wild herbs, tomato leaf and dark chocolate enlivened by touches of cinnamon, cloves, orange peel and earthy tones. The palate is supported by a supple, smooth tannin structure. More from Grande Provence

There is something to be said about following in the footsteps of ancient Greek and Roman winemakers who embraced this ‘technology’ thousands of years ago, using clay hewn out of the earth to cradle and nurture a living liquid. The journey of The Grande Provence Amphora wine began when the winemaker decided to import two 400L clay amphorae from Manetti Gusmano and Figli from Florence, Italy, with seven generations of experience in crafting their superb vessels. Waterlily Sauvignon Blanc combines the best of both worlds. Durbanville's fresh and vibrant fruit aromatics combined with a textured and succulent mouth-feel that lends itself to be paired with a wide range of dishes. More from Bloemendal

This is an easy-drinking wine which has a rich salmon colour with a slight pink hue. Aromas of strawberry, red cherry and candy floss compliments the nose of the wine. The palate is off-dry with a dominant sweet berry characteristic and a well-rounded acidity. More from Bloemendal
Rich fruity flavours and velvety texture summarizes our Waterlily Merlot. It has aromas of spices and red fruits along with hints of chocolate, black cherry and plum. More from Bloemendal

This wine has a deep ruby red colour with aromas of white pepper, cloves and redberries. Notes of red berries and spice continue through to the palate and are supported by a firm tannin structure. The wine pairs well with grilled meats and vegetables, venison and beef stew. More from Bloemendal

Deep purple colour with concentrated aromas of plum, cigar box, cassis and toffee. Notes of plum and toffee continue through on to the palate and are supported by well-integrated tannins and lengthy finish. The wine pairs well with savoury duck, venison and pork dishes. More from Bloemendal

The revival of a legend, Suider Terras on Bloemendal has near-mythical status as a source of unique and age-worthy Sauvignon Blanc. A vibrant gold hue with green core, the wine explodes with what is now a standard Suider Terras character; fynbos, herbs, chalk, and lime; on taste, this wine is robust and built for serious aging and development; the structure was given preference over perfume for this wine. The 2017 barrel-fermented edition will develop seamlessly with cellaring for up to 10 years. Just 2533 bottles produced. More from Bloemendal

This Méthode Cap Classique has a golden colour with a light green hue, with aromas of fresh limes, citrus blossom, green apples, and lemon zest on the nose. Delicately balanced flavours of citrus, tropical fruit and brioche combines with a yeasty complexity, broadening the palate with layered textures and leading to a long finish. More from Bloemendal

On the nose white peach, cut apple, vanilla essence and some lees complexity, quite particular. The palate is rich and broad but not at all listless with a lovely fruit expression upfront before a long and intensely savoury finish. More from Bloemendal
A supremely weighty, regal example of South African Malbec. The mouthfeel is more velvety than Prince’s tuxedo, and it somehow manages to be supremely ripe, without being flabby. More from Bloemendal

wine: Allee Bleue Black Series Old Vine Pinotage 2019
notes: All the berries are here, strawberry, raspberry, blackberries and plums. Wrapped in a layer of fine dark chocolate and offset with a touch of liquorice. The mouthfeel is soft and silky with just enough tannin. This wine will evolve and mature into something really special over the next 4-7 years. A winemaker’s selection of the three best barrels, new French Oak, matured for 16 months prior to being bottled unfiltered and unfined. This wine will be further enhanced if decanted 30 minutes prior to drinking, but can be cellared for at least 7 to years. More from Allee Bleue

wine: Allee Bleue Black Series Single Vineyard Syrah 2017
notes: A brooding Shiraz with heaps of white pepper spice, ripe plums, violets, cinnamon and a hint of liquorice on the nose. The palate is super elegant and soft with all the flavours pulling through. A winemaker’s selection of the six best barrels, 80% new French Oak, matured for 16 months prior to being bottled unfiltered and unfined. Enjoyment will be further enhanced by decanting 30 minutes prior to drinking, but this wine can be cellared for at least 7 to 10 years. More from Allee Bleue

Delicate flavours of fynbos, cedar and cigar box, all beautifully wrapped in blackberry fruit. The palate is reminiscent of spice, dark chocolate and cinnamon with elegant and soft tannins. This is a unique wine which will intrigue even the best connoisseur. More from Allee Bleue

Star light hue with shades of green. Sweet tropical fruit invites you on the nose. This is followed by intense passion fruit aromas well supported by hints of green pepper and typical herbaceousness. The palate is fresh and lively with loads of summer flavours and a clean, crisp finish. More from Allee Bleue

Intense deep red colour. Powerful bouquet of violets, cinnamon and chocolate followed by ripe cherries. The palate is smooth and silky, packed with berry fruit and spicy nuances. More from Allee Bleue

Juicy extract-sweet fruit nuances, ripe, silky tannins, fine spice nuances in the finish, has an impressive fresh structure, secure future potential.

Medium to deep garnet-purple coloured, the 2013 Cabernet Sauvignon Wraith leaps from the glass with gregarious black and red cherries, mulberries, black currant cordial, red roses and lavender scents with layers of crushed rocks and earthy sparks. Faint earth and exotic spice nuances unfurl slowly, growing in intensity and depth. The palate is full-bodied and solidly structured with firm, very finely grained, super ripe tannins and bold freshness. Red berry fruit, full of spice, white pepper and floral notes. Supple, intense palate with fine tannin matched by plenty of fruit.

Rather deep ruby red colour. The nose displays some oak and wood with dry spices, leather and wild berries. The palate is dense, a bit firm and tannic at this stage but with nice fruit and a long finish. A wine deserving some time to soften and gain harmony.

wine: Giuseppe Campagnola Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOC 2018
notes: Deep garnet red colour. Ethereal, vanilla and spicy bouquet, with hints of black cherry, bitter almond and plum. Full, warm, persistent and velvety taste.

wine: Undurraga Terroir Hunter Lo Abarca Sauvigon Blanc 2014
notes: Bright lemon-green colour, mangetout aromas with fresh limes and grass, bright and vivacious with crunchy green fruit flavours. Citrus finish - wonderfully crisp. Pungent and green up front, with a shot of cool-coast pyrazines on the nose, this hits the palate with a lemony blast of citric acid. Flavours of orange and nettle are a touch briny, while a juicy, acidic, peppery finish is racy to the max.

The dark colours of the 2020 Red Horizon Shiraz speak to the rich, abundant flavours that define it. An aromatic wine that shows an abundance of black pepper and violets leading to complex layers of plum and black cherries and balanced with careful use of oak. These dark fruit flavours are framed by firm tannins which promise excellent maturation potential. More from Constantia Uitsig

notes: Lote Negro is a blend of 60% malbec from Los Chacayes and 40% cabernet franc from Altamira, all fermented in concrete and then aged in used oak barrels for about 14 months. This is a reflection of the season, and the sensation of a cooler year results in red fruits, herbs, and a tension of acidity and tannins. A wine full of fruit. It's juicy, intense, and powerful, but it also lets that delicious fruit shine. This is one to leave in the cellar for a few years, or open it now, decant it patiently, and serve it with lamb.

wine: Jim Barry The Mcrae Wood Shiraz 2013

The wine matured for 12 months in small, third-fill French oak barrels. Medium-bodied wine with layers of mint, chocolate, plum and mulberry. Full and elegant, with a long conclusion. Pairs well with lamb shank or Cape Malay dishes. More from Glenwood Vineyards

Dark garnet in colour. Smoky vanilla nose with some dark berries. Very elegant on the palate with smoky and toasty notes following from the nose. Dark fruit and jam on the finish with a soft mouthfeel. Elegant now, but will improve with age. Pairs well with the perfectly matured rump or sirloin. Sublime with anything sweet. Only 1200 bottles produced. More from Glenwood Vineyards

The Leeuwenkuil Heritage Syrah 2015 is brimming with the concentration of a great vintage. While emphatically world-class, this complex and layered wine is quintessentially Swartland. Shy to start, the nose continues to evolve and invite with florals and white pepper. It oscillates between red and black fruit with a lifted fynbos freshness. The palate shows the same complexity. The ripe fruit is laced with meaty flavours and wonderfully coated tannins. A clear line of acidity keeps the wine focused and fresh and contributes to its long, lingering finish. It is a wine of startling power and ele

grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
notes: From Robert Parker’s Wine Advocate – “ Probably one of my favourite vineyards in all of Napa Valley, even though it is not entitled to any particular AVA designation, is the steep hillside vineyard behind the luxury resort of Meadowood in St. Helena called Thorevilos. It is co-owned by David Abreu and Ric Forman. I have now tasted 16 vintages of this wine, and six and possibly seven (the 2015) have merited perfect scores, which is just mind-boggling even to someone who has been doing this for 38+ years. This wine contains a considerable quantity of Cabernet Franc (probably 30% or more, althoug

David Abreu produces remarkably profound single-vineyard wines in minute quantities. The 2014 Madrona Ranch is a compelling wine with startling aromatic intensity and complexity. On the nose it is saturated with black fruits, vanilla, exotic spice and cedar. The palate is full-bodied and fruit-drenched but perfectly supported by fine-grained and deliciously ripe tannins.

aromas: Cassis, Blackberry, Violet, Vanilla, Cedar, Bacon
notes: ‎Deep dark ruby garnet, violet reflections, subtle edge lightening. Intense precious wood spice, hints of cedar, vanilla and caramel, ripe blackberry cassis notes, distinct roasted aromas. Stuffy, extract-sweet texture, spreads on the palate, has a fine acid structure, the tannins are perfectly integrated, stick for a very long time, ripe berry fruit in the aftertaste, mineral touch in the finish, still shows clear baby bacon, very seductive‎ .

wine: Topiary MCC Blanc de Blancs NV
notes: 100% Chardonnay from the farm. Blend of 2014 and 2015 vintage. Apple pie and prune with a bit of richness from the lees, with a fine lime undertone and a long clean finish. Fine bubbles and classy.

Deep, purple red. Rich black fruit - most obviously blackberry, black cherries and plum notes. Voluptuous, full, big and luscious, with hints of pepper, Oriental spice and a touch of smokiness. Aromatic, medium to full bodied and powerful, with good extraction of the sweet flavours of black ripe fruits. Elegant with good texture and firm tannins, giving wine great ageing potential. A touch of mint, with lavender notes. Firm, well balanced oak and long finish with fresh, spicy, integrated mouthfeel.

Experience the exceptional 2017 Noble Late Harvest from Buitenverwachting 1769 Muscat. Skin fermented and aged in older barrels for 10 months, this muscat de Frontignan boasts floral aromas and a tangy acidity, perfectly balanced by 243 g/l of sweetness. Savour the rich flavours of ripe apricot, melon, fynbos, almond and apple like characters.

wine: Chateau Capion AOP Terrasses Du Larzac Rouge 2016
notes: Deep purple colour with violet reflection, expressive nose dominated by forest fruits. On the palate, a real fruit-burst is followed by prolonged notes of spice, finishing with elegant tannins. Perfect with grilled meat, or pork loin served with seasonal vegetables, this wine powerfully expresses the complexity of the Terrasses du Larzac terroir.

This starts off surprisingly light in intensity on the nose, with faint hints of freshly dried straw, fresh apple slices and a touch of orange rind. The palate starts off with more of the same and is light upon entry, but then unveils a rounder midpalate and a creamy mouthfeel around flavours of creamed pear and baked apple that carry through to the close. Lauren Buzzeo

The red shows a deep ruby colour with garnet highlights on the rim. The generous bouquet suggests blackcurrant, cedar with scents reminiscent of red berries, spices and vanilla. The wine is amply structured; full, round and smooth on the palate with rich fruit and length of flavour. An elegant wine that will mature with time in the bottle.
This Tawny Port reveals notes of ripe citrus fruits, including oranges and lemons, along with a hint of ginger. Its aftertaste is smooth and subtly sweet.

Very aromatic, with bitter cocoa, English cake and slight mass on the nose, still with nougat and coffee. Taste with precision, sweet medium, notes of jam and chocolate with mint to contribute to the freshness of the set. It ends long.‎

‎It shows a much lighter and less concentrated profile than usual in tawnies of this age, here based mainly on delicacy and elegance, unfolding in nuances of ginger, nougat, spices. A different 30 years, sophisticated, with a lot of class and fineness.‎

Pungent, full, aromatic nose. Luscious, ripe, black cherry and plum fruit with notes of cedar and spice. The wine is wonderfully rich, rounded, concentrated, with layers of fruit and attractive notes of cedar. An elegant wine with good complexity. Lovely, intense finish full of flavour.

From the Cabernet Franc, notes of black liquorice, white flowers, and campfire intermingle with the chorus of aromas and flavours that we love from Cabernet Sauvignon: blackberry and cassis, dark chocolate and savoury herbs. The signature textural power and subtle aromatic nuance of eastern Oakville is in full force, bringing notes of burning embers, crushed stones, and sagebrush.

This is a beautiful, luscious wine. It has all the characteristics of a fine Vintage from this producer, with richness and opulence masking powerful tannins. Here, though, is a Port that will also develop relatively quickly. It is likely to be ready from 2027.

wine: Fonseca Unfiltered Late Bottled Vintage Port 2009
notes: The Fonseca Unfiltered Late Bottled Vintage Port 2009 is a premium port wine crafted with high quality black currant flavours. Aromatic and fresh, it develops ripe tannins with a full-bodied flavour, making it ideal for both immediate enjoyment and future aging. Enjoy this unfiltered late-bottled vintage port year-round.

Intense Fruit, Powerful, full-bodied Barolo. Full, rich with berries and floral notes as well as aromas of liquorice, dried herbs and spices. Solid structure and a rich softness as well as a lingering finish. Barolo Dagromis Gaja vintage 2015 The "Dagromis" wine of Gaja winery is a famous Barolo, made from 100% Nebbiolo grapes, grown in the vineyards of La Morra. The wine is aged for 12 months in barriques and other 12 months in traditional oak barrels. It is named after the Gromis family, from which Gaja acquired the vineyards in 1995. Dragomis has a red garnet colour, tending to orange nuanc

This wine is aged for 11 months in specially selected French oak barrels to showcase the vintage characteristics of red berries, forest floor and cigar box, which are supported by well-rounded tannins. Enjoy red berries, forest floor and cigar box on the nose, supported by well-rounded tannins.

The 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Ark Vineyard possesses a deep, profound bouquet of blue-black fruit, cassis, dried violets, Korean spices, dark roasted coffee, and a hint of well-worn leather. Complex, full-bodied, and supremely textured, it keeps coming back with loads of fruit and opulence Hundred Acre Ark Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon yet stays perfectly balanced, has silky tannins, smooth edges and a royal, singular personality.

The 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon Kayli Morgan Vineyard gives up clean distinct aromas of cedar pencil, cassis, black currant, African violets, espresso, and maduro tobacco, it rolls over your tongue with a deeply sensual, seamless texture backed micro-fine tannins, remarkable purity of fruit, subtle oak and a long building finish.

Made in a savoury, age worthy style, the 2013 Covenant features aromas of tar, espresso and black olive. It adds intriguing red-berry notes on the full-bodied palate, along with dusty tannins that persist through the long finish.
Vibrant intent fruit with a mix of plum, juicy berry with ripe tannins and good length.

A blend of Corvina and Malbec, Masi's Corbec is a wine which expresses Venetian style and Argentinian soul. This wine was made using Masi's specialist appassimento method, where the grapes are dried for 20 days before fermentation. The resulting wine is jam packed with brooding dark berry fruit and notes of sweet spice.

The youthful, fresh and vibrant first range from Viña Undurraga. Hugely appealing to all palates. The ‘U’ by Undurraga wines capture the personality and characteristics of Viña Undurraga. Produced in Chile’s Central Valley, the soils are alluvial in origin, medium textured, loamy to sandy-loam and well drained. The climate is sub-humid Mediterranean. Winters are mild and Summers are temperate and dry with cool nights. This ensures the production of healthy grapes with a delicate texture and accentuated aroma.

Massive Double Magnum format, very limited quantities produced and an outstanding way to imbibe this stunning wine. Deep garnet coloured, the 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon Ark Vineyard comes charging out of the gate with amazingly intense roses and lilacs scents over an impressively primary core of blackberries, crushed black currants and black cherries with tantalizing layers of chocolate box, smoked meats and Chinese five spice plus a waft of fragrant earth. The palate is full-bodied, super concentrated and built like a brick house, delivering very firm, grainy tannins with just enough freshness,

wine: Hundred Acre Ark Vineyard Deep Time 2013
notes: Robert Parker's Wine Advocate 100/100 The 2013 Cabernet Sauvignon Kayli Morgan Vineyard Deep Time spent an incredible 60 months in barrel. Medium to deep garnet coloured, it bursts from the glass with exuberant notions of Black Forest cake, liquorice and espresso over a core of crème de cassis, blackberry pie, raspberry preserves and stewed plums with fragrant accents of red roses, black truffles and tilled earth. The full-bodied palate is powerfully fruited with a veritable layer cake of black and red fruits streaked with liquorice and mocha, framed by super ripe, wonderfully plush tannins an

The nose is complex, showing blackcurrants, cedar wood, lead pencil and cigar box aromas. These develop in the glass and are joined by raspberry, black cherry, spice and a hint of gaminess. On the palate the wine is concentrated but elegant, with fine-grained tannins. These tannins soften even further in the glass, resulting in a luxurious wine with a long aftertaste.

The touch of red muscat gives the wine a beautiful amber colour. The nose shows an abundance of ripe and dried fruit, like crushed pineapple, apricot and raisins. The ageing in barrels adds some wood spice and a hint of honey to the wine. The dried fruit and honey follow on the palate, and a fresh acidity balances the sweetness.

aromas: Raspberry, Strawberry, Red Cherry, White Pepper, Cedar, Graphite
notes: Medium-dark ruby. Fruity, bright aromas of red cherry, red berries and flowers, complicated by cedar and graphite. Then light and lively in the mouth, with strawberry, raspberry and smoky dark cherry flavours complicated by hints of white pepper and gunflint. The finish features a lingering floral note and chewy tannins that will need some time to resolve but seem polished enough to guarantee a bright future. This is an excellent, classically styled Haut-Bages Liberal, just a step below the first growths.
Enticing, with a tangy iron note to the fresh red currant and bitter cherry fruit flavours, followed by a lingering sanguine edge on the pleasantly dusty finish. WE

From Hollick Estate in the Coonawarra region of Southern Australia, this classic Aussie blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Shiraz offers up fantastic drinkability. Very approachable with supple tannins and bright plum and blackberry fruit leading into a spicy finish. Produced for early drinking 2022-2025.

Subtle layers of citrus and stone fruit aromas, and whiffs of angelica, acacia flower and allspice. Light to medium bodied, with a smooth, fleshy texture and vibrant, integrated acidity. Tim Atkin MW SA Report 2021: "Patina comes from a 1.6- hectare parcel planted on schist soils in 1996. Partially fermented on skins, it has good grip, taut acidity and layers of pear, green apple and beeswax. Concrete eggs add some focus to the vanilla oak spice. 2021-25"

Intense with an abundance of dark berry fruit, juicy black plums and brambles, and whiffs of aniseed, leather and charcoal. Medium to full-bodied, dense and fleshy, with a solid core of fruit and grippy, fine tannins, with enough acidity to balance. Tim Atkin MW SA Report 2021: "Patina is a classic expression of Syrah grown on schist soils, with racy, floral, baking spice aromas, fine, silky, aromatic strawberry and red cherry fruit, some texture from 50% whole bunches and no new oak. A Cape Cote Roti. Plush, yet refined. 2022-26"

grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Petit Verdot
notes: Deftly balanced, this big wine offers a mix of rich, dense flavours and subtle fruit and herb nuances. The core delivers loamy earth, currant, black liquorice, mocha and cedar laced oak and loamy tannins that let the flavours push through. Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Malbec and Petit Verdot. Drink now through 2025. Wine Spectator

grapes: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Petit Verdot
notes: A blend of 77% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Cabernet Franc and the rest Petit Verdot and Malbec, there's 928 cases of the 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon Estate, unquestionably one of the wines of the vintage. Blackcurrants, unsmoked tobacco, graphite, and damp earth all flow from this ethereally textured, seamless, gorgeous wine that has no hard edges, excellent acidity and a great finish. It’s slightly more elegant and polished than the more powerful 2015 and will shine for 20-25 years. Jeb Dunnock

wine: Champagne Carbon Rose Pink in Luxury Box
notes: Bottle wrapped with Carbon Fibre Packaging include luxury box. The colour of this Rosé CARBON is a work of haute couture. A parade of fine pearly bubbles seems to stretch to infinity. Its participants follow one after the other in a long, stylized thread up to the surface. A beautiful, persistent sheath of foam resides at the top of the glass. The nose is very aromatic, a connoisseur’s delight with a colourful collection of red fruit, a generous bowl of strawberries, raspberries and cherries – and floral notes with hints of violets and lilac. wine: La Belle Etoile Celestiale Rose Grenache 2021
notes: This pretty pink wine is a blend of Cinsault, Syrah and Grenache. Light, delicate notes of red berry and gooseberry and fruits that remind you of summer pudding and raspberry Eton mess this wine is ideal for warm summer day drinking or an aperitif to start the evening off.
A youthful Chardonnay expression Pays d'oc. Flint and minerality coupled with fresh citrus and white stone fruit tones.

Rich notes of fresh boysenberry, cassis, and a touch of light cocoa. Although the North Coast has traditionally set the standard for Cabernet Sauvignon, pockets of distinction have risen throughout the coastal regions of the state from areas close to our own home, such as Sonoma Valley, to as far south as Monterey and Paso Robles. By integrating the diverse characteristics from each of these regions and their vineyards, we are proud to present an effortlessly approachable Cabernet that we feel represents the full potential of our state to produce world-class wines.

YALUMBA HAS CREATED A MINI VERTICAL OF THEIR FLAGSHIP CABERNET SAUVIGNON AND SHIRAZ, THE CALEY. PRODUCING ONLY 10 VERTICAL CASES, EACH FEATURES THE FIRST THREE RELEASES FROM THE INAUGURAL 2012 RELEASE. THE CALEY IS THE RESULT OF OUR UNWAVERING COMMITMENT TO AUSTRALIA’S OWN UNIQUE RED WINE STYLE: CABERNET AND SHIRAZ. FOR MORE THAN A CENTURY, CABERNET SHIRAZ HAS BEEN A FOCUS AT YALUMBA AND THE CALEY IS NOW OUR FINEST EXAMPLE, A “SUPER CLARET” OF ANOTHER ERA.
Pierre Jourdan Ratafia is a delicious sweet aperitif style wine. Enjoy a fortified, full-bodied sweet wine, with hints of fresh limes along with rich honey tones.

A blend of Shiraz, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, this is a fruit driven red with lots of juicy ripe red fruit accompanied by just a touch of vanilla and spice and supple tannins. See more from D'Aria

Music by D'Aria Sauvignon Blanc 2019 is a crisp, bright and fresh white with plenty of ripe stone fruit and a hint of citrus. Nothing too complicated but with enough acidity and minerality to maintain balance. See more from D'Aria
Middelvlei Shiraz is an elegant juicy wine with soft tannins. Concentrated flavours of plums, cherries and dark chocolate with mild oak spice and a soft smooth finish. See more from Middelvlei

wine: Rudd Oakville Estate Samantha's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2014
notes: Rudd Oakville Estate Samantha's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2014. Dark in colour with violet edges, the aromatics express pure, Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon characteristics with cassis fruit, hints of dried rosemary and freshly dug earth, suggesting an iron/rust element. On the mouth a fresh entry with ripe tannins and acid crescendos with liveliness and inviting drinkability. A wine of finesse, yet generous, the 2014 Rudd Oakville Estate Samantha's Cabernet Sauvignon is enjoyable now and will continue to develop in complexity with 4-15 years of cellaring.

wine: Rudd Oakville Estate Samantha's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2012
notes: A bold, assertive style that packs in a lot of flavour, with dense dark berry, mocha, mineral, cedar and loamy earth notes driving the core flavours. Though big and rowdy, there's a measure of finesse and suppleness here that moves to the forefront.

wine: Taylor's 10 Year Old Tawny Port in Gift Tube
notes: Taylor's 10 Year Old Tawny Port in Gift Tube. Deep brick colour with amber rim. Rich and elegant nose combining aromas of ripe berry fruit with a delicate nuttiness and subtle mellow notes of chocolate, butterscotch and fine oak wood. Smooth and silky on the palate and full of ripe figgy, jammy flavours which persist on the long finish.

wine: Romano dal Forno Amarone della Valpolicella 2006
notes: Polished and expressive, this shows a smoky baseline of graphite-laced minerality, with fine-grained tannins and mouth watering acidity focusing the flavours of date, kirsch, ground anise and clove, with a touch of cocoa powder.

wine: Staglin Family Estate Salus Cabernet Sauvignon 2013
notes: Intensely dark, black fruits fill the glass with the blackberry, blackcurrant, boysenberry and ripe Damson plum taking centre stage. Unctuous and resinous, the complex notes of leather, coffee extract, cocoa liquor and crushed rocks are given lift and lightness by an integrated essence of camphor, anise and potpourri. While the palate is initially a bit compact and focused, it quickly blossoms into a wonderfully mouth coating elixir with a fine-grained structure and a lively, granular texture that keeps on keeping on. This 2013 Salus Cabernet Sauvignon is at present a big, structured and tight

wine: Taylor's Historical Collection III "The Mallet" Reserve Tawny Port
notes: This blend was carefully put together for this limited edition from specially selected Ports from Taylor’s extensive aged Tawny stocks, aged in seasoned oak Port pipes. Deep reddish-brown hue at the centre with a narrow brick coloured rim. The mature, opulent nose opens with a warm redolence of coffee, butterscotch and dried fruit, with notes of plum and raisin. Around this rich, mellow core are layers of spicy, woody and nutty aroma, as well as discreet floral scents, giving the wine an intricate, subtle and seductive complexity. On the palate it is round and dense, with a smooth silky textur

Argentiera, Doc Bolgheri Superiore, draws its strength and uniqueness from the magnificent territory in which it’s generated. The grapes come from the estate’s best vineyards of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc. It is a wine with a rich and silky taste. A long maturation in French oak barrels, the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon and the unique terroir of Tenuta Argentiera make this wine on of the greatest expressions in the Bolgheri area.

Flagship red from the Estate. Only the Rondekop vineyards are used for the production of the Vergelegen G.V.B. These vineyards sit between 180-220 meters above sea level and enjoy cooler climate and a longer ripening period. Plum, chocolate, cassis and cedarwood on the nose and flavours of black cherry, blackcurrants and refreshing minerals on the palate. More from Vergelegen Estate

The Series C 2016 displays plummy hues with an inky, red-black colour. A deep, primary wine with concentration of dark berry fruits, including black cherries and dried blackcurrants that segue to darker chocolate, liquorice, molasses, and hints of pencil shavings. The wine is subtle and continues to reward with time in the glass, blossoming with sophisticated violet notes and characters of blonde tobacco and spice. The palate offers a sensuous and inviting overture. Tannins are firm yet plush, giving structure and velvety depth of flavour. A surprisingly soft entry, this wine builds in intensi

aromas: Blackcurrant, Blueberry, Violet, Clove, Slate, Hazelnut
notes: Series C 2017 showcases beautiful purity, striking intensity and a remarkably long finish of dark fruit with a touch of clove spice. This blend displays a deep, intense ruby colour. The nose offers a remarkably complex fruit expression, opening with blackcurrant, blueberry and fresh juniper berry interwoven with sensuous violet perfume. Composed dark fruits transition to hints of chocolate and hazelnut praline. A subtle slate/lead-like minerality underlies a bittersweet, spicy Cola note. The entry is plush and weighty, with an abundance of fine-grained tannins across the palate - most reminisc

aromas: Cassis, Blackberry, Plum, Violet, Nutmeg, Dark Chocolate
notes: Series C 2019 displays an intense ruby-purple colour and a vibrant, crimson rim. Dense on opening, this blend offers seductively fragrant layers of blackberry, cassis and baked plum, perfectly offset by a savoury, hoisin sauce note. Opulent floral notes; violet and lilac harmoniously blend to fresh-crushed juniper berry, pencil shavings, nuanced dark chocolate and sweet, warm nutmeg. The palate reveals a plush, expansive entry, with vivid continuity. Fine-grained tannins throughout embody a cashmere embrace, building on the fine and assertive structure. A deep ruby colour with an inky purple rim. Aromatics showing opulence and youthful tension. Complex layers of pomegranate, Boysenberry and black cherry lead to baking spice, fresh pastry and a peppery base note of teak wood shavings. The palate shows a seamless fine structure, silky focus and alluring, supple texture. Fruit flavours are generous – luscious black raspberry and cherry, balanced by rich concentration and lingering espresso notes. This is a big, bold wine and although immediately accessible, cellaring will reward the patient collector for the next two decades or even more
This fresh version brims with cherry, mineral, briar and tobacco aromas and flavours. Works toward equilibrium, with solid tannins, and finishes with a mouth-watering impression.

Intense ruby red in colour, CastelGiocondo Brunello 2014 expresses itself through complex aromas of raspberry and blackcurrant, with subtle hints of blueberry, which are further enriched by elegant floral notes and the tertiary spice of cinnamon, pepper and leather. On the palate, it envelops the palate with impressive balance, dense tannic texture and minerality through to a long finish.

wine: Castiglion Del Bosco Brunello Di Montalcino 2014
notes: The 2014 Brunello is a thrilling wine, fearless of expressing the finesse and elegance of a rainy but healthy vintage. Soil drainage, altitude, and ventilation of the Capanna vineyards reward this Brunello with a complete taste profile and a full, savoury finish.

A n intense bouquet of dark cherries, soy, leather and roasted herbs that are well-defined. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannins, plenty of sour cherries, balsamic and orange zest notes that fan out on the composed, focused finish.

A classic example of a Bordeaux-style wine grown in South Africa, though the 2015 vintage offers a more restrained and austere approach in a nod to the blend’s Old-World heritage. On the nose find notes of olive tapenade spiced with cinnamon and cassia bark with blackberry and brambles. There’s liquorice, and aniseed too; scented with herbs such as thyme and dried fennel. A savoury flinty edge to the aromatics will find you picking up beef bouillon and pencil shavings.
