Tags: Craziness 3, Mineral
Tags: Aromatic, Craziness 3

"Ya Yeh" is a cute word that means egg in Slovenian, the wine spent in-fact time in egg concrete. The Sauvignon Blanc has delicate citrusy notes of clementine and lime , some shy but well integrated aromas of pear, medlar, apricot and passion fruit and a wonderful acidity .

Šipon is the grape variety which is the latin word for Furmint. The white Pet Nat Mea is a mild , fresh and summery sparkling. It has notes of mint , almond , yellow apple and lime zest . Very pleasant with a gentle perlage .
Tags: Amphora Wines, Craziness 2, Fruity, No Sulfites Added Wines
The Karpatenschiefer from Trapl is a delicious orange wine, is herbal, complex and light . It has notes of grapefruit , yellow apple and hay . A wonderful rustic version of a Grüner Veltliner!

Johannes Trapl Weissburgunder is a light and summery refreshment. A bit wild in the nose, a hint of caramel, citrusy notes and only 10.5% of alcohol. It has a nice acidity, some tannins and aromas of green apple, lime and yellow grapefruit .
This Blaufränkisch is part of Trapl‘s colourful labels – fun , balanced and summery . It has fruity notes of blackberry, cherry and cranberry. An easy drinking red yet delicious!

The Zweigelt is part of the colorful, fun line of Johannes Trapl , in-fact it is an easy drinking red wine. It is fruity and balanced , it has low tannins and mild acidity and tasty aromas of cherry and raspberry . Drink it slightly chilled!
Johannes Trapl Grüner Veltliner is fresh and light . It is a citrusy version of this grape variety with lime and green tea leaves aromas. Slightly herbal and salty with a summery acidity.

Johannes Trapl Rosé is a summery refreshment. The colourful label represents a fun , fruity and lively wine (like his Zweigelt and Grüner Veltliner). The rosé has a nice fruitiness with aromas of strawberry , cherry and pomegranate . There is a nice lime note too.

The Rennersistas Pin-oh! Noir is light in terms of colour and style. It is a very elegant red with delicious fruity notes of raspberry and cranberry and some fragrant violets too. Such a great wine, highly recommended!

The Douro from Antonio Lopes Ribeiro is from the famous Douro region in Portugal. The mix of local grape varieties, the rocky schist terroir give birth to a balanced , round , medium body red with nice fruitiness and a herbal touch. Dark fruits , blackberry , black cherry and cinnamon aromas. Big wine for little money!

Nina from Casa de Mouraz is a cuvée of 20 different grape varieties, half red and half white, coming from a 60 years old vineyard. The result is a bright red with an elegant , light and salty style with aromas of strawberry and cherry . The wine is made without any addition of sulfites, dried chestnuts blossoms are used instead. Cool right?

Bolinha by Casa de Mouraz is a light orange wine with nice acidity. It has great floral and citrusy notes, a mix of vermut , mint , rosemary and lots of green tea leaves. It has complexity, a light and refreshing style and a delicious green apple aroma. Bolinha is a cute Maltese dog who helps out in the vineyard 🙂

At the Hoch family farm , herbs, hops, and grapes reign supreme! This creative, sparkling drink is the perfect aperitif for those seeking a fun , alcohol-free option. Rather than acting as a mere wine substitute, it was crafted to ensure everyone feels included at the dinner table. On the palate, you’ll detect gentle herbal notes and a hint of hops (reminiscent of a fine craft beer), while the verjus —the juice of unripe grapes—provides a lovely , refreshing acidity . The result is a drink that is dry , aromatic , and full of character. Allergens: Wheat & Barley - This drink contains gluten

ChaBoom by Leo Uibel is a fun pet nat with lots of fruity notes like peach , apple , pear , gooseberry and pink grapefruit . It is very cloudy so make sure you twist the bottle a couple of times ( gently) before opening the bottle!

Entourloupe is a Blanc de Blancs made from local grape varieties. The Crémant is elegant and fruity , it has a lovely light oxidative note which elevates it to the next level. Hazelnut and yellow apple can be detected and an overall complexity . They are definitely the masters in Crèmant production!

The new creation by Domaine Muller Koeberle is the Pet Nat 327 . It is a blend of 50 resistant grape varieties around the world. A sort of experiment which turned out amazing . The sparkling rosé is very aromatic , it has an intense strawberry scent in the nose. On the palate it has a playfull mix of fruity aromas like quince , pear and a bit of banana . The long lasting aftertaste is filled with delicious wild strawberries !
Tags: Aromatic, Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 1, Organic Certified Wines, Vegan Wines

Girotondo is mainly a Sangiovese with a bit of Malvasia. The result is a wild and rustic red wine. It has refreshing notes of pomegranate , cherry and red currant . It has a light body and a hint of saltiness . sSuch a new way of producing Sangiovese! We are hooked.
Tags: Craziness 2, Light

The Rosso is a wonderful red wine with nice fruitiness and earthy tannins like you would expect from a Tuscan red. Notes of blackberry and strawberry and a light saltiness . It goes away from the typical powerful, intense Sangiovese, this is rather light bodied, vibrant and full of character.
The Bianco is a light orange wine made with typical Tuscan white grape varieties. A balanced and mild wine with tasty aromas of yellow apple , pear , hazelnut and clementine zest .
Tags: Craziness 1, Organic Certified Wines, Powerful

The Canaiolo by Pacina is a wonderful, powerful red wine. It has herbal notes as well as blackberry , salami and forest floor . Expect nice earthy tuscan tannins. We recommend to drink this red wine along with food and to consume it within a day. The next day it starts to get a little nutty. Share it with friends and family at the dinner table!

The Donesco is a new release from Pacina. Made in substitution of ‘Il Secondo di Pacina’, it’s the earthiest red of their selection with bite-y tannins and a full body. Notes of blackberry , plum & cinnamon.

La Cerretina from Pacina is a dark , aromatic orange wine. It would remind you of the ancient Georgian wines with its earthy notes and complexity . Honey , walnuts and herbal aromas describe this special crazy macerated wine.
Tags: Craziness 2, Elegant, Organic Certified Wines

One of a kind is made from Riesling grapes. The roots of the vines dig deep into the gravel soil extracting all the minerals the land has to offer. The wine in-fact has a wonderful saltiness and complexity . it also elegant with refreshing notes of green apple and lime .

Johannes Zillinger’s Rosé from the NUMEN series is a complex one with character. The St. Laurent grape variety gives a dark , almost red wine-like color to this natural amphora wine. It gains its complexity from 100 year- old vines , it’s smoky on the palate with some wild berry aromas completing in a long finish .

The Revolution Pink Solera from Johannes Zillinger is a mix of 3 grape varieties: Rösler (50%), Syrah (40%) and St. Laurent (10%). The Rösler was fermented in stainless steel tanks and matured in barrels, the Syrah spent time in barrels and the St. Laurent was made with a unique solera system (different vintages put together year after year). The result is a fresh and summery rosé, aromas of sour cherries , ribes and yogurt .
Best Friend by the Pittnauers is fun just like a best friend should be! Bright in color and summery in style with fresh aromas of raspberry , cherry and pomegranate . Serve chilled!

The Dancing Queen is a wine full of fun flavours, lots of floral notes and fruitiness . Apple , pineapple , clementine , jasmine and elderflower . It's also mild in acidity and overall balanced in style. Drink a glass and start dancing! Between Orange and White Wine.

Schmelzer’s Rosé Pet Nat is bottle fermented and it is made of Zweigelt and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. There is no added SO2 like in all Georg’s wines. The natural juice is fruity , fresh and summery. It has intense aromas of wild strawberry , red currant and pomegranate . The refreshing acidity and the light salty minerality makes it the perfect aperitif for hot days.

Georg Schmelzer‘s white Pet Nat, the Dion, is a cuvée of Welschriesling (80%) and Sämling. Bottle fermented and no sulphites added, it has a fresh and elegant style, a hint of smokiness and herbal notes. Green apple , mint and grapefruit . The Pannonian microclimate of Burgenland and the sandy soil contributes to its fine, pleasant acidity.
The Gemischter Satz Vielfalt from Hager Matthias is an amazing balanced white wine. It’s aromatic and floral with notes of clementine, yellow apple and apricot .

Opera I is made with 2 grape varieties: Müller-Thurgau & Moravian Muscat, using the classic Champagne method with the second fermentations in the bottle and zero dosage . The result is outstanding, a Champagne-like sparkling, with elegance and complexity , with notes of green apple , lime and clementine and that bread-y finish which is typical in Champagne.

Labyrinth II is part of the Naboso 's new line, the ' single varietal' line. Limited quantities, no skin contact, just pure expression of the grape variety and its terroir. In this case 100% Grüner Veltliner, aged 1 year in oak and acacia barrels. The 2022 is complex and mineral , it has salty and citrusy notes. Green apple and lime as well as a hint of oak .

A mix of white and red grapes, Spolu is basically a cherry juice , super fun and light bodied. A light fizz on the tip of the tongue, notes of raspberry and pomegranate . Gentle acidity and very low tannins, perfect to drink slightly chilled!
Rituál is an elegant Blaufränkisch it has great complexity , notes of cherry and cranberry and a mild oakiness . This wine can be enjoyed by everyone, nothing funky in there - just pure, good wine!

The Zore is a red wine that in terms of style it can remind of a Beaujolais: fruity , juicy and super fun to drink. Lots of red berries like cherry , raspberry and strawberry . Gentle tannins and acidity, it's highly drinkable despite the 14% of alcohol.

This wonderful orange wine from Naboso is rich and complex. Doma 2022 has yummy aromas of apple , pear and almond . A slight salty and yogurt-y touch. Mild in tannins and acidity is a perfectly balanced wine to pair to a delicious dinner.

The Grüner Veltliner Vielfalt from Hager Matthias is an aromatic natural white wine. Dreamy flavours like mango and guava and clementine zest The beautiful creative label has been painted by a Caritas team of local people with disabilities. For every bottle sold you would support this great association. Another good reason to get yourself a bottle or two!

The S EKT PUR Blanc de Noir from Matthias Hager is a sparkling natural wine prepared with the Champagne method. Don’t be fooled by the grape variety, although it’s a Zweigelt , you’ll get a white juice! Lovely aromas of apples and melon in the nose. Super refreshing , bready , elegant treat in the palate!

The Pet Nat from Hager Matthias is made from 100% Zweigelt grapes. It’s clear , bright and delicious with a fine mild sparkle. Its freshness and its minerality are rounded up by some nice aromas of strawberry and red currant . It’s a perfect aperitif.

The Grüner Veltliner Pet Nat from Matthias Hager is your best choice for an easy refreshment . Expect some dry , minerality driven bubbles. The juice is slightly cloudy , a natural pick-me-up! Nice aromas of apricots and marzipan .

Did you know that the Wagram slopes used to be covered by a premordial sea? Lots of fossils are often found by the producer while working in the vineyards. You might ask what a pig is doing in the water… that’s a fantasy sea creature which should resemble Czerny’s mangalitza pig , an ancient pig race with furry curls, perhaps it lived in the sea millions of years ago. The wine is aromatic, fruity and floral with notes of peach , pineapple , honey (dry), orange blossom and yellow apple and a touch of creaminess and saltiness . Enjoy! Only 240 bottles found!

Friends, party, Rozsa . This pink rosé from Koppitsch is a real glou-glou wine. It's a summery , fruity cuvée with a light fizziness. Red berry notes, especially raspberry, starwberry and cherry. It has everything you need for a fun summer.

What happens when you combine good wine and fresh cold brew lavender tea? "Punched!" happens: a wonderful fizzy rosé-like drink, light in alcohol , perfect for summery days. Julie Hoch is so creative when it comes to herbs, her passion resonates in her creations!

Julie Hoch loves to experiment with herbs from her garden. This great non alcoholic sparkling drink is made by infusing mint with grape juice. The result it's a minty , grape-y summery drink, sligthly sweet , yet refreshing and fun !

The Pure Joy Botanical Elderflower by Julie Hoch is a sparkling aperitif made by adding freshly brewed elderflower tea to fresh grape juice and allowing then the mix to ferment, with its natural yeast, inside the bottle. The result is a light , bone-dry , summery sparkling drink. The floral notes and the low alcohol make this pet nat the perfect aperitif for summer.

The Gamay vineyard of the ' Sauvage ' have a very low yield therefore very few bottles are produced every year. The wine is balanced , fruity and complex . Black cherry and blackberry , mild acidity and low tannins.
' Mayga ' is wonderful and elegant red with a natural kick! Salty , peppery and mineral with complex aromas like liquorice , black cherry & black peppercorn . Be ready to be amazed!
Tags: Craziness 3, Fruity, No Sulfites Added Wines, Organic Certified Wines
The Heideboden is a blend of 3 grape varieties. This delicious red wine is bright and it has a light fizziness . It is fruity with tasty aromas of cherry , pomegranate and black currant .

Salzberg is the name of one of the oldest and best vineyard slopes in Gols, which faces southwest. The wonderful location and the rich soil give the wine an intense and complex style. A powerful wine full of character made to accompany a special dinner!
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 1, Organic Certified Wines, Powerful, Vegan Wines
The Heinrich Pinot Noir is a very elegant and light bodied red wine. Tasty notes of raspberry and cherry . Expect nice acidity in there and a bit of tannins.

Weisze Freyheit is a wonderful, complex wine. Elegant and mineral , with salty notes and a touch of creaminess . Aromas of lime , green apple , lemon and mild caramel . The colour is a very charming bright orange .
Rosé Brut by Schödl is a wonderful alternative to Champagne. It is elegant and mineral with a lovely freshness . Mild red currant and strawberry aromas.

Blanc de Blanc by Schödl is the perfect Champagne-like sparkling to open for special celebrations. It is elegant and mineral with lots of beautiful aromas like green apple , lime & sea buckthorn berry and a bit of vanilla . Bready notes, light saltiness and a touch of hazelnut bring this wonderful sparkling to the next level.
Bloody Muscat By Schödl is a gentle and elegant Muskateller. It has fruity and floral notes, some pleasant aromas of pink grapefruit , orange , peach , elderflower and litschi .
Schödl's Pinot Noir is an elegant red wine with its typical wonderful aromas of violet and cherry .

Pét Naturel Weiss by Schödl is an elegant, fresh natural sparkling wine. It has champagne-like features. Notes of green apple , lime and hazelnut, a nice bright acidity, light salty notes and a long finish.

Safari by Schödl is a fresh and summery white wine. In the nose a bomb of grapefruit and clementine . Zesty on the palate especially lime and grapefruit zest, some apple and peach too. Super delicious!
Grün Grün Grüner by Schödl family is balanced and mild . It has a light creaminess and nice complexity . Aromas of mirabelle plum , citrus fruits and a hint of Tonka bean.

The Gemischter Satz from Hager Matthias is the perfect crowd pleaser. A fresh and light natural juice, full of aromas and fruitiness especially Marille apricots and apple, all balanced out with some nice acidity. Your dinner party just cannot go wrong if you start with a few bottles of this!

Projekt Wildtyp Drangalo is a light orange wine with a salty touch. Yellow apple , pear and green tea leaves. Mild tannins and acidity. A little funk in the nose! Drangalo is a Viennese word that refers to a person who drinks on a daily basis. We all know a Drangalo in our life! 😉

Lick is the Pet Nat in Petracavallo’s selection and it’s fun in both the look and the taste! It is balanced , it has a great fizziness, mild acidity , and gentle aromas of apricot , buckthorn, yellow apple, pear and hazelnut .

Petracavallo Bye Bye Bye! is an orange wine made from an almost extinct local grape variety: Fiano Minutolo. It has great complexity , herbal and earthy notes. Aromas of apple , orange zest and herbs of all kind. Expect a light fizz at first and a bunch of tannins!

Koppitsch family has created a brand new wine by mixing red and white grape coming from the Neuberg vineyard. ABENDROT (which translates to ‘afterglow’ in English) has a fantastic ginger color that recalls the amazing sunsets by the lake Neusiedl. The wine is rustic and citrusy with a creamy touch. More of a rosé in style but with a character of an orange wine. Red currant , mirabelle plums , lime and thyme notes.

The Winzersekt Brut from Wimmer Czerny is an elegant sparkling wine. Grape juice is added to trigger the second fermentation, no added sugar, nor yeast or sulphites. It has a lovely fine perlage and the color is simply gorgeous. Strawberry , lime and a very pleasant minerality that leaves a tiny salty aftertaste.

Wimmer Czerny 's Pet Nat PUR is a great aperitif , it is mineral and summery . It has notes of strawberry , red currant and citrus fruits like lime and lemon. Lovely, refreshing acidity and a wonderful salinity .
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 1, Organic Certified Wines
A wonderfully aged Grüner Veltliner with a beautiful oxidative touch. Very complex , rich and aromatic with notes of yellow apple , pear , dried apricot , some caramel and light hazelnut .
The Weissburgunder Scheiben by Wimmer Czerny is a balanced and fruity white. It has a slight fizziness , some pear and peach aromas and a touch of creaminess!
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 1, Organic Certified Wines
The Frühroter Veltliner from Wimmer Czerny is a fruity and mild white wine. An overall balanced juice, with nice notes of apricot , green apple , pear and some floral hints.
This Roter Veltliner is an easy going white wine, balanced in style with the perfect level of acidity! Gentle aromas of apple, apricots and pear. Lovely high quality wine for a very fair price.

The Hefeabstich from Wimmer Czerny is a fresh Grüner Veltliner. It has everything you expect from this grape variety: balanced style, light body and peppery character. Nice notes of green apple , gooseberry and white pepper . What a great price too!

' Out of the Dark ' is an elegant version of a Blaufränkisch , its style can recall a Pinot Noir. It has minerality and complexity as well as a lovely saltiness . Aromas of red fruits: raspberry , cherry , red currant and pomegranate !

The Kind of Blue is a great summery Pet Nat, it is made from red grapes in-fact the colour tends towards a light rosé. The taste is citrusy and refreshing . It has notes of red currant , lime , lemon and orange .

Heinrich Naked Rosé has the right characteristics for a lovely summery wine: kicking acidity, salty taste and citrusy notes! Lemon , red currant and pomegranate , gentle tannins and no sulphites added.

The Chardonnay vines grow on the Leithaberg slopes, the limestone and mica slate soil blesses the wine with fantastic salty minerality . You'll get some peach , lime , buttermilk and a hint of caramel . The caramel aroma lingers beautifully on the palate.

Into the Light is a white vinified Blaufränkisch. The grapes fermented and matured in wooden casks and amphoras resulting in a complex and mineral white wine. Yellow plum , lime , buckthorn berry , salty notes and a cool light walnut -y finish. Now you can say that you've had a white Blaufränkisch!
The fun and summery Naked Red by Heinrich is a very tasty and fair priced wine. It has flavours of cherry , chocolate and blackberry , mild tannins and a balanced style.
The Naked Orange is a wonderful fun orange cuvée. It has some charming floral notes especially orange blossoms , some peach and litchi aromas. There is saltiness in there and a light fizz.
Naked White by Heinrich is a blend of Pinot Blanc and Chardonnay, the wine has a great minerality, salty with citrusy notes and green apple .

The red wine in Heinrich‘s Freyheit line is the Pinot Noir . The beautiful ceramic black bottle carries an elegant and complex red with raspberry , violets and hay notes, light acidity and very delicate tannins.

Mira’s Pinot Noir has gone through a semi carbonic maceration and matured for 8 months in oak barrels. The wine is elegant with notes of cherry , raspberry and violet . You have a light fizziness on the tip of the tongue.

Here’s another delicious red from Pittnauer , the Pinot Noir . It is balanced and complex with elegant notes of blackberry , raspberry, violets and some light spices . It has just the right level of tannins and acidity to please everyone at the table.
Velvet by Pittnauer is a balanced and fruity red wine. Aromas of cherry , raspberry and black currant .

The Rosé by Nature from Pittnauer is made from mainly Blaufränkisch grapes which were fermented in steel tanks and then matured in amphoras . The light , summery rosé is both beautiful and delicious, a bit tangy and zesty with notes of pomegranate , rhubarb , lime and pink grapefruit .
Pittnauer’s Blond by Nature is a fun white with a very charming color! Very tasty on the palate, it has mild delicious aromas of pineapple , apricot, peach and citrus zest . A super summery treat!
The Grüner Veltliner Reflexion celebrate the 3 generations behind Zillinger's Winery. The wine is fresh and summery with light peppery and mild salty notes, green apple flavour and a balanced style.

This Grüner Veltliner from Zillinger's Numen series comes from old vines; the best selected grapes are fermented in Georgian Amphoras, the extremely complex golden juice is mineral and salty with notes of yellow apple , lime and saffron . A light oxidative note elevate this wine to a deeper level. Wonderful long finish too!

aromas: Baked Apple, Quince, Lime, Cinnamon, Hazelnut
notes: The Sauvignon Blanc vines were re crafted on the coldest part of the Riesling vineyard in Steinthal. Resulting in extremely small berries, concentrated and very ripe with a reduced sugar content and high acidity. This special wine is extremely complex , lots of elegant flavours that dance on your palate with a beautiful saltiness . Quince , baked apple , cinnamon , lime and hazelnut . Expect a light oxidative note that brings the wine to the next level! Top!

This delicious orange from Pittnauer has good reasons to be called ‘Perfect Day’ , drinking a bottle of this aromatic juice does make you happy. The color is so charming, the intense floral bouquet in the nose is enticing ( orange blossom , hyacinth , rose petals etc..). Peachy notes and a hint of litchi in there too and some citrus fruits.

Velue Rot is made of 85% Zweigelt and 15% of Merlot. The process of destemming the grapes and the gentle fermentation without pressing the berries have given a light and fun style to the wine. Fruity notes of cherry , raspberry and red currant .

Velue Weiss is a blend of Grüner Veltliner, Riesling and Muscat a petit grains. Such a fun and easy drinking white. Crunchy apples in there, some apricots , lime and light saltiness . Expect a touch of fizziness upon opening the bottle.

Johannes Zillinger’s Riesling from the NUMEN series is a mineral driven, complex white. Definitely not like any conventional Riesling! Stemming from selected old vines , it had spent 14 months in amphora before it was bottled unfiltered. It is elegant with a hint of smoky and stony notes plus apricot and lime aromas.

The Revolution White from Johannes Zillinger is an experimental mix of 3 grape varieties: Chardonnay (50%), Riesling (25%) and Sämling (25%). The story doesn’t end here though. The Chardonnay was fermented in amphora, The Sämling in barrels and the Riesling was made with a unique solera system (different vintages put together year after year). Slightly fizzy at first, it has a citrusy, refreshing and balanced style. Notes of grapefruit , lime , clementine and green apple .

The Numen Fumé blanc from Johannes Zillinger is an unfiltered, bit cloudy sauvignon blanc. Old vines , intercellular fermentation in Georgian qvevris and 16 months on the lees: a long and elaborated process that results into a super complex white with beautiful minerality and a very long finish . Floral and elegant with lots of peach notes as well as litchi and jasmine .

Babelas (Afrikaans for ‘hangover’) was dedicated by the Rennersistas to South Africa and its wonderful people who are often partying with fizzy goodness. The Babelas is fruity and balanced . It has aromas of strawberry , hazelnut and pomegranate . A touch of minerality and only 9.5% of alcohol. It is a fun, party Pet Nat indeed!

Les Chaineaux is an elegant Chenin Blanc with a golden colour and a cloudy look. Lots of delicious pears in there, yellow apple and apricot too. The wine is aged for a year in used oak barrels which gives the wine that gentle oak-y touch. It has great complexity , a balanced style and a charming minerality .

Les Puys is elegant and balanced . It has delicious aromas of blackberry , raspberry and a hint of oak. A really complex and deep red wine, features given by the special terroir in-fact the 40 yo vines grow on silex soil.

Les Pucelles is a particular plot of Cabernet Franc where the vines present a rather woody stalks where normally are green and thick. This gives the wine a rustic style. Balanced oveall with notes of blackberry, a touch of cassis and rosemary . 50% of the grapes are not destemmed blessing this wonderful red with well integrated tannins.
Les Moulines de Beau Puy is elegant and balanced with notes of cassis , blackberry and a touch of rosemary . Another fantastic Cabernet Franc from Domaine de Frères' selection.

Le Pérou is made with Cabernet Franc and it is the only parcel surrounded by woods, the vines benefit from a special micro climate. The wine is bright due to the light and gentle skin maceration. It is juicy and aromatic , strawberry and cream at first, then cherry and blackberry ! Mild in acidity and tannins, it is a delicious red that will make everyone happy!
Waiting for Tom Rosé from Rennersistas is a cuvée of Zweigelt (70%) and Blaufränkisch (30%). It’s very dark in colour. Aromas of cherry , hay and strawberries. The wine is fruity and balanced.
Pita is a refreshing Pet Nat with a super fun style. Aromas of apple , pear , lemon zest and light hops . Pita is a gorgeous Portuguese chicken and it helps around the vineyard!
Tags: Craziness 1, Fresh, Organic Certified Wines

Vinho Tinto is a bright and summery red wine, fermented without the skins and made mainly (95%) from Vinhao which is a red grape plus a little of Loureiro, a white grape. The vines grow very close to the Atlantic ocean blessing the wine with that distinctive freshness and saltiness . You get also some lime and lots of raspberries in there. This lovely light red pairs perfectly with fish dishes.

Chibu is made from about 20 different grape varieties ( 80% red and 20% white) coming from a 60 years old vineyard. The wine is made without any addition of sulfites, the producers added dried chestnut blossoms to the crushed grapes instead. The bright red is summery and fruity with notes of cherry , raspberry , strawberry and sage.

Dao Tinto is a true blend of the Portuguese Dao region! Many different local red grape varieties that together let you discover a fruity and balanced wine. Medium body, round with notes of black cherry and blackberry and a lovely aromatic finish.
Encruzado is an indigenous Portuguese grape variety special in the Dao region. This creamy and balanced white has fruity notes as well as apricot , apple and lime aromas.
Dao Branco is a clear , fruity cuvée of many different local white grape varieties. Citrusy and balanced , with notes of green apple , apricot and lime . Your ultimate Portuguese refreshment!

Cantor by Dom Bliskowice is made with a PiWi grape variety: Cabernet Cantor . The wine is fresh and citrusy , it is a basket full of sour cherries with some pomegranate and lime and a couple of strawberry too. Expect a little fizz at the very first sips.

J22 by Dom Bliskowice is made with an Piwi grape variety: Johanniter . The wine is light , fresh and salty , it surprises the palate with its electrifying acidity. The lovely caramel aftertaste comes from the time spent in French barrels. We like to drink this wine accompanied by fresh oysters or a fish ceviche (not too spicy though).

Dió is a new fun addition in the Koppitsch's selection. The name means 'nut' in Hungarian, the vineyard in-fact shares the soil with 3 old nut trees. The Dió is fruity and exotic with notes of pineapple , ACE juice and grapefruit .

The BergWerk from Georg Schmelzer stems from wild-grown cabernet sauvignon. The small, dark, super flavorful, hand-harvested grapes will then be filled into amphoras in the ground right next to the vines! Which then spend an entire cycle of 4 seasons being matured and treated by the sassy elements, cultivating an earthy, rustic and complex character and notes of blackberry, cassis & plum . The intense complex taste could remind you of Rum.

aromas: Strawberry, Sour Cherry, Cranberry, Lemon, Lime
notes: La Ciuccia (apulian word for donkey) is the rosé wine in Petracavallo‘s selection. It is fresh , summery , it has aromas of strawberry , cranberry, lime, sour cherry and lemon . A super fun rosé.

Pretty nʌts 2024 from Alex and Maria Koppitsch is a fruity and aromatic Pet Nat. It is made of mainly Blaufränkisch grapes and a small part of Syrah. Delicious summery notes in there: raspberries (basically it's a raspberry juice), strawberry and caramel . he wine comes in 4 different labels, all picturing the vineyard in the 4 different seasons.

Bubble Rainette is a fruity and balanced Pet Nats with tasty aromas like apple , pear and apricot .. It has the power to bring everyone together! Enjoy it with natural wine lovers and not, everyone will love this Pet Nat!

The Solera from Muller Koeberle consists in 4 grape varieties and 4 vintages all made with the solera system. The result is a complex white wine with a cool oxidative style . Dried fruits (esp. apricots), yellow apple and gooseberry . Lovely minerality in there too. Best enjoyed in one day . The wine is truly awesome however it is made without adding any sulfites therefore we recommend to share it with friends and drink it on the same day.

La Geiss is not your usual elegant Pinot Noir but a rather rustic one with some light herbal notes and fruitiness . Cherry , raspberry and mint in there. Tip: drink the bottle in one day to experience it at its best! It is made in the most natural way, without adding sulfites!

The Fox Gewürztraminer is aromatic and floral ! Aromas of peach , apricot and orange zest plus some herbal notes in the nose. Wonderful complexity and an astonishing colour! The wine is made naturally without sulfites and we recommend to enjoy it within two days.
Burgreben from Domaine Muller-Koeberle is a fantastic Alsatian Riesling . On the palate the wine is elegant and mineral with mild salty notes, some apricot, lime and sea buckthorn berry aromas.

One of the most special Rieslings we have ever tasted! The Langenberg not only has a very particular soil, a brown soil with a granite substrate (granite composition - mica, quartz and feldspars) but also the way the vineyard is farmed is special with Permaculture and agroforestry techniques. The Riesling spent time with the flor yeast therefore it gains that complex oxidative style . Light pencil shavings, creamy and bready notes. Apricot aroma and a lovely stony minerality.
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 3, No Sulfites Added Wines, Organic Certified Wines, Rustic, Vegan Wines

Marianne is a another great Crémant by Muller-Koeberle, also made with Pinot Noir from the Burgreben vineyard. Milder in acidity, balanced and complex . It is an elegant Crémant, light bready and creamy with some gentle raspberry notes.
Hugo is a wonderful Crémant , pure elegance with great complexity . It is bready , it has aromas of yellow apple & hazelnut and a touch of creaminess.

The Homok from Koppitsch is made from a variety of white grapes growing on sandy soil. “Homok” means “sand” in Hungarian – not surprisingly the Austrian vineyard is located right at the Hungarian border at Lake Neusiedl. As its title suggests, this line from Alex and Maria focuses on the characteristics of the terroir. The cloudy juice is light , fresh and has lovely summery notes. Pineapple , lime, mint and elderflower , light in alcohol, super delicious. Have fun guys!
Big Foot by Petracavallo is a super rustic Montepulciano. The wine is based on tannins and fruitiness with notes of blackberry , cherry , black olives .
The vintage of Superglitzer by Rennersistas is a fresh and summery red wine. It has notes of cherry , pomegranate and red currant . Light salty , fun and light !
Chardonnay by Rennersistas is a fruity orange wine with aromas of peach , rosemary and orange peel . The wine is creamy too.

Intergalactic 2024 from Rennersistas is a cuvée of 5 different local grape varieties . Some of the grapes macerated for 12 hours others for up to 8 days resulting in a brighter orange wine. The delicious wine is fruity and balanced with tasty notes of pear , apricot and yellow apple .

WINE _ We, the Treasure Hunters , discovered this great orange wine the last time we visited Georg's winery. Georg recently became interested in PiWi varieties. Due to the climate change , natural wine production is at risk every year and experimenting with hybrids , which are more resistant to illnesses, has raised interest in some natural wine producers. This orange wine is a result of an experimental PIWI grape variety. TASTE _ It is surprisingly light (only 10.5% of alcohol), it has some aromas of apricot, peach and grapefruit . There is a lovely creaminess and a nice zesty aftertaste! LAB

Georg Schmelzer‘s Bicolor is quite an unusual marriage of white and red wine. The white local grapes are fermented separately and matured in stainless steel tanks, meanwhile the red grapes spend time in used barrels. This fusion represents the fruitiness and freshness of a white wine and the characters of a red wine. Some consider it a rosé, some others a red wine. It is summery and fruity , it taste like a cherry juice without the sugar! There is a bit of lime , red currant and juniper berry too. Such a fun wine!

Schmelzer Big Nature White is cloudy and it has a darker colour than usual whites. The 1 litre fun cuvée has notes of peach, apple and light citrus fruits , a bit of caramel and a touch of creaminess.

The Grüner Veltliner from Georg Schmelzer is part of the fun line (the white labels are the fun wines). The wine is wonderfully mineral: smoky , stony and salty . It has aromas of yellow apple, mint and a hint of something herbal, perhaps marijuana . A complex version of a Grüner Veltliner which is definitely worth trying.
Schemlzer Welschriesling has a light orange hues and is cloudy. It is light and fruity with a fantastic creamy texture. Aromas of passion fruit , peach and pear .

The unfiltered Weissburgunder from Georg Schmelzer has been through a so-called malolactic fermentation: where the acids in the fresh grape must turn into lactic acid. This process gives this cloudy natural wine a creamy , almost buttery flavour. The wine aged in barrels therefore you get lovely vanilla and caramel notes. There is some fruitiness in there too, peach mainly.

Heinrich Zweigelt is basically a pocket size version of the Zweigelt from Heinrich. Like its big brother it has a balanced and fun style and fruity notes of cherry and raspberry . May a tiny bit more Tannins. Super easy drinking and delicious...

OMG is another Uibel's funny wordplay: O nly M ash G rüner. The orange Grüner Veltliner is balanced and fun . It has a beautiful saltiness , notes of lime and sage and a fine pear aroma that gently lingers for some time on the palate.

My Sexy MF by Uibel is a fun wordplay: 'M' stands for Müller Thurgau and 'F' stands for Frühroter Veltliner. The marriage of these two grape varieties results to a balanced and fruity orange wine. Lots of lovely notes like orange peel , peach and apricot and a light smoky touch that brings the wine to the next level!

Sucette from Uibel is made of 75% Zweigelt and 25% Pinot Noir, both fermented and matured in Amphoras . In the nose there is a intense scent of strawberries , on the palate is light and balanced with a cranberry aroma. A little fizziness upon opening the bottle.
Möbius is another wonderful Grüner Veltliner. The malolactic fermentation has blessed the wine with some creamy notes . There is fruitiness in there, mainly green apple ad a bit of lime .

Roter Bruno from Uibel is made from mainly Zweigelt grapes and 10% of Pinot Noir. The result is a balanced and fruity red, low in both tannins and acidity, it has cherry and raspberry notes. As the wine spent some time maturing in barrels you can detect some oakiness in there too.
Uibel Golem is a typical Grüner Veltliner: mild, balanced and peppery . Some aromas of green apple and pear and a touch of fizziness.

This was a discovery that truly blew our minds. While tasting through different barrels at the winery, Hager Matthias mentioned a forgotten barrel of Riesling tucked away in a quiet corner of the cellar—one he said held something special. Naturally, we couldn’t wait to taste it. What we found was extraordinary: an openly fermented Riesling, matured under flor yeast , quietly working its magic over time. At that moment, the wine still carried a gentle sweetness , wrapped in a cool, oxidative style that reminded us of Jura wines. It showed remarkable complexity , with layers of flavours unfoldin

Eiswein has become a rarity in Austria due to the more milder winters. The grapes in-fact need to be harvested frozen, the temperature must be -8°C and often the harvest happens in the night. This Zweigelt is super fruity and balanced , it has lots of aromas like raisins , prunes , honey and dry apricots . Such a fantastic balanced sweetness in this fine and pleasant dessert wine.

The Grüner Veltliner Mollands is part of the 'easy going' Hager's line. It is exactly what you would expect from this grape variety: light , fresh and peppery . An overall tasty, balanced white perfect for natural wine lovers and not.

We ' The Treasure Hunters ' discovered Hager's Treasure on our visit to the winery. Matthias is great in producing Rieslings and when we tasted this tank we were really taken by this orange Riesling, it tasted different, it intrigued us . Wine: It has a cool aroma in the nose like hay and herbs (almost Marijuana-like). It evolves at every sniff and sip, at times you get some floral notes, then herbal ones and at times you feel some saltiness . It has many dimensions. Some timid but fine aromas of apricot and jasmine come through. Label: beautifully designed by Matthias Bergsmann , represents t

Sprudla is a delicious orange Pet Nat made by mainly Müller-Thurgau and a bit of Grüner Veltliner. It is earthy and rustic with aromas of yellow apple, apricot, clementine, orange & rosemary . Some light smoky notes and herbal vibes.

Linsnwuscha is super fun rosé. It is dry but it has a couple of grams of residual sugar. It is aromatic and fruity with notes of cherry , strawberry , hazelnut . Rafael says it taste like tomato ketchup (some weird buds he has)...

Feschak is a funky Blaufränkisch, also balanced and complex . A lot of jammy cassis aroma in the nose. Yogurt and Tonka bean on the palate. Feschak means handsome guy in the Eastern Austrian dialect. ;)
Gramuri is a Blaufränkisch like no others. It has a cool liquorice aroma, some blackberry and white pepper. Herbal and rustic in style. Expect a light fizz upon opening the bottle.
Schlawina is orange Neuburger . Powerful tannins, lots of flavours: pear , apricot , black tea leaves and a hint of caramel. A touch of saltiness and a splash of citrus fruits too.
Tags: Craziness 3, No Sulfites Added Wines, Rustic & Earthy
Mira’s Sauvignon Blanc has a nice acidity and complexity. There are some aromatic and fruity notes like passion fruit , peach , gooseberry and cream . An overall balanced white wine!

Mira’s Riesling grow on sand soil, the grapes macerated in open vats and spent time in acacia barrels. The 2023 is a brighter orange wine or a darker white wine with lime and apricot notes, a light oaky and creamy touch. Fresh , elegant and lovely minerality .
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 1, Elegant & Mineral
Cramant is a prestigious Grand Cru extra brut with a velvety perlage. An extremely elegant Champagne with great minerality and a buttery , creamy texture. Some green apple and brioche .
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 1, Elegant & Mineral
Dynamitage is the Gamay in Baptiste cousin ‘s selection. A fruity red with notes of cherry , blackberry and hay . It is also complex and it has a fine minerality .

Ouech Cousin is another great creation by Baptiste Cousin . The 50 yo Grolleau Noir vines grow on loam soil and are surrounded by forest. The outcome is a complex and mineral red with some cool funky and rustic notes. Aromas of black olives , cherry , blueberry , cassis , and rosemary .

Al’cab’erné by Baptiste Cousin has that delicious cassis flavour which is typical in Cabernet Franc, in addition to that you’ll discover black olives , cherry and dry honey . A very lovely, balanced red with lot of complexity and a super long finish .

Marie Rose by Baptiste Cousin is made of Grolleau Gris, one of those pink-skinned grapes that if slightly macerated produces a dark rosé wine. Marie Rose is complex and smoky , it has notes of cherry , rosemary , blood orange and some light spices like cloves and black pepper. Super Yummy.

Puppet Nat by Baptiste Cousin is an off-dry rosé Pet Nat with lots of lovely aromas. You’ll detect cassis , ripe pomegranate , raspberry and some light spices . It is so delicious that goes down like juice. Very versatile too as the light sweetness is well integrated and it complements spicy food and dishes with cheese . Enjoy it also as an aperitif or at the end of a meal!

Pétillant Naturel White by Johannes Trapl is a refreshing and slightly sparkling wine. Great in summery days (but not only), low in alcohol, nice citrusy flavours, green apple and a touch of passion fruit .
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 2, Fruity, No Sulfites Added Wines, Organic Certified Wines, Vegan Wines
Chop Suey from Quantum Winery is a dark natural rosé. Tasty raspberry, lime and pomegranate notes. It’s fresh , mineral and slightly smoky .

Orbis Grün by Fidesser is a Grüner Veltliner macerated for weeks on the skins. The wine is technically orange however in terms of taste it is rather a white wine. Lots of aromas in there like pear , banana , melon and pink pepper . Also a bunch of spices in the nose especially cloves .

“ R&B is a wine with a great rhythm” the Pittnauers claim. They are right, being a blend of Grüner Veltliner (bigger part) and St.Laurent, the wine carries the characteristics of both white and red. Light , a bit fizzy , a hint of caramel in there combined with tasty cherries , peach and raspberry . This is a fun and summery wine!

Pét Naturel Rosé by Schödl is similar in style to the Pet Nat white but in addition it has some extra fruitiness . Not only summery notes like lime and red currant but also raspberry and strawberry , such a balanced and elegant sparkling.
Sankt Laurent by Schödl is a light red wine as well as elegant and complex . Slightly fizzy on the tip of the tongue with some tasty notes of cherry , pomegranate and pimento .

Götzenthal Grüner Veltliner by Schödl is a fantastic white wine. It has an outstanding minerality and great complexity . Yellow apples in there, saltiness , charming elegance and stony notes. Tiny reductive in the nose and slightly fizzy on the palate for that ‘natural’ kick we personally love!
Rosé Supernova comes from Schödl’s best Pinot Noir and St. Laurent vineyards resulting in a complex and elegant wine with great minerality and tasty aromas of strawberry , raspberry and lime .

Free your mind by Schödl is aromatic and floral . Lovely aromas of jasmine, elderflower and grapefruit . A nice citrusy finish lingers in the palate. Have fun drinking the wine under the notes of ‘Free your mind’ by En Vogue!
Kapellenberg Pinot Noir by Fidesser has gentle tannins and acidity and lovely aromas of raspberry , violets and Tonka bean . There is also a touch of wilderness in this tasty, elegant wine.

This Sauvignon B lanc comes from Fidesser’s Sandberg vineyard. The mild winter and the warm summer resulted in a powerful and rich white wine with gentle acidity and lots of aromas like passion fruit , gooseberry , peach and grapefruit .
Platter Sauvignon B lanc is one of Fidesser’s easy drinking wine! The wine is aromatic and balanced with notes of gooseberry , grapefruit and light peach . A treat for everyone at the dinner table.

Platter Grüner Veltliner is part of Fidesser’s “comfy” line: easy drinking, perfect for everyone! This white is the essence of the GV, it is peppery , light and fresh with notes of green apple and lime .
Orbis Rot by Fidesser is a light and fruity red wine. Fresh acidity and low tannins, some cherry , red currant and pomegranate aromas.

Orbis Weiss by Fidesser is a cuvée of many grape varieties. The wine is balanced and complex . It has yellow apple , pear and Tonka bean aromas. A nice touch of creaminess makes this lovely orange extra special.

Orbis Gelb by Fidesser is a delicious orange wine made from aromatic, floral grape varieties: Gelber Muskateller and Weisser Traminer. Litchi , peach , rose petals and jasmine are some of the many aromas in there.
Spätburgunder is the German name for Pinot Noir. Schmitt‘s version is elegant , game-y with a light fizziness . In addition there is an interesting aroma of green tea and some delicious raspberries .
Tags: Craziness 3, Light, Low Alcohol

The “Schlicht und Ergreifend” Weissburgunder from Georg Schmelzer is a fantastic orange wine, it is so good that we decided to buy the whole barrel, only 299 bottles were made and we have them all! The taste recalls a lot of Bourbon Whiskey, how cool is that? Pleasant vanilla and caramel flavours thanks to the time spent in the oak barrel. The wine is peachy , earthy and creamy too.

Roter Traminer Freyheit is part of Heinrich‘s Amphora line and is presented in a white ceramic bottle. The wine is aromatic and fruity , it has aromas of peach , rose hip and apricot plus some floral notes and a lovely saltiness .

Muskat Freyheit is another amazing orange wine from Heinrich. A floral bouquet, especially jasmine and elderflower , combined with peach , a hint of sage and some awesome salty notes. The wine fermented and matured in Amphoras , hence the beautiful ceramic bottle.

Graue Freyheit by Heinrich comes in a beautiful white ceramic bottle, this reminds us that the wine spent time in Amphoras. The complexity and minerality is outstanding. In the palate is a pure grapefruit juice with orange , peach , mint and salty notes.

The Blaufränkisch by Heinrich is a simple, balanced red wine. Easy drinking and super fair priced . Tasty, fruity notes like cherry , black currant and ripe pomegranate . Bring it to a family dinner and you’re good to go, no complains for once (at least from our families)! 😉

The Zweigelt by Heinrich is a balanced red wine that doesn’t need too much introductions and explanations. It is fruity and delicious, with notes of raspberry and cherry , a traditional Zweigelt produced naturally.

wine: Oh When the Saints... Pet Nat 2023
notes: Oh when the Saints … by Heinrich is an aromatic and fruity rosé Pet Nat made with St. Laurent grapes. Tasty raspberry and peach aromas, mild in tannins and acidity, light in alcohol and no added sulphites! Such a great fizzy wine!

Verdeca is an autochthon grape variety from the Apulia region, it was often used for cuvées and rarely macerated on the skins, until now! Petracavallo made an orange wine out of the Verdeca and it is awesome! It is herbal, with earthy tannins, peach , orange zest and hazelnut aromas and a cool oxidative note .

Bianco d’Alessano is a local grape variety that was almost extinct in Apulia region but thankfully Petracavallo managed to recover the vines. The plants produce small amounts of grapes, therefore a limited amount of bottles is available every year. This delicious orange wine has great tannins , some aromatic and tropical notes and some herbs . Hazelnut , mango and apple !
Tags: Craziness 2, Earthy

Wimmer Czerny Sunbeam is a fruity and aromatic Pet Nat made from Grüner Veltliner grapes. It is an explosion of pineapple in the nose and on the palate. It has also a bit of pear and peach . Such a lovely Pet Nat!

The Riesling vines grow on the coolest site of Schmitt‘s winery, the Monsheimer site (hence the M on the name). The wine has elegance and complexity , with tasty flavours like peach , yellow apple , apricot and a hint of caramel, plus lovely creaminess .

Katrin Lautner Wiesenmargerite is an orange Grüner Veltliner . The process of carbonic maceration has given the wine creaminess and a balanced style. A bit wild in the nose, on the palate is citrusy , slightly earthy with a hint of caramel , some herbs , apple and lime . Full of flavour.

Katrin Lautner Wiesenklee is a light Blaufränkisch , slightly fizzy on the palate. It has fruity aromas of cherry , raspberry and pomegranate , some herbal notes, like rosemary , a hint of wood and nice earthy flavours.
Wilde Karotte by Katrin Lautner is super complex , with aromas of lime , peach and black tea . It has an earthy style, some creaminess and a lovely salty finish.

Großer Wiesenknopf by Katrin Lautner is a Zweigelt, but its style could remind you of a Pinot Noir. It’s fruity , light and elegant , with raspberry , violets , blackberry and cherry notes and a touch of salinity . It spent 8 months in barrels, a nice hint of wood as well.

The Mine de rien is the crazy orange wine from Domaine des Mathouans made from Muscat a Petit Grains grapes. It has spent long time on the skins ( not destemmed) therefore you’ll notice a great level of tannins. A floral explosion in the nose, especially a stunning bouquet of jasmine , on the palate you have dry honey , rosemary and some tropical aromas.

wine: Le Bon, la Brute et le Carignan 2021
notes: The le Bon, la Brute et le Carignan from Domaine de Mathouans is another homage to the winemaker, Aline Hock’s love of movies. The Carignan has blackberry , black cherry and marzipan aromas. A wild , fruity, rustic red with great earthy tannins and some funky notes in the nose!
The Graf Sauvignon 2018 from Sepp Muster has aromas of caramel and gooseberry , nice salty minerality and some notes of lime and green mango . A touch of creaminess and a fantastic acidity!
Blaufränkisch Karpatenschiefer from Trapl is an elegant red wine. It has complexity and really delicious aromas of black cherry , raspberry and Rum .
Pétillant Naturel Rosé by Johannes Trapl is a light and super fun sparkling. Perfect for summery days, it has tasty aromas of raspberry , strawberry , lime and thyme .

The Rét from Alex & Maria Koppitsch translates to “field” in Hungarian – referring to the land that was used for feeding the livestock of the village. Both vintages are light , fruity and summery . Fun notes of cherry yogurt , blackberry, blueberry and hay.

Rennersistas ‘ new creation ‘ Bottlefish ‘ is a Blaufränkisch coming from a vineyard right next to the siblings doorstep. The carbonic maceration has blessed this bright red wine with fruitiness and juiciness . It has notes of cherry , raspberry and violets . It is mild in both acidity and tannins making it an overall delicious balanced red.

The Rennersistas Zweigelt has an intense wild nose, you can also detect some cherry and red fruits in there. In the mouth is mineral, complex and juicy , the tasty blackberry aroma brings this red to the next level!

aromas: Green Apple, Lime, Grapefruit, Elderflower, Mint
notes: Like all the the other white wines from Maria & Sepp Muster, the Opok is clear and bright. The great refreshing acidity is accompanied by nice minerality and a lovely citrusy mouth – lime and grapefruit . Also notes of elderflower , green apple and mint .

This Sauvignon Blanc from Maria & Sepp Muster is a light and fresh white wine. The special Opok soil provides the wine with beautiful minerality and good acidity . The wine is citrusy and herbal . Notes of elderflower and lemon and a light bell pepper finish. Some natural craziness in there: wild in the nose, tannins on the palate.
The Gelber Muskateller vom Opok by Muster is a fresh and light version of this grape variety. Also mineral and aromatic with notes of mint , elderflower, lemon and an intense litchi aroma.

The Graf Morillon from Sepp Muster is a delicious white wine based on minerality, in fact you get both stony and salty notes. A bit wild in the nose upon opening the bottle. Some green mango , light peach , caramel and stone fruit. Interesting fact: Morillon is the Styrian (Austrian) name for Chardonnay.

The Maria and Sepp Muster Rosé Opok is a light and elegant cuvée. Bright in color and unfiltered, but not cloudy. Strawberry and cranberry in the nose with a light wild scent. On the palate fresh aromas of lime and red currant , a touch of caramel and beautiful minerality .

Erde from Muster family is an orange wine like no others. One year of skin contact grants the wine nice tannins, lots of aromas and a herbal touch (the usual Vermut leaf aroma). We tasted mango , peach and jasmine but there is so much more in there… ooh, be prepared for an outstanding mango finish!

Krawallo is an old Viennese expression which means troublemaker, this crazy orange wine by Projekt Wildtyp spent 21 days on the skins and has no added sulphur . The wine is rustic and herbal with a light smoky touch. Aromas of p ear, medlar, apricot and rosemary . We recommend to decant this wine.

wine: The Grape of the Century Enigma Weiss MMXXI
notes: For all the Quantum Winery‘s fans out there this is a must have! Enigma Weiss 2021 , a fun and rustic orange wine, in the nose is smoky and it has a nice hazelnut scent. Also smoky on the palate with delicious notes of grapefruit and melon plus a lovely salty aftertaste and a clementine finish.

wine: Herr Baumann MMXXI - Make Portugieser Grape Again
notes: Quantum Winery Herr Baumann Make Portuguiser grape again is a crazy wine! The fun part is understanding what exactly is in there, your nose and taste buds will go wild. We had a funny savoury pancake / chips scent in the nose. Something reminded us of ‘ sour cream and onion Pringles ‘, we know it sounds crazy! On the palate is somehow elegant , with medium acidity and a nice cherry aroma. You better try it for yourself! Update from the tasting on the 5.12.24 : The wine has a bit of an unstable phase. It drinks beautifully when you open the wine. Amazing flavours. However we recommend to drink
Tags: Craziness 3, Mineral

The Pure Joy Hop(e) is a botanical wine created by Julie Hoch. This is made by adding hopes to the fermenting wine resulting in an elegant, dry slightly sparkling drink that has a hint of beer flavour! Such a cool and delicious product, the hops aroma in there is mild and pleasant, there is a touch of yeastiness and some citrusy notes. Highly recommended!! Style: Wine-based drink

The Big Nature Red from Schmelzer is a fun cuvée. It presents a beautiful purple color, in the nose cherry and a hint of mulberry . In the palate tasty aromas of cherry and blood orange plus nice fresh young tannins.

Touch from Koppitsch is kind of a cuvée of a field blend and Welschriesling. The big white egret – that inspired the label as well – often visits the vineyard right by the Neusiedl Lake. The orange wine is aromatic , fresh and fun to drink. This 2020 is refreshing, it has a bit of exotic notes like unripe pineapple and mango. A hint of ‘ multivitamin juice’ flavours, lemongrass , citrus fruits and a touch of hay .

The Aeon 2018 from Koppitsch is a special edition. A white wine full of energy , light and citrusy but also a bit creamy and salty . You get a tasty yellow grapefruit aroma plus a hint of caramel and a lovely long finish . The 2019 is also citrusy and salty but it has different aromas: peach , lime , a hint of coconut and Tonka bean . A bit of Rum -like notes. Big energy as always!!

aromas: Peach, Apricot, Lemon, Lime, Grapefruit, Mango, Elderflower, Limestone
notes: The Perspektive Weiss from Alex & Maria Koppitsch is a cuvée of equal parts of Weissburgunder and Chardonnay. The Perspektive line focuses on soil type, in this case limestone. The Neuberg is the oldest vineyard of the area that overlooks the Neusiedl lake. No wonder the wine gains this beautiful complexity and minerality . In the 2020 notes of elderflower , lime and lemon . There is a touch of creaminess in there and an outstanding acidity! It is definitely a fresh, summery white. The 2021 is also fruity and citrusy and is has a zippy acidity. Intense passion fruit aroma and some mango , peac

The Perspektive rot from Koppitsch stems from the best vineyards Burgenland has to offer. The 2018 is a balanced red with complex notes of cherry , chocolate , rum and cloves . The 2019 is elegant and balanced with notes of cassis, cloves and hay. The 2020 is crazier, it is lighter and fresher. It has higher acidity and a summery style. Notes of young plums, sour cherry and lime.

The new Schrammel 2.0 Color orange is such a great refreshing Pet Nat! It is a basket full of citrusy delights, lots of aromas of clementine , lemon and orange as well as physalis and peach . It is also smoky and mineral . Tip: tilt the wine carefully to redistribute the yeast and open real carefully , have a glass ready to catch the foam!
Color Rosé is a new addition to the Schrammel Pet Nat line. It is unfiltered, it has a lovely refreshing and citrusy style, notes of pomegranate and pink grapefruit and a super minerality .

The Schrammel 2.0 Color Weiss is a dry , citrusy Pet Nat. Super unfiltered, with refreshing minerality and great saltiness , it is definitely a summery wine. Notes of lime , clementine and grapefruit.

Schrammel 2.0 Color Rot is a very light red pet nat, only 10% of alcohol. It is a refreshing wine, perfect for summer days. A bit of cinnamon and smoky notes to add to its delicious aromas of cherry, cranberry and red currant . Important: be careful when opening the bottle, lots of foam will shoot out!

Alternativ Orange from Schrammel 2.0 is a macerated Grüner Veltliner. It is mineral and complex with a taste of clementine and orange peel . Not only, you’ll get also a hint of smokiness and some green mango aromas. A truly delicious orange wine with a super refreshing acidity .

Jaen grape (aka Mencía in Spain) is native to the Iberian Peninsula, the vineyards from Casa de Mouraz grow in the Dao region on a clay and granitic soil. The red wine is fruity and powerful , it has blueberry and black cherry aromas. Balanced, with such a fantastic taste that could remind you of Rum!

wine: Trauben, Liebe und Zeit Gelb N°6
notes: The Strohmeier TLZ Gelb is made from mainly Chardonnay grapes with a small addition of Sauvignon Blanc. The wine is complex and mineral . It has notes of hay , pear , grapefruit and light peach . In the nose lovely apricot notes. Great acidity in there, saltiness and a beautiful long finish .

wine: Trauben, Liebe und Zeit - Karmin N°9
notes: Strohmeier Karmin n9 could be considered both a bright red and a dark rosé. You decide! The wine is super interesting and complex with its smoky and mineral style and the lovely aromas of wild strawberry , pink peppercorn , sour cherry and cranberry .

wine: Trauben, Liebe und Zeit - Indigo N°3
notes: Indigo is the craziest red in Strohmeier‘s selection. It has herbal notes, great acidity and earthy tannins . Notes of cranberry , cherry , grapefruit and a bit of strawberry .

wine: Trauben, Liebe und Zeit - Rot N°9
notes: The TLZ Red from Strohmeier is 95% Zweigelt and a tiny bit of Blauer Wildbacher. This crazy red is elegant and complex with notes of cassis , cherry and cranberry . It has a hint of balsamic which disappears after a day. Try the wine in stages and see how it evolves!

Pitt Nat Blanc from Pittnauer is a summery Pet Nat with exotic notes of passion fruit , and pineapple . It has tasty notes of flat peach , grapefruit and elderflower but prepare yourself for a super peachy aftertaste! Yum!

Mash Pitt from Pittnauer is an orange wine that has everything: it is herbal but also fruity , it has great complexity and some exotic notes. Lots of delicious aromas like pineapple , chamomile , tangerine , vermut leaf and mango .

The Big Natur e line is expanding with Schmelzer‘s new summery rosé. The litre bottle is super refreshing with its lemony notes, the bright acidity and the slight fizz . There are some notes of red currant , pomegranate and lime too.
Voodoo Doll from Schmitt family is a Riesling that spent time under the flor yeast developing a complex style. Floral in the nose, it has also herbal notes, some almonds , apricots and hay .

The Parcellas Pinot Brut Nature from Bianka and Daniel is a special edition. In the nose: almonds , Tonka bean, bread and hint of caramel ; meanwhile in the palate you’ll taste dried apricots , peach , yellow apple , a touch of oxi and you could go on and on with many other flavours that develop every minute.

The Riesling Brut Nature from Bianka and Daniel has a beautiful stony scent combined with peach , buckthorn berry and mirabelle plum aromas. It is an elegant sparkling wine with fantastic minerality and complexity . Notes of peach, cream , lime , grapefruit and nutmeg on the palate. This is such a great alternative to Champagne.

The Weissburgunder grapes of the Parzellás wine from Schmitt ‘ family fermented and matured in Georgian Amphoras . 30% of the mash remained in contact with the juice for about a year blessing the wine with that gorgeous colour and a complex style. The wine has a nice caramel aroma in the nose, on the palate it has herbal notes, delicious flavours of dry honey , yellow apple and macadamia nut.

The Vinception from Domaine de Mathouans is a very earthy full body red wine. Ripe forest berries and a hint of white pepper in the nose, while on the palate is complex , earthy and meaty with a cool salami aroma and dark chocolate . This is definitely a Grenache Noir with high tannins and great character.

wine: Cest à siroter pres de chez vous NV
notes: The “ Ces’t à siroter pres de chez vous ” from Domaine des Mathouans is again referring to a movie, this time a Belgian classic. The wine is herbal and fruity , it has an intense aroma of thyme that lingers nicely in the palate. There is also some cherry , blackberry and hay . Nice earthy tannins and a long finish filled with a burst of spices !

The name Macaline is a playful combination of the grape variety, Macabeo , and the producer’s name, Aline . The wine is as fun as it can be, it is balanced and aromatic . It has notes of melon , yellow apple and hay with a touch of smokiness !
Tags: Biodynamic Certified Wines, Craziness 2, Fruity, Organic Certified Wines, Vegan Wines

The BioDynamite has a new look this year, we all tried the Aline ‘s rosé pet nat the past years and loved it, now you should grab a few of these bangers! The new pet nat is equally delicious, rustic in a way but balanced with citrusy and herbal notes. Aromas of yellow apple , orange zest , mandarine and thyme . Not sure whether to consider it a white or an orange pet nat, we leave this choice up to you!! White/orange Pet Nat

The Roter Veltliner Granit from Wimmer Czerny is a special white wine. It spent time in granite tanks gaining a beautiful smokiness and a great minerality. Apricot aroma, fresh acidity and a touch of creaminess , a true delight.

Gewürz from Rennersistas is a wonderful orange made of Gewürztraminer and Pinot Gris. The 2021 is fruity and aromatic. It has delicious aromas of peach , roses , melon and lemon . A light earthiness in there and mild herbaceous notes.

In a hell mood from Rennersistas was dedicated to their father Helmut. The Pet Nat is summery, light , fresh and crisp. Kind of herbal in the nose, minty we would say; on the palate is citrusy , nice acidity, lime and pear aromas and a mild nutty aftertaste. Some smokiness in there too, hazelnut and grapefruit . It definitely puts anyone in a hell of a mood!

Two are the grape varieties behind the Waiting for Tom Weiss of Rennersistas: Pinot Blanc (70%) and Chardonnay (30%). Really fun to drink, it has citrus fruits, green tea and pear aromas. Like the previous vintage is fruity and balanced . It has a tiny bit more acidity, therefore is more summery and fresh .

Get ready for this awesome white from Quantum Winery. Spitting on Wittgenstein is a super dry , fresh Riesling. A citrusy bomb with notes of lemon, grapefruit and bergamot . This cloudy crazy wine has some green apple aroma, a light fizz and bright acidity : your perfect summer refreshment .

Johannes Trapl‘s Uni6 – pronounced unisex in German- is a cuvée of Blaufränkisch (80%) and Sankt Laurent. It comes in a pet nat bottle however it is not sparkling! The 2022 is a light rosé, summery with a light fizz . It has aromas of pomegranate , red currant , green tea leaves and a hint of rose petals.

J19 Ultra from Dom Bliskowice is a lovely orange wine made from Johanniter , a local grape variety. The wine has herbaceous notes and earthy tannins, rosemary and vermut leaf aromas, tasty green apple and wonderful complexity .

R18 from Dom Bliskowice is a dry Riesling based on minerality . Awesome salinity, aromas of green olives , apricots and lemon . An interesting hint of petrol can be detected. The wine evolves with time, the next day is even better.
Dom Bliskowice J20 is an aromatic white wine. It is fruity with a note of green apple , a hint of caramel and some light rosemary . We love the crisp acidity and the saline aftertaste.

Monday Lisa from Dom Bliskowice has a really funny label picturing an exhausted Monna Lisa holding a glass of wine. Not only the presentation is brilliant so is the wine itself! The bottle holds a fruity , light and complex juice, an explosion of blackberries both in the nose and on the palate. Lots of black cherries too, plus rosemary and a touch of moss .

Keskese from Dom Bliskowice is one of the most interesting wines we have ever tasted! It has a very bright red color and it surprises you with its herbaceous aromas . Very complex , yet elegant and light . Some of the flavours we detected are fresh liquorice root , vermut leaf , moss , fern and a bit of strawberry . The wine can stay open for more than a week and it’d be as good as the first day.

The Blauburger is not often to be found, it is a cross between Blaufränkisch and Blauer Portuguiser. The Hager Matthias‘s version is elegant and balanced . In the nose you get a tiny wild scent but then you have beautiful black cherry and cloves aromas!

The Riesling PUR from Hager Matthias is an earthy orange wine with fresh acidity and lovely tannins. Such an interesting vintage this one: slighlty fizzy at first, resin tree and herbs in the nose, in the palate is zesty and herbal with orange peel and almonds aromas.

The Zweigelt Vielfalt from Hager Matthias is a dark medium body rosé. It has a beautiful fruitiness with notes of ripe pomegranate , cherry, strawberry and raspberry , a hint of caramel too. It is balanced and aromatic , super delicious!

The Sauvignon Blanc from Hager Matthias is a perfection of its grape variety. It’s a fresh , balanced , fruity natural white wine with tones of gooseberry , lime and green apple. Recommended for all Sauvignon Blanc lovers and beyond! Style: white Craziness:

The Pacina 2013 from the Italian producer is their signature red wine. This rather old school Sangiovese was fermented in concrete and matured in barrels. The earthy notes and the great level of tannins are holding on to the essence of the olden days.

The “Schlicht und ergreifend” Sämling from Georg Schmelzer is an aromatic and complex orange wine. Not only the color will make you fall in love with it but also the charming bouquet of peaches and mangoes with a hint of Tonka bean . You’ll get lots of peaches in the palate as well plus some herbal and earthy notes. Pure Heaven!

wine: Schlicht und Ergreifend Cuvée Orange III
notes: “Schlicht und Ergreifend” Cuvée Orange from Schmelzer is another awesome macerated wine, matured in small barrels it has gained delicious oaky aromas: vanilla and caramel . It is also creamy , herbal and peachy . It has earthy tannins, a hint of hay and some acidity.

The St. Laurent grapes of this delicious red from Pittnauer come from a special area in the north of Burgenland region, the vineyard plot is called Altenberg . The wine has a fragrant and elegant style. It is complex and rich with lovely aromas of raspberry , blackberry and cassis . A hint of oakiness can be detected since the wine matured for almost a year in small used barriques.
The vines of the Pittnauer St. Laurent vom Dorf grow on iron enriched Danube gravel soil gifting this light red wine with an elegant and balanced style. Cassis , red currant , cherry and some hay.

Pitt Nat Rosé from Pittnauer is a fantastic Pet Nat! Very flavourful, fruity and aromatic ! The 2022 taste like a pineapple juice with extra strawberry and mango . It definitely gives you a tropical feeling!

Quantum Winery Dekonstruktion Red is light in terms of body, color and alcohol. This delicious cuvée is a bit smoky , grassy and a bit herbal and it has aromas of cherry and pear . Mild in acidity and tannins.

The Revolution Red Solera from Johannes Zillinger is a mix of 3 grape varieties: Rösler (50%), Zweigelt (25%) and Cabernet (25%). The Rösler and the Zweigelt fermented and matured in barrels while the Cabernet in Amphora. Expect a delicious, fruity red wine. Balanced in style and low in tannins. Notes of cherry, hazelnut and herbs, plus a lovely black currant aftertaste and a beautiful long finish.

J.Zillinger Velue Zweigelt is like the other Velue wines, light and uncomplicated. It is fruity and mild with tasty cherry and pomegranate aromas, low in tannins and lovely acidity. Great value for a high quality red!

Parcellaire Blanc #1 from J.Zillinger is a tasty white cuvée. The cool location, where the old vineyards grow, gifts the wine with some acidity and pure freshness . Delicious aromas of gooseberry and quince , great floral and citrusy notes too.

Parcellaire Blanc and Sauvignon from Zillinger is made of Pinot Blanc and Sauvignon Blanc grapes. The old vineyards are located high up, on cool airy hilltops, resulting in a light , balanced and aromatic white wine. Not too high in acidity with charming aromas of elderflower and lemon , slightly reductive, very delicious!

Johannes Zillinger‘s Muskateller from the NUMEN line is probably the most aromatic one from the series. It has noticeably more dimensions than a Muskateller usually does. This unfiltered natural wine has gone through intracellular fermentation, hence its complexity and long finish . An explosion of flavours: lots of litchi and peach , some floral notes mainly jasmine and rose .
Johannes Zillinger‘s Velue Rosé is a fresh and summery wine. It has great salinity combined with tasty aromas of red currant and pomegranate . Herbal notes and a hint of grapefruit too.

Coteaux Champegnois Millésime from Chavost is a fantastic Chardonnay . Light , elegant and complex with a buttery texture. Caramel , yogurt and lemon zest and a lovely stony minerality. The perfect wine for all the ‘French Chardonnay’ lovers.

wine: Champagne Blanc de Chardonnay Extra Brut
notes: Blanc de Chardonnay from Chavost is a rich and creamy Champagne . It has the elegance, complexity and the bread-y aftertaste that you would expect in a Champagne . In the nose there are interesting aromas of hazelnut and jasmine . It is fruity on the palate with lots of tasty green apples . Type: white Champagne Craziness:

The Pinot Brut Nature from Bianka and Daniel is made from Pinot Noir and Pinot Blanc and it has a fantastic minerality and complexity . No dosage and no added sulfites, it presents this bready aftertaste like in traditional Champagne. We noticed a lovely dill aroma in both the nose and palate.

The Feminin is the Chardonnay in the Schmitt‘s selection. 4 weeks of skin contact resulting in a super fruity and complex orange wine. Awesome nose and palate with aromatic flavours like macadamia , peach and caramel . Delicious!
Tags: Craziness 4, Mineral, No Sulfites Added Wines, Vegan Wines

Nista from Marco Durante is a powerful orange wine. This is a really exciting skin-contact wine as it is earthy and malty with tasty aromas of dried pineapple , honey and herbs ( rosemary maybe). Great complexity , present tannins and a lovely smoky aftertaste.

Settantasette (Italian for seventy-seven) is Marco Durante’s year of birth, “a joyful and a terrible year”, he claims. This powerful red is earthy and complex . Very dry, herbal and great level of tannins. Lovely aromas of blackberry , tobacco and rosemary .

Marco Durante’s Accade (‘happens’ in Italian) was initially meant for the Settantasette however the wine took a different path and developed its very own character. This is a crazy wine: volatile acidity, high tannins and an outstanding balsamic aroma. Cinnamon , cherry , blueberry are few of the flavours we detected but there is a lot more in there!

Vinos Ambiz Rosado is a rich rosé yet refreshing . Super aromatic , creamy and complex . Yummy aroma of strawberries . We recommend to drink this delicious wine within 2 days, after that it starts to get nutty.

The Rosado from Vinos Ambiz is a delicious Pet Nat . Aromatic and fruity . It has a couple of grams of residual sugar, so expect it to be slightly sweet . Refreshing summery aromas of watermelon and strawberry. In the nose fun and wild !

Malvar from Vinos Ambiz refers to its grape variety, indigenous to Spain. It stems from 100 year-old (!!) vines. The wine is the least funky of Ambiz’s selection: aromatic , and herbal , balanced with a hint of oxi . We discovered lovely aromas of jasmine , grapefruit and almonds . Don’t forget to tilt the bottle few times before opening it.

Vinos Ambiz Grenache is an earthy red wine with a good amount of tannins. It has pleasant oaky and matured notes. Aromas of forest floor , coffee and a beautiful scent of liquorice that intensifies over time.

This beautiful orange from Vinos Ambiz is made from the Airén grape variety. It stems from 40 year-old vines, ensuring its richness and complexity in flavour. Stony , bit earthy with delicious aromas of walnut and quince . Be aware that there is some volatile acidity in there. We only recommend this wine for wine lovers that also like a bit of volatile acidity in the wine. We think it is well integrated in the wine, but it is definitely present. Tipp : shake the bottle before serving so that the last glass will taste like the first!

The Chelva from Vinos Ambiz comes from El Tiemblo, the Sierra de Gredos region in Spain. This crazy, cloudy orange wine comes with lovely aromatic flavours. Wild scents in the nose are alleviated by lots of delicious elderflowers . Fruity in the palate with notes of peach , mango and nettle . We always suggest redistributing the yeast equally by tilting the bottle couple of times. Open and enjoy!
Waiting for Tom Red from Rennersistas is a cuvée of Zweigelt (55%), Pinot Noir (30%) and Blaufränkisch (15%). The wine is a pure cassis bomb! It is also minty and grassy , light and fruity .

Fidesser Orbis Orange is a very fun wine to drink, is cloudy, aromatic and creamy . You’ll get lots of different cool flavours like vanilla , peach and orange zest . You'll detect like oak-y notes too!

Fidesser Orbis Pet Nat is the perfect summer treat . The 2020 rosé is light and fruity , an explosion of raspberries in both nose and palate. You have some refreshing notes like lemon , red currant and mint . The 2022 vintage has a bit of higher acidity, it is citrusy , fresh and light . Red currant and cranberry aromas.

The Quantum Winery Dekonstruktion Weiss is dark in color, kind of in between orange and white wine. It has the freshness and the peppery style of a typical Grüner Veltliner coated with some smokiness and yeastiness . Lime , ginger and bay leaf are the main flavours, this is a great summery wine. Between white and orange

Expect crazy stuff from this Welschriesling from Rennersistas . A bit wild in the nose and mildly exotic . Bone-dry , fresh and citrusy . Aromas of dry honey , lemon , apple and quince . It awaits you are freshing acidity and beautiful minerality .

The Blaufränkisch from Rennersistas is a delicious red based on minerality and complexity . Floral in the nose with some spices too, cloves especially. Tasty blackberries and a hint of tobacco in the palate.

The Orange PUR from Wimmer Czerny is a cuvée made from Roter Veltliner and Traminer grapes, fermented and matured in amphoras . The result is outstanding, an aromatic and floral wine with peach , thyme and dry honey flavours. The mango aroma gives an exotic touch to this delicious balanced orange wine.

The Dao Private Selection from Casa de Mouraz is 70% Touriga-Nacional and 30% Jaen. This red is fruity and probably the earthiest of the producer’s selection, it pairs perfectly with game and strong cheeses. It presents cherry and blackberry aromas and a hint of oakiness .

The Rotburger Kreuzegg from Schnabel is a very interesting version of a Zweigelt . A bit funky in the nose with lovely cherry aromas, on the palate you’ll find black currant , sage , white pepper and a curious light smoky aftertaste which recalls of an ‘Isle Whiskey’. This delicious Burgundy-style red is complex and mineral and lingers long on the palate .

The Bot from Casa de Mouraz comes from a 100 years old vineyard, the vines share the space with other fruit trees like plum, fig, peach and olive trees. The field blend of red and white grapes resulted in a bright charming colour. Expect elegance and complexity , cassis , blackberry and cherry flavours, a nice fresh minerality , some tannins and a beautiful long finish . Only 683 bottles produced and every bottle is numbered.

Elfa from Casa de Mouraz is a special red: 80 years old vineyard, strictly selected grapes and few bottles produced. It is rich and elegant , it has a nice minerality plus aromas of cherry and plum , a beautiful balanced red.
